column3: te .gniveśādikāṃs te tu pṛthak tantrāṇi tenire |
aṣṭāv aṅgāni tasyāhuś cikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā |
vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ ||
vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca |
tair bhaved viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś cāgniḥ samaiḥ samaḥ ||
koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdur madhyo madhyaḥ syāt taiḥ samair api |
taiś ca tisraḥ prakṛtayo hīnamadhyottamāḥ pṛthak |
tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo .nilaḥ |
pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam ||
snigdhaḥ śīto gurur mandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ |
ṣaḍ dravyam āśritās te ca yathāpūrvaṃ balāvahāḥ |
tatrādyā mārutaṃ ghnanti trayas tiktādayaḥ kapham ||
śamanaṃ kopanaṃ svasthahitaṃ dravyam iti tridhā ||
rajas tamaś ca manaso dvau ca doṣāv udāhṛtau ||
śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti samāsād auṣadhaṃ dvidhā |
vastir vireko vamanaṃ tathā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu |
āḍhyo rogī bhiṣagvaśyo jñāpakaḥ sattvavān api ||
śastrādisādhanaḥ kṛcchraḥ saṃkare ca tato gadaḥ |
tyajed ārtaṃ bhiṣagbhūpair dviṣṭaṃ teṣāṃ dviṣaṃ dviṣam |
cikitsitaṃ jvare rakte kāse śvāse ca yakṣmaṇi |
vamau madātyaye .rśaḥsu viṣi dvau dvau ca mūtrite ||
bālopacāre tadvyādhau tadgrahe dvau ca bhūtage ||
unmāde .tha smṛtibhraṃśe dvau dvau vartmasu saṃdhiṣu |
dṛktamoliṅganāśeṣu trayo dvau dvau ca sarvage ||
brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhet svastho rakṣārtham āyuṣaḥ |
sauvīram añjanaṃ nityaṃ hitam akṣṇos tato bhajet |
vātapittāmayī bālo vṛddho .jīrṇaś ca taṃ tyajet |
śītakāle vasante ca mandam eva tato .nyadā |
tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako raktapittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ |
ativyāyāmataḥ kāso jvaraś chardiś ca jāyate ||
gajaṃ siṃha ivākarṣan bhajann ati vinaśyati ||
jīrṇe hitaṃ mitaṃ cādyān na vegān īrayed balāt |
na vegito .nyakāryaḥ syān nājitvā sādhyam āmayam ||
sukhaṃ ca na vinā dharmāt tasmād dharmaparo bhavet ||
saṃpadvipatsv ekamanā hetāvīrṣyet phale na tu ||
kāle hitaṃ mitaṃ brūyād avisaṃvādi peśalam |
naikaḥ sukhī na sarvatra viśrabdho na ca śaṅkitaḥ |
na kaṃcid ātmanaḥ śatruṃ nātmānaṃ kasyacid ripum ||
column5: na kaścit kasyacin mitraṃ na kaścit kasyacid ripuḥ |

column3: prakāśayen nāpamānaṃ na ca niḥsnehatāṃ prabhoḥ |
na pīḍayed indriyāṇi na caitāny atilālayet ||
niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī maulī sahāyavān |
nadīṃ taren na bāhubhyāṃ nāgniskandham abhivrajet ||
nāsikāṃ na vikuṣṇīyān nākasmād vilikhed bhuvam |
nordhvajānuś ciraṃ tiṣṭhen naktaṃ seveta na drumam ||
sarvathekṣeta nādityaṃ na bhāraṃ śirasā vahet |
ācāryaḥ sarvaceṣṭāsu loka eva hi dhīmataḥ |
evaṃ kṛtsnadinaṃ nītvā rātrau yāme gṛhe gate |
devān ṛṣīn gurūn smṛtvā tataḥ śayanam ācaret ||
āyur ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ yaśo lokāṃś ca śāśvatān ||
māsair dvisaṃkhyair māghādyaiḥ kramāt ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ |
śiśirādyās tribhis tais tu vidyād ayanam uttaram |
ādānaṃ ca tad ādatte nṛṇāṃ pratidinaṃ balam ||
tiktaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaṭuko balino .tra rasāḥ kramāt |
varṣādayo visargaś ca yad balaṃ visṛjaty ayam |
saumyatvād atra somo hi balavān hīyate raviḥ ||
śīte .gryaṃ vṛṣṭigharme .lpaṃ balaṃ madhyaṃ tu śeṣayoḥ |
bhavaty alpendhano dhātūn sa paced vāyuneritaḥ |
dairghyān niśānām etarhi prātar eva bubhukṣitaḥ |
niyuddhaṃ kuśalaiḥ sārdhaṃ pādāghātaṃ ca yuktitaḥ ||
rasān snigdhān palaṃ puṣṭaṃ gauḍam acchasurāṃ surām |
navam annaṃ vasāṃ tailaṃ śaucakārye sukhodakam |
ayam eva vidhiḥ kāryaḥ śiśire .pi viśeṣataḥ |
tadā hi śītam adhikaṃ raukṣyaṃ cādānakālajam ||
hatvāgniṃ kurute rogān atas taṃ tvarayā tyajet ||
pratyahaṃ kṣīyate śleṣmā tena vāyuś ca vardhate |
bhajen madhuram evānnaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ himaṃ dravam |
madyaṃ na peyaṃ peyaṃ vā svalpaṃ subahuvāri vā |
jaṅgamā iva padminyo haranti dayitāḥ klamam ||
vahninaiva ca mandena teṣv ity anyonyadūṣiṣu |
bhajet sādhāraṇaṃ sarvam ūṣmaṇas tejanaṃ ca yat ||
āsthāpanaṃ śuddhatanur jīrṇaṃ dhānyaṃ rasān kṛtān |
divyaṃ kaupaṃ śṛtaṃ cāmbho bhojanaṃ tv atidurdine ||
taptānāṃ saṃcitaṃ vṛṣṭau pittaṃ śaradi kupyati ||
tiktaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ ca kṣudhito .nnaṃ bhajel laghu ||
śuci haṃsodakaṃ nāma nirmalaṃ malajij jalam ||
nābhiṣyandi na vā rūkṣaṃ pānādiṣv amṛtopamam |
śīte varṣāsu cādyāṃs trīn vasante .ntyān rasān bhajet ||
tatra pūrvo vidhis tyājyaḥ sevanīyo .paraḥ kramāt ||
asātmyajā hi rogāḥ syuḥ sahasā tyāgaśīlanāt ||
mukhena viṭpravṛttiś ca pūrvoktāś cāmayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
mūtrasya rodhāt pūrve ca prāyo rogās tadauṣadham |
mūtrajeṣu tu pāne ca prāgbhaktaṃ śasyate ghṛtam ||
pravartayet kṣutiṃ saktāṃ snehasvedau ca śīlayet |
tṛṣṇāyā nigrahāt tatra śītaḥ sarvo vidhir hitaḥ |
tatra yojyaṃ laghu snigdham uṣṇam alpaṃ ca bhojanam |
aṅgamardaś ca tatreṣṭaḥ svapnaḥ saṃvāhanāni ca |
śoṣo hidhmā ca kāryo .tra kāsahā sutarāṃ vidhiḥ |
hitaṃ viśramaṇaṃ tatra vātaghnaś ca kriyākramaḥ |
jṛmbhāyāḥ kṣavavad rogāḥ sarvaś cānilajid vidhiḥ ||
sagulmā bāṣpatas tatra svapno madyaṃ priyāḥ kathāḥ ||
vyāyāmaḥ srutir asrasya śastaṃ cātra virecanam ||
vastiśuddhikaraiḥ siddhaṃ bhajet kṣīraṃ priyāḥ striyaḥ |
nirdiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ tatra bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ye tu tān prati ||
tataś cānekadhā prāyaḥ pavano yat prakupyati |
dhārayet tu sadā vegān hitaiṣī pretya ceha ca |
yateta ca yathākālaṃ malānāṃ śodhanaṃ prati |
atyarthasaṃcitās te hi kruddhāḥ syur jīvitacchidaḥ ||
ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ ||
rāgadveṣabhayādyāś ca te syur āgantavo gadāḥ ||
śītodbhavaṃ doṣacayaṃ vasante viśodhayan grīṣmajam abhrakāle |
ghanātyaye vārṣikam āśu samyak prāpnoti rogān ṛtujān na jātu ||
dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvān āptopasevī ca bhavaty arogaḥ ||
column5: dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvān āptopasevī ca bhavatyarogaḥ ||

column3: tanv avyaktarasaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ śītaṃ laghv amṛtopamam ||
gaṅgāmbu nabhaso bhraṣṭaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tv arkendumārutaiḥ |
aklinnam avivarṇaṃ ca tat peyaṃ gāṅgam anyathā ||
sāmudraṃ tan na pātavyaṃ māsād āśvayujād vinā |
aindram ambu supātrastham avipannaṃ sadā pibet ||
anārtavaṃ ca yad divyam ārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat ||
pathyāḥ samāsāt tā nadyo viparītās tv ato .nyathā |
himavanmalayodbhūtāḥ pathyās tā eva ca sthirāḥ |
nāmbu peyam aśaktyā vā svalpam alpāgnigulmibhiḥ ||
pittayukte hitaṃ doṣe vyuṣitaṃ tat tridoṣakṛt ||
nārikelodakaṃ snigdhaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ himaṃ laghu |
prāyaḥ payo .tra gavyaṃ tu jīvanīyaṃ rasāyanam ||
hastinyāḥ sthairyakṛd bāḍham uṣṇaṃ tv aikaśaphaṃ laghu ||
payo .bhiṣyandi gurv āmaṃ yuktyā śṛtam ato .nyathā ||
pīnase mūtrakṛcchre ca rūkṣaṃ tu grahaṇīgade |
na cānāmalakaṃ nāpi nityaṃ no mandam anyathā ||
tadvan mastu saraṃ srotaḥśodhi viṣṭambhajil laghu |
snehānām uttamaṃ śītaṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ param |
ikṣoḥ saro guruḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphamūtrakṛt ||
kiṃcit kālaṃ vidhṛtyā ca vikṛtiṃ yāti yāntrikaḥ ||
sakṣārāḥ sakaṣāyāś ca soṣṇāḥ kiṃcid vidāhinaḥ ||
hṛdyaḥ purāṇaḥ pathyaś ca navaḥ śleṣmāgnisādakṛt ||
uṣṇam uṣṇārtam uṣṇe ca yuktaṃ coṣṇair nihanti tat ||
pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivāryate |
tailaṃ svayonivat tatra mukhyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca |
tvagdoṣakṛd acakṣuṣyaṃ sūkṣmoṣṇaṃ kaphakṛn na ca ||
satiktoṣaṇam airaṇḍaṃ tailaṃ svādu saraṃ guru |
tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ picchilaṃ visraṃ raktairaṇḍodbhavaṃ tv ati ||
ākṣaṃ svādu himaṃ keśyaṃ guru pittānilāpaham |
column5: ākṣaṃ svādu himaṃ keśyaṃ guru pittānilāpaham ||

column3: māṃsānugasvarūpau ca vidyān medo .pi tāv iva |
guru tad doṣajananaṃ navaṃ jīrṇam ato .nyathā ||
tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghus tīkṣṇā nihanti ca |
vraṇe pāṇḍvāmaye kuṣṭhe na cātyarthaṃ virudhyate ||
mārdvīkaṃ lekhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ saram |
śāṇḍākī cāsutaṃ cānyat kālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu ||
te kramād vituṣair vidyāt satuṣaiś ca yavaiḥ kṛte ||
pataṅgās tapanīyāś ca ye cānye śālayaḥ śubhāḥ ||
column5: pataṃgas tapanīyaśca ye cānye śālayaḥ śubhāḥ ||

column3: mahāṃs tam anu kalamas taṃ cāpy anu tataḥ pare ||
sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣāś ca pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca ninditāḥ |
snigdho grāhī laghuḥ svādus tridoṣaghnaḥ sthiro himaḥ ||
gandhanāḥ kuruvindāś ca guṇair alpāntarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
koradūṣaḥ paraṃ grāhī sparśaḥ śīto viṣāpahaḥ |
rūkṣaḥ śīto guruḥ svāduḥ saro viḍvātakṛd yavaḥ ||
nyūno yavād anuyavo rūkṣoṣṇo vaṃśajo yavaḥ |
vṛṣyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdho jīvano vātapittahā ||
kaṣāyaṃ svādu saṃgrāhi kaṭupākaṃ himaṃ laghu ||
uṣṇas tvacyo himaḥ sparśe keśyo balyas tilo guruḥ |
dṛkśukrahṛt kaṭuḥ pāke tadvad bījaṃ kusumbhajam ||
māṣo .tra sarveṣv avaro yavakaḥ śūkajeṣu ca |
vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāghnī dīpanī hitā ||
viparīto guruḥ kṣīramāṃsādyair yaś ca sādhitaḥ ||
bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano vṛṣyaś cakṣuṣyo vraṇahā rasaḥ ||
rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā balyā rucipradā |
viṣṭambhi mūtralaṃ hṛdyaṃ yathādravyaguṇaṃ ca tat |
dhānā viṣṭambhinī rūkṣā tarpaṇī lekhanī guruḥ |
ghnanti saṃtarpaṇāḥ pānāt sadya eva balapradāḥ |
nodakāntaritān na dvir na niśāyāṃ na kevalān ||
na bhuktvā na dvijaiś chittvā saktūn adyān na vā bahūn |
vartako vartikā caiva tittiriḥ krakaraḥ śikhī |
sṛmaraś camaraḥ khaḍgo gavayaś ca mahāmṛgāḥ |
rājīcilicimādyāś ca māṃsam ity āhur aṣṭadhā |
tatra baddhamalāḥ śītā laghavo jāṅgalā hitāḥ ||
dīpanaḥ kaṭukaḥ pāke grāhī rūkṣo himaḥ śaśaḥ ||
tadvac ca kukkuṭo vṛṣyo grāmyas tu śleṣmalo guruḥ |
caṭakāḥ śleṣmalāḥ snigdhā vātaghnāḥ śukralāḥ param ||
viparītam ato jñeyam āvikaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ tu tat ||
lāvarohitagodhaiṇāḥ sve sve varge varāḥ param ||
māṃsaṃ sadyohataṃ śuddhaṃ vayaḥsthaṃ ca bhajet tyajet |
mṛtaṃ kṛśaṃ bhṛśaṃ medyaṃ vyādhivāriviṣair hatam ||
hanti doṣatrayaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vṛṣyā soṣṇā rasāyanī |
tiktaṃ pāke kaṭu grāhi vātalaṃ kaphapittajit ||
snigdhaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu bṛṃhaṇaṃ śukrakṛt param |
gurvī sarā tu pālaṅkyā madaghnī cāpyupodakā ||
pālaṅkyāvat smṛtaś cañcuḥ sa tu saṃgrahaṇātmakaḥ |
jīvanī bṛṃhaṇī kaṇṭhyā gurvī vṛṣyā rasāyanam |
bālaṃ pittaharaṃ śītaṃ vidyāt pakvam ato .nyathā |
krauñcādanaṃ kaloḍyaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru ||
ālukāni ca sarvāṇi tathā sūpyāni lakṣmaṇam ||
laghupattrā tu yā cillī sā vāstukasamā matā ||
rūkṣoṣṇam amlaṃ kausumbhaṃ guru pittakaraṃ saram |
yad bālam avyaktarasaṃ kiṃcit kṣāraṃ satiktakam |
tan mūlakaṃ doṣaharaṃ laghu soṣṇaṃ niyacchati ||
rase pāke ca kaṭukam uṣṇavīryaṃ tridoṣakṛt |
gurv abhiṣyandi ca snigdhasiddhaṃ tad api vātajit ||
vātaśleṣmaharaṃ śuṣkaṃ sarvam āmaṃ tu doṣalam |
ārdrikā tiktamadhurā mūtralā na ca pittakṛt |
hṛdyaḥ keśyo gurur vṛṣyaḥ snigdho rocanadīpanaḥ |
tīkṣṇo gṛñjanako grāhī pittināṃ hitakṛn na saḥ |
dīpanaḥ śūraṇo rucyaḥ kaphaghno viśado laghuḥ ||
viśeṣād arśasāṃ pathyo bhūkandas tv atidoṣalaḥ |
pattre puṣpe phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt ||
column5: puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ nālaṃ kandāśca guravaḥ kramāt ||

column3: varā śākeṣu jīvantī sārṣapaṃ tv avaraṃ param |
udriktapittāñ jayati trīn doṣān svādu dāḍimam ||
sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ grāhi rocanadīpanam ||
urumāṇaṃ priyālaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru śītalam |
phalaṃ tu pittalaṃ tālaṃ saraṃ kāśmaryajaṃ himam ||
paraṃ vātaharaṃ snigdham anuṣṇaṃ tu priyālajam |
kolamajjā guṇais tadvat tṛṭchardikāsajic ca saḥ |

column5: bilvaṃ tu durjaraṃ pakvaṃ doṣalaṃ pūtimārutam |

column3: dīpanaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ bālaṃ grāhy ubhayaṃ ca tat |
kapittham āmaṃ kaṇṭhaghnaṃ doṣalaṃ doṣaghāti tu ||
gurv āmraṃ vātajit pakvaṃ svādv amlaṃ kaphaśukrakṛt |
śamyā gurūṣṇaṃ keśaghnaṃ rūkṣaṃ pīlu tu pittalam |
satiktaṃ svādu yat pīlu nātyuṣṇaṃ tat tridoṣajit |
svādv amlaṃ śītam uṣṇaṃ ca dvidhā pālevataṃ guru |

column3: dhātusāmyaṃ tathā hy eṣāṃ śleṣmā cāṅgāni puṣyati ||
viṣārtaḥ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu niśāsv api ||
ebhir eva ca nidrāyā nāśaḥ śleṣmātisaṃkṣayāt ||
yathākālam ato nidrāṃ rātrau seveta sātmyataḥ |
asātmyāj jāgarād ardhaṃ prātaḥ svapyād abhuktavān ||
bālo vṛddho .nyavegārtas tyajed rogī ca maithunam ||
seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ tṛpto vājīkṛtām hime |
aparvamaraṇaṃ ca syād anyathā gacchataḥ striyam ||
seveta cānu śayanaṃ viratau ratasya tasyaivam āśu vapuṣaḥ punar eti dhāma ||
śrutacaritasamṛddhe karmadakṣe dayālau bhiṣaji niranubandhaṃ deharakṣāṃ niveśya |
mātrāśī sarvakālaṃ syān mātrā hy agneḥ pravartikā |
mātrāṃ dravyāṇy apekṣante gurūṇy api laghūny api ||
atimātraṃ punaḥ sarvān āśu doṣān prakopayet |
pīḍyamānā hi vātādyā yugapat tena kopitāḥ ||
prayāti nordhvaṃ nādhastād āhāro na ca pacyate ||
yāntas tiryak tanuṃ sarvāṃ daṇḍavat stambhayanti cet ||
pītvā sogrāpaṭuphalaṃ vāry uṣṇaṃ yojayet tataḥ ||
tīvrārtir api nājīrṇī pibec chūlaghnam auṣadham |
trividhaṃ trividhe doṣe tat samīkṣya prayojayet |
prabhūte śodhanaṃ taddhi mūlād unmūlayen malān |
tadarthakāri vā pakve doṣe tv iddhe ca pāvake |
ajīrṇaṃ ca kaphād āmaṃ tatra śopho .kṣigaṇḍayoḥ |
laṅghanaṃ kāryam āme tu viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ bhṛśam |
vidagdhe vamanaṃ yad vā yathāvasthaṃ hitaṃ bhavet ||
garīyaso bhavel līnād āmād eva vilambikā |
śayīta kiṃcid evātra sarvaś cānāśito divā ||
vidāhi śuṣkam atyambuplutaṃ cānnaṃ na jīryati ||
miśraṃ pathyam apathyaṃ ca bhuktaṃ samaśanaṃ matam ||
akāle bahu cālpaṃ vā bhuktaṃ tu viṣamāśanam ||
trīṇy apy etāni mṛtyuṃ vā ghorān vyādhīn sṛjanti vā |
kāle sātmyaṃ śuci hitaṃ snigdhoṣṇaṃ laghu tanmanāḥ ||
tarpayitvā pitṝn devān atithīn bālakān gurūn |
samīkṣya samyag ātmānam anindann abruvan dravam |
śuṣkaśākāni yavakān phāṇitaṃ ca na śīlayet ||
svāsthyānuvṛttikṛd yac ca rogocchedakaraṃ ca yat ||
adyād dravyaṃ guru snigdhaṃ svādu mandaṃ sthiraṃ puraḥ ||
annena kukṣer dvāv aṃśau pānenaikaṃ prapūrayet ||
dadhni madye viṣe kṣaudre koṣṇaṃ piṣṭamayeṣu tu |
surā kṛśānāṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ sthūlānāṃ tu madhūdakam |
śoṣe māṃsaraso madyaṃ māṃse svalpe ca pāvake ||
kṣīṇe vṛddhe ca bāle ca payaḥ pathyaṃ yathāmṛtam ||
viparītaṃ yad annasya guṇaiḥ syād avirodhi ca |
anupānaṃ karoty ūrjāṃ tṛptiṃ vyāptiṃ dṛḍhāṅgatām |
pānaṃ tyajeyuḥ sarvaś ca bhāṣyādhvaśayanaṃ tyajet ||
prasṛṣṭe viṇmūtre hṛdi suvimale doṣe svapathage |
tathāgnāv udrikte viśadakaraṇe dehe ca sulaghau ||
prayuñjītāhāraṃ vidhiniyamitaṃ kālaḥ sa hi mataḥ ||
dravyam eva rasādīnāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ te hi tadāśrayāḥ |
pañcabhūtātmakaṃ tat tu kṣmām adhiṣṭhāya jāyate ||
tannirvṛttir viśeṣaś ca vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā ||
naikadoṣās tato rogās tatra vyakto rasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||

column3: na kiṃcid vidyate dravyaṃ vaśān nānārthayogayoḥ ||
vīryaṃ punar vadanty eke guru snigdhaṃ himaṃ mṛdu ||

column3: ataś ca viparītatvāt sambhavaty api naiva sā |
vivakṣyate rasādyeṣu vīryaṃ gurvādayo hy ataḥ ||
uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ dvidhaivānye vīryam ācakṣate .pi ca |
śamaṃ ca vātakaphayoḥ karoti śiśiraṃ punaḥ |
rasānāṃ pariṇāmānte sa vipāka iti smṛtaḥ ||
svāduḥ paṭuś ca madhuram amlo .mlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ |
rasair asau tulyaphalas tatra dravyaṃ śubhāśubham |
kiṃcid rasena kurute karma pākena cāparam ||
column5: kiṃcid rasena kurute karma pākena cāparam |

column3: yad yad dravye rasādīnāṃ balavattvena vartate ||
rasaṃ vipākas tau vīryaṃ prabhāvas tāny apohati |
rasādisāmye yat karma viśiṣṭaṃ tat prabhāvajam |
madhukasya ca mṛdvīkā ghṛtaṃ kṣīrasya dīpanam |
iti sāmānyataḥ karma dravyādīnāṃ punaś ca tat ||
svādur guruś ca godhūmo vātajid vātakṛd yavaḥ ||
uṣṇā matsyāḥ payaḥ śītaṃ kaṭuḥ siṃho na śūkaraḥ ||
teṣāṃ vidyād rasaṃ svāduṃ yo vaktram anulimpati |
tikto viśadayaty āsyaṃ rasanaṃ pratihanti ca ||
rasānām iti rūpāṇi karmāṇi madhuro rasaḥ ||
so .tyabhyastas tanoḥ kuryāc chaithilyaṃ timiraṃ bhramam ||

tiktaḥ kaṣāyo madhuras tadvad eva ca śītalāḥ |
tiktaḥ kaṭuḥ kaṣāyaś ca rūkṣā baddhamalās tathā ||
paṭoḥ kaṣāyas tasmāc ca madhuraḥ paramaṃ guruḥ ||
laghur amlaḥ kaṭus tasmāt tasmād api ca tiktakaḥ |
ekaikahīnās tān pañcadaśa yānti rasā dvike ||
trike svādur daśāmlaḥ ṣaṭ trīn paṭus tikta ekakam |
catuṣkeṣu daśa svāduś caturo .mlaḥ paṭuḥ sakṛt ||
pañcakeṣv ekam evāmlo madhuraḥ pañca sevate |
dravyam ekaṃ ṣaḍāsvādam asaṃyuktāś ca ṣaḍ rasāḥ ||
ṣaṭ pañcakā ṣaṭ ca pṛthag rasāḥ syuś caturdvikau pañcadaśaprakārau |
bhedās trikā viṃśatir ekam eva dravyaṃ ṣaḍāsvādam iti triṣaṣṭiḥ ||
doṣadhātumalā mūlaṃ sadā dehasya taṃ calaḥ |
samyaggatyā ca dhātūnām akṣāṇāṃ pāṭavena ca |
garbhotpādaś ca dhātūnāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ karma kramāt smṛtam ||
kaṇṭhādiṣv adhimāṃsaṃ ca tadvan medas tathā śramam ||
asthy adhyasthy adhidantāṃś ca majjā netrāṅgagauravam ||
parvasu sthūlamūlāni kuryāt kṛcchrāṇy arūṃṣi ca |
kukṣāv ādhmānam āṭopaṃ gauravaṃ vedanāṃ śakṛt |
pitte mando .nalaḥ śītaṃ prabhāhāniḥ kaphe bhramaḥ |
rase raukṣyaṃ śramaḥ śoṣo glāniḥ śabdāsahiṣṇutā |
medasi svapanaṃ kaṭyāḥ plīhno vṛddhiḥ kṛśāṅgatā ||
śukre cirāt prasicyeta śukraṃ śoṇitam eva vā |
purīṣe vāyur antrāṇi saśabdo veṣṭayann iva |
kukṣau bhramati yāty ūrdhvaṃ hṛtpārśve pīḍayan bhṛśam ||
mūtre .lpaṃ mūtrayet kṛcchrād vivarṇaṃ sāsram eva vā |
doṣādīnāṃ yathāsvaṃ ca vidyād vṛddhikṣayau bhiṣak |
vṛddhiṃ malānāṃ saṅgāc ca kṣayaṃ cātivisargataḥ |
malocitatvād dehasya kṣayo vṛddhes tu pīḍanaḥ ||
tatrāsthni sthito vāyuḥ pittaṃ tu svedaraktayoḥ |
asthimārutayor naivaṃ prāyo vṛddhir hi tarpaṇāt ||
vāyor anyatra tajjāṃs tu tair evotkramayojitaiḥ ||
pūrvo dhātuḥ paraṃ kuryād vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇaś ca tadvidham |
doṣā duṣṭā rasair dhātūn dūṣayanty ubhaye malān ||
adho dve sapta śirasi khāni svedavahāni ca |
malā malāyanāni syur yathāsvaṃ teṣv ato gadāḥ ||
ojas tu tejo dhātūnāṃ śukrāntānāṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
yannāśe niyataṃ nāśo yasmiṃs tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhati ||
duśchāyo durmanā rūkṣo bhavet kṣāmaś ca tatkṣaye ||
yad annaṃ dveṣṭi yad api prārthayetāvirodhi tu |
tat tat tyajan samaśnaṃś ca tau tau vṛddhikṣayau jayet ||
vṛddhāḥ kṣīṇāś ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ lakṣayanty abudhās tu na ||
yathābalaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣā vṛddhā vitanvate |
rūpāṇi jahati kṣīṇāḥ samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate ||
ya eva dehasya samā vivṛddhyai ta eva doṣā viṣamā vadhāya |
yasmād atas te hitacaryayaiva kṣayād vivṛddher iva rakṣaṇīyāḥ ||
nābhir āmāśayaḥ svedo lasīkā rudhiraṃ rasaḥ |
dṛk sparśanaṃ ca pittasya nābhir atra viśeṣataḥ ||
medo ghrāṇaṃ ca jihvā ca kaphasya sutarām uraḥ ||
prāyaḥ sarvāḥ kriyās tasmin pratibaddhāḥ śarīriṇām ||
pacaty annaṃ vibhajate sārakiṭṭau pṛthak tathā ||
tatrastham eva pittānāṃ śeṣāṇām apy anugraham |
karoti baladānena pācakaṃ nāma tat smṛtam ||
dṛkstham ālocakaṃ tvaksthaṃ bhrājakaṃ bhrājanāt tvacaḥ ||
śleṣmā tu pañcadhoraḥsthaḥ sa trikasya svavīryataḥ |
kaphadhāmnāṃ ca śeṣāṇāṃ yat karoty avalambanam |
vyāpinām api jānīyāt karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak |
uṣṇena yuktā rūkṣādyā vāyoḥ kurvanti saṃcayam ||
śītena kopam uṣṇena śamaṃ snigdhādayo guṇāḥ |
śītena yuktās tīkṣṇādyāś cayaṃ pittasya kurvate ||
śītena yuktāḥ snigdhādyāḥ kurvate śleṣmaṇaś cayam ||
uṣṇena kopaṃ tenaiva guṇā rūkṣādayaḥ śamam |
cayo vṛddhiḥ svadhāmny eva pradveṣo vṛddhihetuṣu ||
tadvidhas tadvidhe dehe kālasyauṣṇyān na kupyati |
pittaṃ yāti cayaṃ kopaṃ na tu kālasya śaityataḥ |
tulye .pi kāle dehe ca skannatvān na prakupyati |
cayādīn yānti sadyo .pi doṣāḥ kāle .pi vā na tu |
śakyaṃ naikaikaśo vaktum ataḥ sāmānyam ucyate ||
doṣā eva hi sarveṣāṃ rogāṇām ekakāraṇam |
yathā pakṣī paripatan sarvataḥ sarvam apy ahaḥ ||
chāyām atyeti nātmīyāṃ yathā vā kṛtsnam apy adaḥ |
vikārajātaṃ trīn doṣān teṣāṃ kope tu kāraṇam ||
arthair asātmyaiḥ saṃyogaḥ kālaḥ karma ca duṣkṛtam |
yad akṣṇā vīkṣyate rūpaṃ mithyāyogaḥ sa dāruṇaḥ ||
vidyāt kālas tu śītoṣṇavarṣābhedāt tridhā mataḥ ||
karma prāṇātipātādi daśadhā yac ca ninditam ||
mithyāyogaḥ samasto .sāv iha vāmutra vā kṛtam |
nidānam etad doṣāṇāṃ kupitās tena naikadhā ||
śākhā raktādayas tvak ca bāhyarogāyanaṃ hi tat ||
svedaḥ kledaḥ srutiḥ kothaḥ sadanaṃ mūrchanaṃ madaḥ |
tatsaṃkarād bhavaty anyo vyādhir evaṃ tridhā smṛtaḥ ||
viparītās tato .nye tu vidyād evaṃ malān api ||
paścāc cikitset tūrṇaṃ vā balavantam upadravam |
na hi sarvavikārāṇāṃ nāmato .sti dhruvā sthitiḥ ||
column5: na hi sarvavikārāṇāṃ nāmato .sti dhruvā sthitiḥ ||

column3: sthānāntarāṇi ca prāpya vikārān kurute bahūn ||
buddhvā hetuviśeṣāṃś ca śīghraṃ kuryād upakramam ||
dūṣyaṃ deśaṃ balaṃ kālam analaṃ prakṛtiṃ vayaḥ |
sattvaṃ sātmyaṃ tathāhāram avasthāś ca pṛthagvidhāḥ ||
yo vartate cikitsāyāṃ na sa skhalati jātucit ||
guruṃ laghum iti vyādhiṃ kalpayaṃs tu bhiṣagbruvaḥ |
kṣiṇuyān na malān eva kevalaṃ vapur asyati ||
tathā yuñjīta bhaiṣajyam ārogyāya yathā dhruvam ||
pṛthak trīn viddhi saṃsargas tridhā tatra tu tān nava ||
trīn eva samayā vṛddhyā ṣaḍ ekasyātiśāyane |
pañcaviṃśatim ity evaṃ vṛddhaiḥ kṣīṇaiś ca tāvataḥ ||
ekaikavṛddhisamatākṣayaiḥ ṣaṭ te punaś ca ṣaṭ |
saṃsargād rasarudhirādibhis tathaiṣāṃ doṣāṃs tu kṣayasamatāvivṛddhibhedaiḥ |
ānantyaṃ taratamayogataś ca yātān jānīyād avahitamānaso yathāsvam ||
kaṇṭhe guṇānāṃ hārāṇāṃ maṇīnām urasā dhṛtiḥ ||
pradoṣaś candramāḥ saudhaṃ hāri gītaṃ himo .nilaḥ ||
saumyā bhāvāḥ payaḥ sarpir virekaś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
viśeṣād vamanaṃ yūṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ medoghnam auṣadham |
upakramaḥ pṛthag doṣān yo .yam uddiśya kīrtitaḥ |
caya eva jayed doṣaṃ kupitaṃ tv avirodhayan |
prayogaḥ śamayed vyādhim ekaṃ yo .nyam udīrayet |
nāsau viśuddhaḥ śuddhas tu śamayed yo na kopayet ||
vṛddhyābhiṣyandanāt pākāt koṣṭhaṃ vāyoś ca nigrahāt ||
te kālādibalaṃ labdhvā kupyanty anyāśrayeṣv api ||
āgantuṃ śamayed doṣaṃ sthāninaṃ pratikṛtya vā |
prāyas tiryaggatā doṣāḥ kleśayanty āturāṃś ciram ||
kuryān na teṣu tvarayā dehāgnibalavit kriyām |
śamayet tān prayogeṇa sukhaṃ vā koṣṭham ānayet ||
āmena tena saṃpṛktā doṣā dūṣyāś ca dūṣitāḥ |
column5: āmena tena saṃpṛktā doṣā dūṣyāśca dūṣitāḥ |

column3: sāmā ity upadiśyante ye ca rogās tadudbhavāḥ ||
līnān dhātuṣv anutkliṣṭān phalād āmād rasān iva ||
āśrayasya hi nāśāya te syur durnirharatvataḥ |
pācanair dīpanaiḥ snehais tān svedaiś ca pariṣkṛtān ||
hanty āśu yuktaṃ vaktreṇa dravyam āmāśayān malān ||
utkliṣṭān adha ūrdhvaṃ vā na cāmān vahataḥ svayam ||
dhārayed auṣadhair doṣān vidhṛtās te hi rogadāḥ |
pravṛttān prāg ato doṣān upekṣeta hitāśinaḥ ||
vibaddhān pācanais tais taiḥ pācayen nirhareta vā |
śrāvaṇe kārttike caitre māsi sādhāraṇe kramāt ||
saṃdhau sādhāraṇe teṣāṃ duṣṭān doṣān viśodhayet |
prayojayet kriyāṃ prāptāṃ kriyākālaṃ na hāpayet ||
grāse grāse muhuḥ sānnaṃ sāmudgaṃ niśi cauṣadham ||
yojyaṃ sabhojyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhojyaiś citrair arocake ||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ yad bṛhattvāya laṅghanaṃ lāghavāya yat ||
dehasya bhavataḥ prāyo bhaumāpyam itarac ca te |
snehanaṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ karma svedanaṃ stambhanaṃ ca yat ||
bhūtānāṃ tad api dvaidhyād dvitayaṃ nātivartate |
śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ ceti dvidhā tatrāpi laṅghanam ||
yad īrayed bahir doṣān pañcadhā śodhanaṃ ca tat |
na śodhayati yad doṣān samān nodīrayaty api |
samīkaroti viṣamān śamanaṃ tac ca saptadhā ||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ śamanaṃ tv eva vāyoḥ pittānilasya ca ||
sthūlāṃś ca laṅghayen nityaṃ śiśire tv aparān api ||
kṣuttṛṣṇānigrahair doṣais tv ārtān madhyabalair dṛḍhān ||
na bṛṃhayel laṅghanīyān bṛṃhyāṃs tu mṛdu laṅghayet ||
rūpaṃ tair eva ca jñeyam atibṛṃhitalaṅghite ||
madhunā triphalāṃ lihyād guḍūcīm abhayāṃ ghanam ||
niśe bṛhatyau hapuṣā pāṭhā mūlaṃ ca kembukāt |
eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca sadṛśāṃśakam ||
saktubhiḥ ṣoḍaśaguṇair yuktaṃ pītaṃ nihanti tat |
atisthaulyādikān sarvān rogān anyāṃś ca tadvidhān ||
kārśyam eva varaṃ sthaulyān na hi sthūlasya bheṣajam ||
svapnaprasaṅgāc ca kṛśo varāha iva puṣyati ||
na hi māṃsasamaṃ kiṃcid anyad dehabṛhattvakṛt |
guru cātarpaṇaṃ sthūle viparītaṃ hitaṃ kṛśe |
upakramā na te dvitvād bhinnā api gadā iva ||
śamyākakampillakahemadugdhā dugdhaṃ ca mūtraṃ ca virecanāni ||
yavamiśikṛtavedhanaṃ kulatthā madhu lavaṇaṃ trivṛtā nirūhaṇāni ||
vellāpāmārgavyoṣadārvīsurālā bījaṃ śairīṣaṃ bārhataṃ śaigravaṃ ca |
sāro mādhūkaḥ saindhavaṃ tārkṣyaśailaṃ truṭyau pṛthvīkā śodhayanty uttamāṅgam ||
vāyuṃ vīratarādiś ca vidāryādiś ca nāśayet ||
nyagrodhādiḥ padmakādiḥ sthire dve padmaṃ vanyaṃ sārivādiś ca pittam ||
kaṇḍūkarī jīvanahrasvasaṃjñe dve pañcake gopasutā tripādī ||
padmakapuṇḍrau vṛddhitugarddhyaḥ śṛṅgy amṛtā daśa jīvanasaṃjñāḥ |
parūṣakaṃ varā drākṣā kaṭphalaṃ katakāt phalam |
nihanti kaphapittakuṣṭhajvarān viṣaṃ vamim arocakaṃ kāmalām ||
column5: nihanti kaphapittakuṣṭhajvarān viṣaṃ vamim arocakaṃ kāmalām ||

column3: arkālarkau nāgadantī viśalyā bhārgī rāsnā vṛścikālī prakīryā |
pratyakpuṣpī pītatailodakīryā śvetāyugmaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vṛkṣaḥ ||
column5: pratyakpuṣpī pītatailodakīryā śvetāyugmaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vṛkṣaḥ ||

column3: saṃdhānīyau hitau pitte vraṇānām api ropaṇau ||
column5: sandhānīyau hitau pitte vraṇānām api ropaṇau ||
column9: saṃdhānīyau hitau pitte vraṇānāṃ cāpi ropaṇau ||

column3: kuṣṭhaṃ truṭī haimavatī ca yonistanyāmayaghnā malapācanāś ca ||
śuktir vyāghranakho .marāhvam aguruḥ śrīvāsakaḥ kuṅkumaṃ caṇḍāgugguludevadhūpakhapurāḥ puṃnāganāgāhvayam |
śyāmādyo hanti gulmaṃ viṣamarucikaphau hṛdrujaṃ mūtrakṛcchram ||
trayastriṃśad iti proktā vargās teṣu tv alābhataḥ |
yuñjyāt tadvidham anyac ca dravyaṃ jahyād ayaugikam ||
pāne nasye .nvāsane .ntar bahir vā lepābhyaṅgair ghnanti rogān sukṛcchrān ||

column589: atirasā snehavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte atheti ||

column3: sarpir majjā vasā tailaṃ sneheṣu pravaraṃ matam |
ghṛtāt tailaṃ guru vasā tailān majjā tato .pi ca |
dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caturbhis tair yamakas trivṛto mahān ||
apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye bastau virecane |
tailaṃ prāvṛṣi varṣānte sarpir anyau tu mādhave |
ṛtau sādhāraṇe snehaḥ śasto .hni vimale ravau ||
tailaṃ tvarāyāṃ śīte .pi gharme .pi ca ghṛtaṃ niśi |
niśy eva pitte pavane saṃsarge pittavaty api ||
niśyanyathā vātakaphād rogāḥ syuḥ pittato divā |
hyastane jīrṇa evānne sneho.cchaḥ śuddhaye bahuḥ |
bṛṃhaṇo rasamadyādyaiḥ sabhakto.lpaḥ hitaḥ sa ca |
pittena padmakādyais tu śālvaṇākhyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
baddhaṃ rātrau divā muñcen muñced rātrau divākṛtam ||
daśamūlena ca pṛthak sahitair vā yathāmalam |
kumbhīr galantīr nāḍīr vā pūrayitvā rujārditam |
tair eva vā dravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sarvāṅgage .nile |
kaphārto rūkṣaṇaṃ rūkṣo rūkṣaḥ snigdhaṃ kaphānile |
alpaṃ vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ svalpaṃ dṛṅmuṣkahṛdaye na vā ||
syāc chanair mṛditaḥ snātas tataḥ snehavidhiṃ bhajet ||
svedātiyogāc chardiś ca tatra stambhanam auṣadham |
svedanaṃ guru tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ prāyaḥ stambhanam anyathā |
prāyas tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ ca madhuraṃ ca samāsataḥ ||
garbhiṇīṃ puṣpitāṃ sūtāṃ mṛdu cātyayike gade ||
svedo hitas tv anāgneyo vāte medaḥkaphāvṛte |
snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhāsthisaṃsthāḥ |
doṣāḥ svedais te dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyak śuddhibhir nirhriyante ||
kaphe vidadhyād vamanaṃ saṃyoge vā kapholbaṇe |
tadvad virecanaṃ pitte viśeṣeṇa tu vāmayet ||
dhūmāntaiḥ karmabhir varjyāḥ sarvair eva tv ajīrṇinaḥ ||
vāmyaś ca kuṣṭhamehādyā na tu recyā navajvarī ||
ākaṇṭhaṃ pāyitān madyaṃ kṣīram ikṣurasaṃ rasam ||
ṛṣayaḥ sauṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāś ca pāntu vaḥ ||
column5: ṛṣayaḥ sauṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāś ca pāntu te |

column3: ubhe pārśve lalāṭaṃ ca vamataś cāsya dhārayet ||
prapīḍayet tathā nābhiṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pratilomataḥ |
pittasya darśanaṃ yāvac chedo vā śleṣmaṇo bhavet ||
vamet punaḥ punas tatra vegānām apravartanam ||
vamitaṃ kṣāmatā dāhaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣas tamo bhramaḥ |
tataḥ sāyaṃ prabhāte vā kṣudvān snātaḥ sukhāmbunā |
peyāṃ vilepīm akṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīn ubhayaṃ tathaikam |
yathāṇur agnis tṛṇagomayādyaiḥ saṃdhukṣyamāṇo bhavati krameṇa |
mahān sthiraḥ sarvapacas tathaiva śuddhasya peyādibhir antarāgniḥ ||
jaghanyamadhyapravare tu vegāś catvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍ aṣṭau |
daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthas tathā syād dvicaturguṇaś ca ||
pittāvasānaṃ vamanaṃ virekād ardhaṃ kaphāntaṃ ca virekam āhuḥ |
dvitrān saviṭkān apanīya vegān meyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam ||
śleṣmakāle gate jñātvā koṣṭhaṃ samyag virecayet ||
utthāne .lpe dine tasmin bhuktvānyedyuḥ punaḥ pibet ||
yaugikaṃ samyag ālocya smaran pūrvam atikramam |
yāty agnir mandatāṃ tasmāt kramaṃ peyādim ācaret |
peyāṃ na pāyayet teṣāṃ tarpaṇādikramo hitaḥ |
durbalo bahudoṣaś ca doṣapākena yaḥ svayam ||
durbalaḥ śodhitaḥ pūrvam alpadoṣaḥ kṛśo naraḥ ||
aparijñātakoṣṭhaś ca piben mṛdv alpam auṣadham |
hared bahūṃś calān doṣān alpān alpān punaḥ punaḥ |
durbalasya mṛdudravyair alpān saṃśamayet tu tān ||
kleśayanti ciraṃ te hi hanyur vainam anirhṛtāḥ |
tebhyo vastiṃ purā dadyāt tataḥ snigdhaṃ virecanam ||
śakṛn nirhṛtya vā kiṃcit tīkṣṇābhiḥ phalavartibhiḥ |
pravṛttaṃ hi malaṃ snigdho vireko nirharet sukham ||
sarvān snehavirekaiś ca rūkṣais tu snehabhāvitān |
snehasvedau prayuñjīta sneham ante balāya ca |
malo hi dehād utkleśya hriyate vāsaso yathā ||
snehasvedāv anabhyasya kuryāt saṃśodhanaṃ tu yaḥ ||
buddhiprasādaṃ balam indriyāṇāṃ dhātusthiratvaṃ jvalanasya dīptim |
cirāc ca pākaṃ vayasaḥ karoti saṃśodhanaṃ samyagupāsyamānam ||
vātolbaṇeṣu doṣeṣu vāte vā vastir iṣyate |
upakramāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ so .graṇīs trividhas tu saḥ ||
anāsthāpyās tv atisnigdhaḥ kṣatorasko bhṛśaṃ kṛśaḥ |
kuṣṭhī ca madhumehī ca māsān sapta ca garbhiṇī |
rūkṣāḥ kevalavātārtā nānuvāsyās ta eva ca |
saptame sapta tāny aṣṭau dvādaśe ṣoḍaśe nava |
dvādaśaiva paraṃ viṃśād vīkṣya varṣāntareṣu ca ||
tryaṅgulaṃ paramaṃ chidraṃ mūle .gre vahate tu yat ||
mudgaṃ māṣaṃ kalāyaṃ ca klinnaṃ karkandhukaṃ kramāt |
karṇikādvitayaṃ netre kuryāt tatra ca yojayet ||
prakuñcavṛddhiḥ pratyabdaṃ yāvat ṣaṭ prasṛtās tataḥ ||
āsaptater idaṃ mānaṃ daśaiva prasṛtāḥ param ||
āsthāpyaṃ snehitaṃ svinnaṃ śuddhaṃ labdhabalaṃ punaḥ ||
śīte vasante ca divā rātrau kecit tato .nyadā ||
saṃkocya dakṣiṇaṃ sakthi prasārya ca tato .param |
athāsya netraṃ praṇayet snigdhe snigdhamukhaṃ gude ||
ucchvāsya vaster vadane baddhe hastam akampayan |
nātivegaṃ na vā mandaṃ sakṛd eva prapīḍayet |
sāvaśeṣaṃ ca kurvīta vāyuḥ śeṣe hi tiṣṭhati ||
tatpārṣṇibhyāṃ tathā śayyāṃ pādataś ca trir utkṣipet ||
vedanārtam iti sneho na hi śīghraṃ nivartate |
dīptāgniṃ tv āgatasnehaṃ sāyāhne bhojayel laghu |
nivṛttikālaḥ paramas trayo yāmas tataḥ param ||
tīkṣṇair vā vastibhiḥ kuryād yatnaṃ snehanivṛttaye ||
upekṣetaiva hi tato .dhyuṣitaś ca niśāṃ pibet ||
prātar nāgaradhānyāmbhaḥ koṣṇaṃ kevalam eva vā |
anvāsayet tṛtīye .hni pañcame vā punaś ca tam ||
nirūhaṃ śodhanaṃ yuñjyād asnigdhe snehanaṃ tanoḥ ||
pañcame .tha tṛtīye vā divase sādhake śubhe |
vastiṃ prakalpayed vaidyas tadvidyair bahubhiḥ saha |
tataḥ kvāthāc caturthāṃśaṃ snehaṃ vāte prakalpayet |
pitte svasthe ca ṣaṣṭhāṃśam aṣṭamāṃśaṃ kaphe .dhike ||
sarvatra cāṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ kalkād bhavati vā yathā |
madhupaṭvādiśeṣaṃ ca yuktyā sarvaṃ tad ekataḥ |
nātisnigdhaṃ na vā rūkṣaṃ nātitīkṣṇaṃ na vā mṛdu ||
lavaṇaṃ tadvad amlaṃ ca paṭhanty anye tu tadvidaḥ ||
mākṣikaṃ lavaṇaṃ snehaṃ kalkaṃ kvātham iti kramāt ||
uttāno dattamātre tu nirūhe tanmanā bhavet ||
āgatau paramaḥ kālo muhūrto mṛtyave param ||
svayam eva nivṛtte tu dvitīyo vastir iṣyate ||
viriktavac ca yogādīn vidyād yoge tu bhojayet ||
vikārā ye nirūḍhasya bhavanti pracalair malaiḥ ||
kiñcitkālaṃ sthito yaś ca sapurīṣo nivartate ||
ekaṃ trīn vā balāse tu snehavastīn prakalpayet ||
pañca vā sapta vā pitte navaikādaśa vānile |
punas tato .py ayugmāṃs tu punar āsthāpanaṃ tataḥ ||
trayas te saṃnipāte .pi doṣān ghnanti yataḥ kramāt ||
tribhyaḥ paraṃ vastim ato necchanty anye cikitsakāḥ |
na hi doṣaś caturtho .sti punar dīyeta yaṃ prati ||
tridhaiva kalpayed vastim ity anye .pi pracakṣate ||
prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte dvādaśāsthāpanāni ca |
kālaḥ pañcadaśaiko .tra prāk sneho .nte trayas tathā |
trayo nirūhāḥ snehāś ca snehāv ādyantayor ubhau |
tasmān nirūḍhaḥ snehyaḥ syān nirūhyaś cānuvāsitaḥ ||
mātrāvastiḥ smṛtaḥ snehaḥ śīlanīyaḥ sadā ca saḥ |
tasya vastir mṛdulaghur mātrā śuktir vikalpya vā |
hṛṣṭe meḍhre sthite carjau śanaiḥ srotoviśuddhaye ||
sūkṣmāṃ śalākāṃ praṇayet tayā śuddhe anusevani |
āmehanāntaṃ netraṃ ca niṣkampaṃ gudavat tataḥ ||
vastīn anena vidhinā dadyāt trīṃś caturo .pi vā ||
strīṇām ārtavakāle tu yonir gṛhṇāty apāvṛteḥ ||
vidadhīta tadā tasmād anṛtāv api cātyaye |
prakuñco madhyamā mātrā bālānāṃ śuktir eva tu ||
vastīṃs trirātram evaṃ ca snehamātrāṃ vivardhayan |
tryaham eva ca viśramya praṇidadhyāt punas tryaham ||
pakṣād vireko vamite tataḥ pakṣān nirūhaṇam |
yathā kusumbhādiyutāt toyād rāgaṃ haret paṭaḥ |
tathā dravīkṛtād dehād vastir nirharate malān ||
śākhāgatāḥ koṣṭhagatāś ca rogā marmordhvasarvāvayavāṅgajāś ca |
ye santi teṣāṃ na tu kaścid anyo vāyoḥ paraṃ janmani hetur asti ||
tasyātivṛddhasya śamāya nānyad vaster vinā bheṣajam asti kiñcit ||
tasmāc cikitsārdha iti pradiṣṭaḥ kṛtsnā cikitsāpi ca vastir ekaiḥ |
nāsā hi śiraso dvāraṃ tena tad vyāpya hanti tān ||
virecanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca śamanaṃ ca tridhāpi tat |
yathāsvaṃ yaugikaiḥ snehair yathāsvaṃ ca prasādhitaiḥ |
śamanaṃ yojayet pūrvaiḥ kṣīreṇa salilena vā ||
marśaś ca pratimarśaś ca dvidhā sneho .tra mātrayā |
kalkādyair avapīḍas tu sa tīkṣṇair mūrdharecanaḥ ||
sa hi bhūritaraṃ doṣaṃ cūrṇatvād apakarṣati |
yāvat patatyasau bindur daśāṣṭau ṣaṭ krameṇa te |
marśasyotkṛṣṭamadhyonā mātrās tā eva ca kramāt ||
bindudvayonāḥ kalkāder yojayen na tu nāvanam |
prātaḥ śleṣmaṇi madhyāhne pitte sāyaṃ niśoścale |
śīte madhyaṃdine grīṣme sāyaṃ varṣāsu sātape |
manyāstambhe svarabhraṃśe sāyaṃ prātar dine dine |
ekāhāntaram anyatra saptāhaṃ ca tad ācaret ||
śanair ucchidya niṣṭhīvet pārśvayor ubhayos tataḥ ||
ā bheṣajakṣayād evaṃ dvis trir vā nasyam ācaret |
nasyānte vākśataṃ tiṣṭhed uttāno dhārayet tataḥ ||
pañcasu srotasāṃ śuddhiḥ klamanāśas triṣu kramāt ||
marśavacca guṇān kuryāt sa hi nityopasevanāt ||
na cātra yantraṇā nāpi vyāpadbhyo marśavad bhayam |
tailam eva ca nasyārthe nityābhyāsena śasyate ||
marśe ca pratimarśe ca viśeṣo na bhaved yadi |
ko marśaṃ saparīhāraṃ sāpadaṃ ca bhajet tataḥ ||
dhāvanyau surabhiṃ sthire kṛmiharaṃ pattraṃ truṭīṃ reṇukām |
kiñjalkaṃ kamalād balāṃ śataguṇe divye .mbhasi kvāthayet ||
tailād rasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ pariśeṣya tena tailaṃ paceta salilena daśaiva vārān |
pāke kṣipecca daśame samam ājadugdhaṃ nasyaṃ mahāguṇam uśantyaṇutailam etat ||
ucchedāya ca jātānāṃ pibed dhūmaṃ sadātmavān ||
snigdho madhyaḥ sa tīkṣṇaśca vāte vātakaphe kaphe |
dhūmo .kāle .tipīto vā tatra śīto vidhir hitaḥ |
hāsasya dantakāṣṭhasya dhūmam ante piben mṛdum |
pidhāya chidram ekaikaṃ dhūmaṃ nāsikayā pibet |
ākṣepamokṣaiḥ pātavyo dhūmas tu tris tribhis tribhiḥ |
ahnaḥ pibet sakṛt snigdhaṃ dvir madhyaṃ śodhanaṃ param ||
triścatur vā mṛdau tatra dravyāṇyaguru guggulu |
śallakī kuṅkumaṃ māṣā yavāḥ kundurukas tilāḥ |
snehaḥ phalānāṃ sārāṇāṃ medo majjā vasā ghṛtam ||
kāsaḥ śvāsaḥ pīnaso visvaratvaṃ pūtir gandhaḥ pāṇḍutā keśadoṣaḥ |
karṇāsyākṣisrāvakaṇḍvartijāḍyaṃ tandrā hidhmā dhūmapaṃ na spṛśanti ||
śuktaṃ madyaṃ raso mūtraṃ dhānyāmlaṃ ca yathāyatham |
kalkair yuktaṃ vipakvaṃ vā yathāsparśaṃ prayojayet ||
viṣe kṣārāgnidagdhe ca sarpir dhāryaṃ payo .thavā |
aśuṣkasya sthitis tasya śuṣko dūṣayati chavim |

siṃhīmūlaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇā dārvītvaṅ nistuṣā yavāḥ ||

tato yathāvyādhi śṛtaṃ snehaṃ koṣṇaṃ niṣecayet ||

column3: daśa dvādaśa vā bindūn dvyaṅgulād avasecayet ||
aṅgulī ca suvarṇotthā rūpyajā ca prasādane ||
gurau madhye laghau doṣe tāṃ krameṇa prayojayet ||
tīkṣṇasya dviguṇaṃ tasya mṛdunaś cūrṇitasya ca ||
dve śalāke tu tīkṣṇasya tisras taditarasya ca |
niśi svapne na madhyāhne mlāne noṣṇagabhastibhiḥ ||
prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca tacchāntyai vyabhre .rke .to .ñjayet sadā ||
vadantyanye tu na divā prayojyaṃ tīkṣṇam añjanam |
svapnena rātrau kālasya saumyatvena ca tarpitā |
śītasātmyā dṛg āgneyī sthiratāṃ labhate punaḥ ||
kāmam ahnyapi nātyuṣṇe tīkṣṇam akṣṇi prayojayet ||
aśmano janma lohasya tata eva ca tīkṣṇatā |
na rātrāvapi śīte .ti netre tīkṣṇāñjanaṃ hitam |
niṣpīḍanaṃ ca vartmabhyāṃ kṣālanaṃ vā samācaret ||
kaṇḍūjāḍye .ñjanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ dhūmaṃ vā yojayet punaḥ ||
dvyaṅguloccāṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yathāsvaṃ siddham āvapet |
ā pakṣmāgrād athonmeṣaṃ śanakais tasya kurvataḥ ||
dṛṣṭau ca kramaśo vyādhau śataṃ trīṇi ca pañca ca ||
śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca daśa manthe daśānile |
pitte ṣaṭ svasthavṛtte ca balāse pañca dhārayet ||
kṛtvāpāṅge tato dvāraṃ snehaṃ pātre nigālayet |
pibecca dhūmaṃ nekṣeta vyoma rūpaṃ ca bhāsvaram ||
itthaṃ pratidinaṃ vāyau pitte tvekāntaraṃ kaphe |
svasthe tu dvyantaraṃ dadyād ā tṛpter iti yojayet ||
snehapītā tanur iva klāntā dṛṣṭir hi sīdati |
sa vāte snehanaḥ śleṣmasahite lekhano hitaḥ ||
pacet pradīptair agnyābhaṃ pakvaṃ niṣpīḍya tadrasam |
netre tarpaṇavad yuñjyācchataṃ dve trīṇi dhārayet ||
dhūmapo .nte tayor eva yogās tatra ca tṛptivat ||
tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyānarhe na yojayet |
dṛṣṭiś ca naṣṭā vividhaṃ jagacca tamomayaṃ jāyata ekarūpam ||
āhartum abhyupāyo yastad yantraṃ yacca darśane ||
vikalpya kalpayet buddhyā yathāsthūlaṃ tu vakṣyate |
mukhair mukhāni yantrāṇāṃ kuryāt tatsaṃjñakāni ca |
nāḍīr evaṃvidhāś cānyā draṣṭuṃ śalyāni kārayet |
dvicchidraṃ darśane vyādher ekacchidraṃ tu karmaṇi ||
catuḥśalākam ākrāntaṃ mūle tad vikasen mukhe |
tadvad ghaṭī hitā gulmavilayonnamane ca sā |
nato .gre śaṅkunā tulyo garbhaśaṅkur iti smṛtaḥ |
kālaḥ pākaḥ karaḥ pādo bhayaṃ harṣaś ca tatkriyāḥ ||

yantreṣvataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣvadhikāri yacca ||
ṛjvagram unnate śophe gambhīre ca tad anyathā ||
kuśāṭā vadane srāvye dvyaṅgulaṃ syāt tayoḥ phalam |
tadvad antarmukhaṃ tasya phalam adhyardham aṅgulam ||
vrīhivaktraṃ prayojya ca tat sirodarayor vyadhe ||
vṛttā gūḍhadṛḍhāḥ pāśe tisraḥ sūcyo .tra sīvane |
pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāt tena hared asṛk |
chedyaṃ bhedyaṃ vyadho mantho graho dāhaśca tatkriyāḥ |
sīdantīḥ salilaṃ prāpya raktamattā iti tyajet ||
ādatte prathamaṃ haṃsaḥ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodakād iva ||
daṃśasya tode kaṇḍvāṃ vā mokṣayed vāmayecca tām |
rakṣan raktamadād bhūyaḥ saptāhaṃ tā na pātayet |
klamo .tiyogān mṛtyur vā durvānte stabdhatā madaḥ |
aśuddhaṃ calitaṃ sthānāt sthitaṃ raktaṃ vraṇāśaye |
vyamlībhavet paryuṣitaṃ tasmāt tat srāvayet punaḥ ||

column3: teṣu srāvayituṃ raktam udriktaṃ vyadhayet sirām ||
nāyantritāṃ sirāṃ vidhyen na tiryaṅ nāpyanutthitām ||
cipye ca dvyaṅgule vidhyed upari kṣipramarmaṇaḥ |
gāḍhaṃ karābhyām ā gulphaṃ caraṇe tasya copari |
baddhvā vidhyet sirām ittham anukteṣvapi kalpayet |
teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu tat tad yantram upāyavit ||
yavārdham asthnām upari sirāṃ vidhyan kuṭhārikām ||
samyagviddhā sraveddhārāṃ yantre mukte tu na sravet |
saśabdam atividdhā tu sraved duḥkhena dhāryate |
agre sravati duṣṭāsraṃ kusumbhād iva pītikā |
samyak srutvā svayaṃ tiṣṭhecchuddhaṃ tad iti nāharet ||
yantraṃ vimucya mūrchāyāṃ vījite vyajanaiḥ punaḥ |
srāvayen mūrchati punas tvaparedyus tryahe .pi vā ||
kaphāt snigdham asṛk pāṇḍu tantumat picchilaṃ ghanam |
aśuddhau balino .pyasraṃ na prasthāt srāvayet param |
atisrutau hi mṛtyuḥ syād dāruṇā vā calāmayāḥ ||
srute rakte śanair yantram apanīya himāmbunā ||
aśuddhaṃ srāvayed bhūyaḥ sāyam ahnyapare .pi vā ||
saśeṣam apyato dhāryaṃ na cātisrutim ācaret |
duṣṭaṃ raktam anudriktam evam eva prasādayet ||
rakte tvatiṣṭhati kṣipraṃ stambhanīm ācaret kriyām |
tām eva vā sirāṃ vidhyed vyadhāt tasmād anantaram |
unmārgagā yantranipīḍanena svasthānam āyānti punar na yāvat |
doṣāḥ praduṣṭā rudhiraṃ prapannās tāvaddhitāhāravihārabhāk syāt ||
nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ laghu dīpanīyaṃ rakte .panīte hitam annapānam |
tadā śarīraṃ hyanavasthitāsṛg agnir viśeṣād iti rakṣitavyaḥ ||
śopho bhavati māṃsasthe coṣaḥ śopho vivardhate ||
āśu śuṣyati lepo vā tatsthānaṃ śalyavad vadet ||
kṣobhād rāgādibhiḥ śalyaṃ lakṣayet tadvad eva ca ||
śīghraṃ nayet tatas tasya saṃrambhācchalyam ādiśet ||
sāmānyena saśalyaṃ tu kṣobhiṇyā kriyayā saruk ||
vṛttaṃ pṛthu catuṣkoṇaṃ tripuṭaṃ ca samāsataḥ |
pratilomam anuttuṇḍaṃ chedyaṃ pṛthumukhaṃ ca yat |
suṣirasthaṃ tu nalakaiḥ śeṣaṃ śeṣair yathāyatham ||
śastreṇa vā viśasyādau tato nirlohitaṃ vraṇam |
tataḥ sthānāntaraṃ prāptam āharet tad yathāyatham |
uddharecchalyam evaṃ vā śākhāyāṃ kalpayet taroḥ |
taireva cānayen mārgam amārgottuṇḍitaṃ tu yat |
mṛditvā karṇināṃ karṇaṃ nāḍyāsyena nigṛhya vā ||
bisenātte tataḥ śalye bisaṃ sūtraṃ samaṃ haret |
kṣiped adhomukhaṃ karṇaṃ hanyād vā cūṣayeta vā ||
śuktena vā sukhoṣṇena mṛte kledaharo vidhiḥ ||
śalye māṃsāvagāḍhe cet sa deśo na vidahyate ||
tais tairupāyair matimān śalyaṃ vidyāt tathāharet ||
tam evopacaret tasmād rakṣan pākaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
rāgo raktācca pākaḥ syād ato doṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ |
kaphajeṣu tu śopheṣu gambhīraṃ pākam etyasṛk ||
raktapākam iti brūyāt taṃ prājño muktasaṃśayaḥ |
pānapaṃ pāyayen madyaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yo vedanākṣamaḥ |
na mūrchatyannasaṃyogān mattaḥ śastraṃ na budhyate ||
yato gatāṃ gatiṃ vidyād utsaṅgo yatra yatra ca |
column5: yato yato gatiṃ vidyād utsaṅgo yatra yatra ca |

column3: tatra tatra vraṇaṃ kuryāt suvibhaktaṃ nirāśayam ||
āyataṃ ca viśālaṃ ca yathā doṣo na tiṣṭhati |
digdhāṃ vartiṃ tato dadyāt tairevācchādayecca tām |
pārśve savye .pasavye vā nādhastān naiva copari ||
dhūpitā mṛdavaḥ ślakṣṇā nirvalīkā vraṇe hitāḥ ||
baliṃ copaharet tebhyaḥ sadā mūrdhnā ca dhārayet ||
vacāṃ chattrām aticchattrāṃ dūrvāṃ siddhārthakān api ||
saindhavaṃ dāḍimaṃ dhātrī ghṛtaṃ taptahimaṃ jalam |
bhuñjāno jāṅgalair māṃsaiḥ śīghraṃ vraṇam apohati |
aśitaṃ mātrayā kāle pathyaṃ yāti jarāṃ sukham ||
navaṃ dhānyaṃ tilān māṣān madyaṃ māṃsam ajāṅgalam |
yaccānyad api viṣṭambhi vidāhi guru śītalam |
na tuden na ca kaṇḍūyecceṣṭamānaśca pālayet |
tṛtīye .hni punaḥ kuryād vraṇakarma ca pūrvavat ||
snigdhāṃ rūkṣāṃ ślathāṃ gāḍhāṃ durnyastāṃ ca vikeśikām |
vraṇe na dadyāt kalkaṃ vā snehāt kledo vivardhate ||
vyamlaṃ tu pāṭitaṃ śophaṃ pācanaiḥ samupācaret |
saṃdhyasthi ca sthite rakte snāyvā sūtreṇa valkalaiḥ ||
sīvyen na dūre nāsanne gṛhṇan nālpaṃ na vā bahu |
vraṇo niḥśoṇitauṣṭho yaḥ kiṃcid evāvalikhya tam |
bandhanāni tu deśādīn vīkṣya yuñjīta teṣu ca |
bhaṅge ca yuñjyāt phalakaṃ carmavalkakuśādi ca |
svanāmānugatākārā bandhās tu daśa pañca ca ||
yamakaṃ maṇḍalākhyaṃ ca pañcāṅgī ceti yojayet |
khaṭvāṃ gaṇḍe hanau śaṅkhe vibandhaṃ pṛṣṭhakodare |
goṣphaṇaṃ saṃdhiṣu tathā yamakaṃ yamike vraṇe |
yo yatra suniviṣṭaḥ syāttaṃ teṣāṃ tatra buddhimān ||
samaṃ mehanamuṣke ca netre saṃdhiṣu ca ślatham |
gāḍham eva samasthāne bhṛśaṃ gāḍhaṃ tadāśaye |
śīte vasante .pi ca tau mokṣaṇīyau tryahāt tryahāt ||
sāyaṃ prātas tayor mokṣo grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate |
kṛcchreṇa śuddhiṃ rūḍhiṃ vā yāti rūḍho vivarṇatām ||
baddhas tu cūrṇito bhagno viśliṣṭaḥ pāṭito .pi vā |
samo mṛduraruk śīghraṃ vraṇaḥ śudhyati rohati |
pracchādyam auṣadhaṃ pattrair yathādoṣaṃ yathartu ca |
bandhanīyā na māṃspāke gudapāke ca dāruṇe ||
arakṣayā vraṇe yasmin makṣikā nikṣipet kṛmīn ||
pracchādya māṃsapeśyā vā vraṇaṃ tān āśu nirharet |
harṣaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ cāpi yāvad ā sthairyasaṃbhavāt |
ādareṇānuvartyo .yaṃ māsān ṣaṭ sapta vā vidhiḥ ||
utpadyamānāsu ca tāsu tāsu vārttāsu doṣādibalānusārī |
tais tairupāyaiḥ prayataścikitsed ālocayan vistaram uttaroktam ||
na tūbhayo .pi yoktavyaḥ pitte rakte cale .bale ||
tatas tilānāṃ kutalair dagdhvāgnau vigate pṛthak ||
gālayed ardhabhāreṇa mahatā vāsasā ca tat |
yāvat picchilaraktācchas tīkṣṇo jātas tadā ca tam ||
paritaḥ sutarāṃ cāto darvyā tam avaghaṭṭayet ||
sthāpyo .yaṃ madhyamaḥ kṣāro na tu piṣṭvā kṣipen mṛdau |
tālapattrī viḍaṃ ceti saptarātrāt paraṃ tu saḥ |
śikharī sukhanirvāpyo na viṣyandī na cātiruk ||
ācūṣann iva saṃrambhād gātram āpīḍayann iva ||
mātrā vidhāryaḥ pañcāśat tadvad arśasi karṇaje ||
yadi ca sthiramūlatvāt kṣāradagdhaṃ na śīryate |
viśeṣād atra seko .mlair lepo madhu ghṛtaṃ tilāḥ |
amlo hi śītaḥ sparśena kṣāras tenopasaṃhitaḥ |
rogān nihanyād acireṇa ghorān sa dhīmatā samyag anuprayuktaḥ ||
agniḥ kṣārād api śreṣṭhas taddagdhānām asaṃbhavāt |
caturdhā tat tu tucchena saha tucchasya lakṣaṇam |
durdagdhe śītam uṣṇaṃ ca yuñjyād ādau tato himam ||
snehadagdhe bhṛśataraṃ rūkṣaṃ tatra tu yojayet |
apramatto bhiṣak tasmāt tān samyag avacārayet ||
atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ ||
nendhanaṃ dṛśyate gacchat sattvo garbhāśayaṃ tathā ||
ata eva ca śukrasya bāhulyāj jāyate pumān |
raktasya strī tayoḥ sāmye klībaḥ śukrārtave punaḥ ||
māsi māsi rajaḥ strīṇāṃ rasajaṃ sravati tryaham |
vatsarād dvādaśād ūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam ||
column5: tad varṣād dvādaśād ūrdhvaṃ yāti pañcāśataḥ kṣayam ||

column3: śuddhe garbhāśaye mārge rakte śukre .nile hṛdi ||
vīryavantaṃ sutaṃ sūte tato nyūnābdayoḥ punaḥ |
rogyalpāyuradhanyo vā garbho bhavati naiva vā ||
kuryād vātādibhir duṣṭe svauṣadhaṃ kuṇape punaḥ ||
peyaṃ kuṇapapūyāsre candanaṃ vakṣyate tu yat |
guhyaroge ca tat sarvaṃ kāryaṃ sottaravastikam ||
śukraṃ śuklaṃ guru snigdhaṃ madhuraṃ bahalaṃ bahu |
padmaṃ saṃkocam āyāti dine .tīte yathā tathā ||
ṛtāvatīte yoniḥ sā śukraṃ nātaḥ pratīcchati |
īṣatkṛṣṇaṃ vigandhaṃ ca vāyur yonimukhān nudet |
parṇe śarāve haste vā bhuñjīta brahmacāriṇī |
icchantī bhartṛsadṛśaṃ putraṃ paśyet puraḥ patim |
ṛtus tu dvādaśa niśāḥ pūrvās tisro .tra ninditāḥ ||
ekādaśī ca yugmāsu syāt putro .nyāsu kanyakā |
avandhya evaṃ saṃyogaḥ syād apatyaṃ ca kāmataḥ ||
ārohet strī tu vāmena tasya dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ |
oṃ āhirasy āyurasi sarvataḥ pratiṣṭhāsi dhātā tvām |
dadhātu vidhātā tvāṃ dadhātu brahmavarcasā bhaveti |
brahmā bṛhaspatir viṣṇuḥ somaḥ sūryas tathāśvinau |
bhago .tha mitrāvaruṇau vīraṃ dadatu me sutam ||
column5: bhago.tha mitrāvaruṇā vīraṃ dadatu me sutam |

column3: uttānā tanmanā yoṣit tiṣṭhed aṅgaiḥ susaṃsthitaiḥ ||
tathā hi bījaṃ gṛhṇāti doṣaiḥ svasthānam āsthitaiḥ |
liṅgaṃ tu sadyogarbhāyā yonyā bījasya saṃgrahaḥ ||
uttānaśayanaṃ yacca striyo necchanti tat tyajet ||
tathā raktasrutiṃ śuddhiṃ vastim ā māsato .ṣṭamāt |
ebhir garbhaḥ sraved āmaḥ kukṣau śuṣyen mriyeta vā ||
pittalaiḥ khalatiḥ piṅgaḥ śvitrī pāṇḍuḥ kaphātmabhiḥ ||
puṃstrīklībāḥ kramāt tebhyas tatra vyaktasya lakṣaṇam |
mātṛjaṃ hyasya hṛdayaṃ mātuśca hṛdayena tat ||
mūrdhā dve sakthinī bāhū sarvasūkṣmāṅgajanma ca |
samam eva hi mūrdhādyair jñānaṃ ca sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ||
garbhasya nābhau mātuśca hṛdi nāḍī nibadhyate |
yayā sa puṣṭim āpnoti kedāra iva kulyayā ||
kaṇḍūṃ vidāhaṃ kurvanti garbhiṇyāḥ kikkisāni ca ||
siddham alpapaṭusnehaṃ laghu svādu ca bhojanam ||
tena tau mlānamuditau tatra jāto na jīvati |
varṣād vikārakārī syāt kukṣau vātena dhāritaḥ ||
tata eva picuṃ cāsyā yonau nityaṃ nidhāpayet |
niḥsnehāṅgī na navamān māsāt prabhṛti vāsayet |
unnate dakṣiṇe kukṣau garbhe ca parimaṇḍale ||
putraṃ sūte .nyathā kanyāṃ yā cecchati nṛsaṃgatim |
klībaṃ tatsaṃkare tatra madhyaṃ kukṣeḥ samunnatam |
yamau pārśvadvayonnāmāt kukṣau droṇyām iva sthite ||
prāk caiva navamān māsāt sā sūtigṛham āśrayet |
pāyayet saghṛtāṃ peyāṃ tanau bhūśayane sthitām |
atha saṃpīḍite garbhe yonim asyāḥ prasārayet |
mṛdupūrvaṃ pravāheta bāḍham ā prasavācca sā ||
kaṭīm ākoṭayet pārṣṇyā sphijau gāḍhaṃ nipīḍayet |
tālukaṇṭhaṃ spṛśed veṇyā mūrdhni dadyāt snuhīpayaḥ ||
tailaṃ siddhaṃ hitaṃ pāyau yonyāṃ vāpyanuvāsanam |
tatsaṅge hyanilo hetuḥ sā niryātyāśu tajjayāt ||
sūtikā kṣudvatī tailād ghṛtād vā mahatīṃ pibet |
vātaghnauṣadhatoyaṃ vā tathā vāyur na kupyati |
viśudhyati ca duṣṭāsraṃ dvitrirātram ayaṃ kramaḥ ||
snehāyogyā tu niḥsneham amum eva vidhiṃ bhajet |
saptarātrāt paraṃ cāsyai kramaśo bṛṃhaṇaṃ hitam ||
rasair vā jāṅgalaiḥ śuddhivarjaṃ cāsroktam ācaret |
garbhe nipatite tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ sāmarthyataḥ pibet ||
laghunā pañcamūlena rūkṣāṃ peyāṃ tataḥ pibet ||
vṛddhim aprāpnuvan garbhaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhati sasphuraḥ ||
upaviṣṭakam āhus taṃ vardhate tena nodaram |
vāte kruddhe kṛśaḥ śuṣyed garbho nāgodaraṃ tu tam |
udaraṃ vṛddham apyatra hīyate sphuraṇaṃ cirāt ||
bālabilvaṃ tilān māṣān saktūṃśca payasā pibet ||
samedyamāṃsaṃ madhu vā kaṭyabhyaṅgaṃ ca śīlayet |
harṣayet satataṃ cainām evaṃ garbhaḥ pravardhate ||
puṣṭo .nyathā varṣagaṇaiḥ kṛcchrāj jāyeta naiva vā |
yogyaiśca vastibhir hanyāt sagarbhāṃ sa hi garbhiṇīm |
guḍaṃ kiṇvaṃ salavaṇaṃ tathāntaḥ pūrayen muhuḥ |
mantrair yogair jarāyūktair mūḍhagarbho na cet patet |
hastena śakyaṃ tenaiva gātraṃ ca viṣamaṃ sthitam ||
pādena yonim ekena bhugno .nyena gudaṃ ca yaḥ ||
viṣkambhau nāma tau mūḍhau śastradāraṇam arhataḥ |
vidārya koṣṭham antrāṇi bahir vā saṃnirasya ca |
yad yad vāyuvaśād aṅgaṃ sajed garbhasya khaṇḍaśaḥ |
tat tacchittvāharet samyag rakṣen nārīṃ ca yatnataḥ ||
garbhasya hi gatiṃ citrāṃ karoti viguṇo .nilaḥ |
chindyād garbhaṃ na jīvantaṃ mātaraṃ sa hi mārayet |
evaṃ nirhṛtaśalyāṃ tu siñced uṣṇena vāriṇā ||
yonir mṛdur bhavet tena śūlaṃ cāsyāḥ praśāmyati ||
cūrṇaṃ snehena kalkaṃ vā kvāthaṃ vā pāyayet tataḥ ||
trirātram evaṃ saptāhaṃ sneham eva tataḥ pibet |
sāyaṃ pibed ariṣṭaṃ ca tathā sukṛtam āsavam ||
upadravāśca ye .nye syus tān yathāsvam upācaret ||
payo vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ daśāhaṃ bhojane hitam |
column5: payo vātaharaiḥ siddhaṃ daśāhaṃ bhojane hitam ||

column3: ūrdhvaṃ caturbhyo māsebhyaḥ sā krameṇa sukhāni ca ||
madhukaṃ śākabījaṃ ca payasyā suradāru ca |
column5: madhukaṃ śākabījaṃ ca payasyā suradāru ca |

column3: anantā śārivā rāsnā padmā ca madhuyaṣṭikā ||
column5: anantā sārivā rāsnā padmā madhukam eva ca ||

column5: śṛṅgāṭakaṃ bisaṃ drākṣā kaśeru madhukaṃ sitā |

column3: kramāt saptasu māseṣu garbhe sravati yojayet |
mūlaiḥ śṛtaṃ prayuñjīta kṣīraṃ māse tathāṣṭame |
yojayed daśame māsi siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ payasyayā |
avasthitaṃ lohitam aṅganāyā vātena garbhaṃ bruvate .nabhijñāḥ |
garbhākṛtitvāt kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇaiḥ srute punaḥ kevala eva rakte ||
garbhaṃ jaḍā bhūtahṛtaṃ vadanti mūrter na dṛṣṭaṃ haraṇaṃ yatas taiḥ |
ojo.śanatvād athavāvyavasthair bhūtair upekṣyeta na garbhamātā ||
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaḥ kramād guṇāḥ |
column5: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ |

column3: tatra khāt khāni dehe .smin śrotraṃ śabdo viviktatā |
caitanaṃ cittam akṣāṇi nānāyoniṣu janma ca ||
sātmyajaṃ tv āyur ārogyam anālasyaṃ prabhā balam |
rasajaṃ vapuṣo janma vṛttir vṛddhir alolatā ||
iti bhūtamayo dehas tatra sapta tvaco .sṛjaḥ ||
tāḥ sapta sapta cādhārā raktasyādyaḥ kramāt pare ||
koṣṭhāṅgāni sthitāny eṣu hṛdayaṃ kloma phupphusam |
kaṇṭho .sraṃ hṛdayaṃ nābhir vastiḥ śukraujasī gudam ||
jālāni kaṇḍarāś cāṅge pṛthak ṣoḍaśa nirdiśet |
asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭiś ca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha |
dhanvantaris tu trīṇy āha saṃdhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam ||
snāvnāṃ navaśatī pañca puṃsāṃ peśīśatāni tu ||
daśa mūlasirā hṛtsthās tāḥ sarvaṃ sarvato vapuḥ ||
rasātmakaṃ vahanty ojas tannibaddhaṃ hi ceṣṭitam |
bhidyante tās tataḥ saptaśatāny āsāṃ bhavanti tu |
tatraikaikaṃ ca śākhāyāṃ śataṃ tasmin na vedhayet ||
ṣoḍaśadviguṇāḥ śroṇyāṃ tāsāṃ dve dve tu vaṅkṣaṇe ||
dve dve kaṭīkataruṇe śastreṇāṣṭau spṛśen na tāḥ |
dve dve tatrordhvagāminyau na śastreṇa parāmṛśet ||
romarājīm ubhayato dve dve śastreṇa na spṛśet ||
catvāriṃśad urasy āsāṃ caturdaśa na vedhayet |
grīvāyāṃ pṛṣṭhavat tāsāṃ nīle manye kṛkāṭike ||
jihvāyāṃ hanuvat tāsām adho dve rasabodhane |
viṃśatir gandhavedinyau tāsām ekāṃ ca tālugām |
dve dve apāṅgayor dve ca tāsāṃ ṣaḍ iti varjayet |
tatraikāṃ dve tathāvartau catasraś ca kacāntagāḥ |
saptaivaṃ varjayet tāsāṃ karṇayoḥ ṣoḍaśātra tu ||
dve śabdabodhane śaṅkhau sirās tā eva cāśritāḥ |
dve śaṅkhasaṃdhige tāsāṃ mūrdhni dvādaśa tatra tu ||
saṃkīrṇā grathitāḥ kṣudrā vakrāḥ saṃdhiṣu cāśritāḥ ||
tāsāṃ śatānāṃ saptānāṃ pādo .sraṃ vahate pṛthak |
vātapittakaphair juṣṭaṃ śuddhaṃ caivaṃ sthitā malāḥ ||
tatra śyāvāruṇāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pūrṇariktāḥ kṣaṇāt sirāḥ ||
gauryaḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ śītāḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ liṅgasaṃkare |
tābhiś cordhvam adhas tiryag deho .yam anugṛhyate |
stanau raktapathaś ceti nārīṇām adhikaṃ trayam |
tāni duṣṭāni rogāya viśuddhāni sukhāya ca ||
āhāraś ca vihāraś ca yaḥ syād doṣaguṇaiḥ samaḥ |
dhātubhir viguṇo yaś ca srotasāṃ sa pradūṣakaḥ ||
atipravṛttiḥ saṅgo vā sirāṇāṃ granthayo .pi vā |
column5: atipravṛttiḥ saṅgo vā sirāṇāṃ granthayo .pi vā |

column3: bisānām iva sūkṣmāṇi dūraṃ pravisṛtāni ca |
dvārāṇi srotasāṃ dehe raso yair upacīyate ||
annasya paktā pittaṃ tu pācakākhyaṃ pureritam |
bhuktam āmāśaye ruddhvā sā vipācya nayaty adhaḥ |
balavaty abalā tv annam āmam eva vimuñcati ||
grahaṇyā balam agnir hi sa cāpi grahaṇībalaḥ |
column5: grahaṇyā balamagnirhi sa cāpi grahaṇīṃ śritaḥ |

column3: tatrāgnir hetur āhārān na hy apakvād rasādayaḥ ||
ādau ṣaḍrasam apy annaṃ madhurībhūtam īrayet |
phenībhūtaṃ kaphaṃ yātaṃ vidāhād amlatāṃ tataḥ ||
pittam āmāśayāt kuryāc cyavamānaṃ cyutaṃ punaḥ |

column3: kecid āhur ahorātrāt ṣaḍahād apare pare ||
prāyaḥ karoty ahorātrāt karmānyad api bheṣajam ||
kṣipyamāṇaḥ khavaiguṇyād rasaḥ sajati yatra saḥ |
tasmin vikāraṃ kurute khe varṣam iva toyadaḥ ||
annasya paktā sarveṣāṃ paktṝṇām adhiko mataḥ |
tasmāt taṃ vidhivad yuktair annapānendhanair hitaiḥ |
pālayet prayatas tasya sthitau hy āyurbalasthitiḥ ||
samo .gnir viṣamas tīkṣṇo mandaś caivaṃ caturvidhaḥ |
yaḥ pacet samyag evānnaṃ bhuktaṃ samyak samas tv asau ||
viṣamo .samyag apy āśu samyag vāpi cirāt pacet |
tīkṣṇo vahniḥ pacec chīghram asamyag api bhojanam ||
mandas tu samyag apy annam upayuktaṃ cirāt pacet |
vayaḥkṛtam ṛtūtthaṃ ca kālajaṃ yuktijaṃ punaḥ |
dvāv añjalī tu stanyasya catvāro rajasaḥ striyāḥ ||
samadhātor idaṃ mānaṃ vidyād vṛddhikṣayāv ataḥ ||
yaḥ syād doṣo .dhikas tena prakṛtiḥ saptadhoditā ||
prāyo .ta eva pavanādhyuṣitā manuṣyā doṣātmakāḥ sphuṭitadhūsarakeśagātrāḥ |
na dṛḍhā na jitendriyā na cāryā na ca kāntādayitā bahuprajā vā ||
netrāṇi caiṣāṃ kharadhūsarāṇi vṛttāny acārūṇi mṛtopamāni |
unmīlitānīva bhavanti supte śailadrumāṃs te gaganaṃ ca yānti ||
pittaṃ vahnir vahnijaṃ vā yad asmāt pittodriktas tīkṣṇatṛṣṇābubhukṣaḥ |
vibhavasāhasabuddhibalānvito bhavati bhīṣu gatir dviṣatām api ||
suptaḥ paśyet karṇikārān palāśān digdāholkāvidyudarkānalāṃś ca ||
tanūni piṅgāni calāni caiṣāṃ tanvalpapakṣmāṇi himapriyāṇi |
krodhena madyena raveś ca bhāsā rāgaṃ vrajanty āśu vilocanāni ||
śleṣmā somaḥ śleṣmalas tena saumyo gūḍhasnigdhaśliṣṭasaṃdhyasthimāṃsaḥ |
kṣuttṛḍduḥkhakleśagharmair atapto buddhyā yuktaḥ sāttvikaḥ satyasaṃdhaḥ ||
dharmātmā vadati na niṣṭhuraṃ ca jātu pracchannaṃ vahati dṛḍhaṃ ciraṃ ca vairam ||
smṛtimān abhiyogavān vinīto na ca bālye .py atirodano na lolaḥ ||
tiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṭukoṣṇarūkṣam alpaṃ sa bhuṅkte balavāṃs tathāpi |
śrāddho gambhīraḥ sthūlalakṣaḥ kṣamāvān āryo nidrālur dīrghasūtraḥ kṛtajñaḥ ||
ṛjur vipaścit subhagaḥ sulajjo bhakto gurūṇāṃ sthirasauhṛdaś ca |
svapne sapadmān savihaṃgamālāṃs toyāśayān paśyati toyadāṃś ca ||
vayas tv ā ṣoḍaśād bālaṃ tatra dhātvindriyaujasām |
vṛddhir ā saptater madhyaṃ tatrāvṛddhiḥ paraṃ kṣayaḥ ||
svaṃ svaṃ hastatrayaṃ sārdhaṃ vapuḥ pātraṃ sukhāyuṣoḥ |
na ca yad yuktam udriktair aṣṭābhir ninditair nijaiḥ ||
susnigdhā mṛdavaḥ sūkṣmā naikamūlāḥ sthirāḥ kacāḥ ||
oṣṭhau raktāv anudvṛttau mahatyau nolbaṇe hanū |
mahad āsyaṃ ghanā dantāḥ snigdhāḥ ślakṣṇāḥ sitāḥ samāḥ ||
jihvā raktāyatā tanvī māṃsalaṃ cibukaṃ mahat |
grīvā hrasvā ghanā vṛttā skandhāv unnatapīvarau ||
gūḍhavaṃśaṃ bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ nigūḍhāḥ saṃdhayo dṛḍhāḥ ||
dhīraḥ svaro .nunādī ca varṇaḥ snigdhaḥ sthiraprabhaḥ |
svabhāvajaṃ sthiraṃ sattvam avikāri vipatsv api ||
āyur aiśvaryam iṣṭāś ca sarve bhāvāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
sārair upetaḥ sarvaiḥ syāt paraṃ gauravasaṃyutaḥ |
anutsekam adainyaṃ ca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca sevate |
sattvavāṃs tapyamānas tu rājaso naiva tāmasaḥ ||
pṛthak sakthnos tathā bāhvos trīṇi koṣṭhe navorasi ||
pṛṣṭhe caturdaśordhvaṃ tu jatros triṃśacca sapta ca |
jaṅghorvoḥ saṃgame jānu khañjatā tatra jīvataḥ |
iti sakthnos tathā bāhvor maṇibandho .tra gulphavat ||
kūrparaṃ jānuvat kauṇyaṃ tayor viṭapavat punaḥ |
nābhiḥ so .pi hi sadyoghno dvāram āmāśayasya ca |
tayoḥ koṣṭhe .sṛjā pūrṇe naśyed yātena pūyatām |
tiryag ūrdhvaṃ ca nirdiṣṭau pārśvasaṃdhī tayor vyadhāt ||
catasras tāsu nīle dve manye dve marmaṇī smṛte |
pṛthak catasras tāḥ sadyo ghnantyasūn mātṛkāhvayāḥ ||
bhruvor madhye traye .pyatra śalye jīved anuddhṛte |
svayaṃ vā patite pākāt sadyo naśyati tūddhṛte ||
viṣamaṃ spandanaṃ yatra pīḍite ruk ca marma tat ||
syān marmeti ca tenātra sutarāṃ jīvitaṃ sthitam ||
bṛhatyau mātṛkā nīle manye kakṣādharau phaṇau |
sīmantāḥ kūrparau gulphau kṛkāṭyau jānunī patiḥ |
viṭapau vidhurākhye ca śṛṅgāṭāni sirāsu tu |
apastambhāvapāṅgau ca dhamanīsthaṃ na taiḥ smṛtam ||
saptāhaḥ paramas teṣāṃ kālaḥ kālasya karṣaṇe |
utkṣepau sthapanī trīṇi viśalyaghnāni tatra hi ||
gulphau ca stanamūle ca tryaṅgulaṃ jānukūrparam |
iṣṭāni marmāṇyanyeṣāṃ caturdhoktāḥ sirās tu yāḥ ||
tarpayanti vapuḥ kṛtsnaṃ tā marmāṇyāśritās tataḥ |
jīvitaṃ prāṇināṃ tatra rakte tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhati ||
prāṇaghātini jīvet tu kaścid vaidyaguṇena cet ||
rogā marmāśrayās tadvat prakrāntā yatnato .pi ca ||
yathā bhaviṣyato liṅgaṃ riṣṭaṃ mṛtyos tathā dhruvam ||
bhavanti bhiṣajāṃ bhūtyai kṛtajña iva bhūbhuji |
kṣīṇāyuṣi kṛtaṃ karma vyarthaṃ kṛtam ivādhame |
ariṣṭaṃ nāsti maraṇaṃ dṛṣṭariṣṭaṃ ca jīvitam |
sa doṣāṇāṃ śame śāmyet sthāyyavaśyaṃ tu mṛtyave |
vikṛtir yā samāsena riṣṭaṃ tad iti lakṣayet ||
sahasaiva pateyur vā jihvā jihmā visarpiṇī ||
śūnā śuṣkā guruḥ śyāvā liptā suptā sakaṇṭakā |
śiraḥ śirodharā voḍhuṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ vā bhāram ātmanaḥ ||
hanū vā piṇḍam āsyasthaṃ śaknuvanti na yasya ca |
viṣadoṣād vinā yasya khebhyo raktaṃ pravartate |
ato .nyathā vā yasya syāt sarve te kālacoditāḥ |
lalāṭe vastiśīrṣe vā ṣaṇ māsān na sa jīvati |
plavate plavamānasya ṣaṇ māsās tasya jīvitam |
yasya gomayacūrṇābhaṃ cūrṇaṃ mūrdhni mukhe .pi vā ||
sasnehaṃ mūrdhni dhūmo vā māsāntaṃ tasya jīvitam |
mūrdhni bhruvor vā kurvanti sīmantāvartakā navāḥ ||
mṛtyuṃ svasthasya ṣaḍrātrāt trirātrād āturasya tu |
jihvā śyāvā mukhaṃ pūti savyam akṣi nimajjati ||
khagā vā mūrdhni līyante yasya taṃ parivarjayet |
yasya sphuṭeyuraṅgulyo nākṛṣṭā na sa jīvati ||
hrasvo dīrgho .ti vocchvāsaḥ pūtiḥ surabhireva vā ||
tyajanti vātivairasyāt so .pi varṣaṃ na jīvati ||
śīteṣu bhṛśam auṣṇyaṃ vā svedaḥ stambho .pyahetukaḥ ||
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca yathā pretas tathaiva saḥ ||
mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ niṣṭhyūtaṃ śukraṃ vāpsu nimajjati |
niṣṭhyūtaṃ bahuvarṇaṃ vā yasya māsāt sa naśyati ||
ghanībhūtam ivākāśam ākāśam iva yo ghanam |
amūrtam iva mūrtaṃ ca mūrtaṃ cāmūrtavat sthitam ||
tejasvyatejas tadvacca śuklaṃ kṛṣṇam asacca sat |
jāgrad rakṣāṃsi gandharvān pretān anyāṃśca tadvidhān |
rūpaṃ vyākṛti tat tacca yaḥ paśyati sa naśyati ||
dhruvam ākāśagaṅgāṃ vā sa na paśyati tāṃ samām ||
śṛṇotyanyāṃśca yaḥ śabdān asato na sato .pi vā ||
niṣpīḍya karṇau śṛṇuyān na yo dhukadhukāsvanam |
sarvaśo vā na yo yaśca dīpagandhaṃ na jighrati |
yaḥ pāṃsuneva kīrṇāṅgo yo .ṅge ghātaṃ na vetti vā |
antareṇa tapas tīvraṃ yogaṃ vā vidhipūrvakam ||
hīno dīnaḥ svaro .vyakto yasya syād gadgado .pi vā ||
sahasā yo vimuhyed vā vivakṣur na sa jīvati |
rogavṛddhim ayuktyā ca dṛṣṭvā maraṇam ādiśet |
chāyā vivartate yasya svapne .pi preta eva saḥ |
varṇaprabhāśrayā yā tu sā chāyaiva śarīragā ||
viśirā dviśirā jihmā vikṛtā yadi vānyathā ||

ayugmāśca mṛgāḥ śastāḥ śastā nityaṃ ca darśane ||
dhanuraindraṃ ca lālāṭam aśubhaṃ śubham anyataḥ |

latā kaṇṭakinī vaṃśas tālo vā hṛdi jāyate |
yasya tasyāśu gulmena yasya vahnim anarciṣam ||
padmaṃ sa naśyet kuṣṭhena caṇḍālaiḥ saha yaḥ pibet ||
snehaṃ bahuvidhaṃ svapne sa prameheṇa naśyati |
unmādena jale majjed yo nṛtyan rākṣasaiḥ saha ||
apasmāreṇa yo martyo nṛtyan pretena nīyate |

patanaṃ vā vināśo vā bhedanaṃ parvatasya ca ||

yaḥ paśyel labhate yo vā chattrādarśaviṣāmiṣam ||

śarīrasya tataḥ sthānaṃ śārīram idam ucyate ||

madhuraṃ yacca sarveṣu prāyo madhviva mehati |
śūlam unnidratā śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaśca jāyate ||
column5: śūlam unnidratā śoṣaḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaṃ ca jāyate |

column3: mahatī piṭikā nīlā vinatā vinatā smṛtā ||
column5: mahatī piḍakā nīlā piḍakā vinatā smṛtā |

column3: dahati tvacam utthāne bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭā visarpiṇī |
putriṇī ca vidārī ca duḥsahā bahumedasaḥ |
column5: putriṇī ca vidārī ca duḥsahā bahumedasaḥ |

column3: yo mūtrayen na taṃ mehaṃ raktapittaṃ tu tad viduḥ ||
column5: yo mūtrayeta tan mehaṃ raktapittaṃ tu tadviduḥ |
bhaviṣyato mehagaṇasya rūpaṃ mūtre .pi dhāvanti pipīlikāśca ||

column3: dṛṣṭvā pramehaṃ madhuraṃ sapicchaṃ madhūpamaṃ syād dvividho vicāraḥ |
saṃpūraṇād vā kaphasaṃbhavaḥ syāt kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣvanilātmako vā ||
sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittamehāḥ krameṇa ye vātakṛtāśca mehāḥ |
sādhyā na te pittakṛtās tu yāpyāḥ sādhyās tu medo yadi nātiduṣṭam ||
yaḥ śopho bahirantar vā mahāmūlo mahārujaḥ ||
vṛttaḥ syād āyato yo vā smṛtaḥ ṣoḍhā sa vidradhiḥ |
doṣaiḥ pṛthak samuditaiḥ śoṇitena kṣatena ca ||
nābhyāṃ hidhmā bhaved vastau mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa pūti ca |
śvāso yakṛti rodhas tu plīhnyucchvāsasya tṛṭ punaḥ ||
pramohas tamakaḥ kāso hṛdaye ghaṭṭanaṃ vyathā ||
gudāsyān nābhijo vidyād doṣaṃ kledācca vidradhau ||
evam eva stanasirā vivṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām ||
nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmavaktratvāt kanyānāṃ na sa jāyate |
ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅ mṛduḥ |
upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhim ādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ |
prapīḍito .ntaḥ svanavān prayāti pradhmāpayann eti punaśca muktaḥ ||
gulmo .ṣṭadhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭair nicayaṃ gataiḥ ||
anudīrṇām udīrṇān vā vātādīn na vimuñcati ||
śuddho vāśu vidāhīni bhajate syandanāni vā ||
vātolbaṇās tasya malāḥ pṛthak kruddhā dviśo .thavā |
vāyuḥ kṛtāśrayaḥ koṣṭhe raukṣyāt kāṭhinyam āgataḥ ||
vyadhaḥ sūcyeva viṭsaṅgaḥ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ muhuḥ |
stambho gātre mukhe śoṣaḥ kārśyaṃ viṣamavahnitā ||
dūyate dīpyate soṣmā svasthānaṃ dahatīva ca ||
svadoṣasthānadhāmānaḥ sve sve kāle ca rukkarāḥ ||
prāyas trayas tu dvandvotthā gulmāḥ saṃsṛṣṭalakṣaṇāḥ |
so .sādhyo raktagulmas tu striyā eva prajāyate |
ṛtau vā navasūtā vā yadi vā yonirogiṇī ||
sevate vātalāni strī kruddhas tasyāḥ samīraṇaḥ |
na cāṅgair garbhavad gulmaḥ sphuratyapi tu śūlavān ||
piṇḍībhūtaḥ sa evāsyāḥ kadācit spandate cirāt |
na cāsyā vardhate kukṣir gulma eva tu vardhate ||
svadoṣasaṃśrayo gulmaḥ sarvo bhavati tena saḥ |
pākaṃ cireṇa bhajate naiva vā vidradhiḥ punaḥ ||
column5: pākaṃ cireṇa bhajate naidhate vidradhiḥ punaḥ ||

column3: ato viparyayo bāhye koṣṭhāṅgeṣu tu nātiruk |
tūṇī pratūṇī tu bhavet sa evāto viparyaye ||
āṭopam ādhmānam apaktiśaktim āsannagulmasya vadanti cihnam ||
rogāḥ sarve .pi mande .gnau sutarām udarāṇi tu |
ādhmāpya kukṣim udaram aṣṭadhā tacca bhidyate |
syuḥ pretarūpāḥ puruṣā bhāvinas tasya lakṣaṇam |
kṣunnāśo .nnaṃ cirāt sarvaṃ savidāhaṃ ca pacyate ||
jīrṇājīrṇaṃ na jānāti sauhityaṃ sahate na ca |
nābhim antraṃ ca viṣṭabhya vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati ||
saśabdo niścared vāyur viḍ baddhā mūtram alpakam ||
nātimando .nalo laulyaṃ na ca syād virasaṃ mukham |
pittodare jvaro mūrchā dāhas tṛṭ kaṭukāsyatā |
śoṇitaṃ vā rasādibhyo vivṛddhaṃ taṃ vivardhayet |
plīhavad dakṣiṇāt pārśvāt kuryād yakṛd api cyutam |
bhidyate pacyate vāntraṃ tacchidraiśca sravan bahiḥ |
āma eva gudād eti tato .lpālpaṃ saviḍrasaḥ ||
vardhayet tad adho nābherāśu caiti jalātmatām |

column5: udrikte doṣarūpe ca vyāpte ca śvāsatṛḍbhramaiḥ |

column3: dakodaraṃ mahat snigdhaṃ sthiram āvṛttanābhi tat |
tad evodakam āpyāyya picchāṃ kuryāt tadā bhavet |
gurūdaraṃ sthiraṃ vṛttam āhataṃ ca na śabdavat ||
mṛdu vyapetarājīkaṃ nābhyāṃ spṛṣṭaṃ ca sarpati |
kṛcchraṃ yathottaraṃ pakṣāt paraṃ prāyo .pare hataḥ |
tatrānilena balinā kṣiptaṃ pittaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||
dhamanīr daśa samprāpya vyāpnuvat sakalāṃ tanum |
tvaṅmāṃsayos tat kurute tvaci varṇān pṛthagvidhān |
yato .taḥ pāṇḍurityuktaḥ sa rogas tena gauravam |
sannasaktho jvarī śvāsī karṇakṣveḍī bhramī śramī |
sa pañcadhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ samastair mṛttikādanāt ||
mṛt kaṣāyānilaṃ pittam ūṣarā madhurā kapham |
dūṣayitvā rasādīṃśca raukṣyād bhuktaṃ virūkṣya ca ||
purīṣaṃ kṛmiman muñced bhinnaṃ sāsṛk kaphaṃ naraḥ |
yaḥ pāṇḍurogī seveta pittalaṃ tasya kāmalām ||
upekṣayā ca śophāḍhyā sā kṛcchrā kumbhakāmalā |
vātapittād bhramas tṛṣṇā strīṣvaharṣo mṛdur jvaraḥ |
alasaṃ ceti śaṃsanti teṣāṃ pūrvam upadravāḥ |
nītvā ruddhagatis tair hi kuryāt tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam ||
utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śophaṃ tam āhur nicayād ataḥ |
doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvayaiḥ sarvairabhighātād viṣād api |
dvidhā vā nijam āgantuṃ sarvāṅgaikāṅgajaṃ ca tam ||
anye ca mithyopakrāntās tair doṣā vakṣasi sthitāḥ ||
ūrdhvaṃ śopham adho vastau madhye kurvanti madhyagāḥ |
sparśoṣṇakāṅkṣī ca kaphād yathāsvaṃ dvandvajās trayaḥ |
yathottaraṃ ca duḥsādhyās tatra doṣā yathāyatham |
te pakvabhinnāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ca bibhrati vraṇalakṣaṇam |
yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaśca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ |
column5: yaṃyaṃ deśaṃ visarpaśca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ ||

column3: śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vāśu ca cīyate ||
column5: śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vāśu ca cīyate |

column3: agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvād drutaṃ ca saḥ |
column5: agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvāddrutaṃ sa ca ||

column3: vyathetāṅgaṃ haret saṃjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsam īrayet |
hidhmāṃ ca sa gato .vasthām īdṛśīṃ labhate na nā ||
kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham ||
column5: kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham |

column3: āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati ||
column5: āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati ||

column3: bāhyahetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayan ||
pāpmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ sadyaḥ prāktanair veritā malāḥ |
tvacaḥ kurvanti vaivarṇyaṃ duṣṭāḥ kuṣṭham uśanti tat ||
kālenopekṣitaṃ yasmāt sarvaṃ kuṣṇāti tad vapuḥ |
prapadya dhātūn vyāpyāntaḥ sarvān saṃkledya cāvahet ||
kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅ miśraiḥ samāgataiḥ ||
vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ pittād audumbaraṃ kaphāt ||
sarvaiḥ syāt kākaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ trikaṃ dadru sakākaṇam |
dāhaḥ kaṇḍūs tvaci svāpas todaḥ koṭhonnatiḥ śramaḥ ||
sthiraṃ styānaṃ guru snigdhaṃ śvetaraktam anāśugam ||
sidhmaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahiḥ snigdham antar ghṛṣṭaṃ rajaḥ kiret ||
column5: antā rūkṣaṃ bahiḥ snigdhamantarghṛṣṭaṃ rajaḥ kiret |

column3: pūrvaṃ raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca kākaṇantīphalopamam |
kuṣṭhaliṅgair yutaṃ sarvair naikavarṇaṃ tato bhavet ||
akṛcchraṃ kaphavātāḍhyaṃ tvakstham ekamalaṃ ca yat |
kuṣṭhaikasaṃbhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ dāruṇaṃ ca tat |
kaphād āmāśaye jātā vṛddhāḥ sarpanti sarvataḥ |
śvetās tāmrāvabhāsāśca nāmataḥ saptadhā tu te ||
kuravo darbhakusumāḥ sugandhās te ca kurvate ||
sraṣṭā dhātā vibhur viṣṇuḥ saṃhartā mṛtyurantakaḥ ||
samāsād vyāsato doṣabhedīye nāma dhāma ca |
caran srotaḥsu rikteṣu bhṛśaṃ tānyeva pūrayan |
karotyadharakāye ca tāṃs tān kṛcchrān upadravān |
kaṇṭhoparodham udgārān vyādhīn ūrdhvaṃ ca nābhitaḥ |
rakte tīvrā rujaḥ svāpaṃ tāpaṃ rāgaṃ vivarṇatām |
śukrasya śīghram utsargaṃ saṅgaṃ vikṛtim eva vā |
yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kruddho .bhyeti muhur muhuḥ ||
column5: yadā tu dhamanīḥ sarvāḥ kruddho .bhyeti muhurmuhuḥ |

column3: adhaḥ pratihato vāyur vrajann ūrdhvaṃ hṛdāśritāḥ ||
nāḍīḥ praviśya hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ śaṅkhau ca pīḍayan |
sa eva cāpatānākhyo mukte tu marutā hṛdi |
antar dhanurivāṅgaṃ ca vegaiḥ stambhaṃ ca netrayoḥ |
bāhyāyāmaṃ dhanuḥṣkambhaṃ bruvate veginaṃ ca tam ||
vyāyacchanti tanuṃ doṣāḥ sarvām ā pādamastakam ||
gate vege bhavet svāsthyaṃ sarveṣvākṣepakeṣu ca ||
vāyur vivṛddhas tais taiśca vātalairūrdhvam āsthitaḥ ||
gandhājñānaṃ smṛter mohas trāsaḥ suptasya jāyate ||
raktam āśritya pavanaḥ kuryān mūrdhadharāḥ sirāḥ ||
rūkṣāḥ savedanāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ so .sādhyaḥ syāt sirāgrahaḥ |
gṛhītvārdhaṃ tanor vāyuḥ sirāḥ snāyūr viśoṣya ca ||
ekāṅgarogaṃ taṃ kecid anye pakṣavadhaṃ viduḥ |
vāyuḥ kaṭyāṃ sthitaḥ sakthnaḥ kaṇḍarām ākṣiped yadā |
tadā khañjo bhavej jantuḥ paṅguḥ sakthnor dvayorapi ||
kampate gamanārambhe khañjann iva ca yāti yaḥ |
ruk pāde viṣamanyaste śramād vā jāyate yadā |
vātena gulpham āśritya tam āhur vātakaṇṭakam ||
hṛṣyete caraṇau yasya bhavetāṃ ca prasuptavat ||
vātalaiḥ śītalair vāyur vṛddhaḥ kruddho vimārgagaḥ |
tādṛśaivāsṛjā ruddhaḥ prāk tad eva pradūṣayet ||
tad āhur nāmabhis tacca pūrvaṃ pādau pradhāvati ||
viśeṣād yānayānād yaiḥ pralambau tasya lakṣaṇam |
ākhoriva viṣaṃ kruddhaṃ kṛtsnaṃ dehaṃ vidhāvati |
tvaṅmāṃsāśrayam uttānaṃ tat pūrvaṃ jāyate tataḥ ||
karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīre sarvataścaran ||
column5: karoti khañjaṃ paṅguṃ vā śarīraṃ sarvataścaran ||

column3: pitte vidāhaḥ saṃmohaḥ svedo mūrchā madaḥ satṛṭ |
sparśākṣamatvaṃ rug rāgaḥ śophaḥ pāko bhṛśoṣmatā ||
kaṇḍūr mandā ca rug dvandvasarvaliṅgaṃ ca saṃkare ||
column5: kaṇḍūrmandā ca rugdvandvaṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ ca saṃkarāt ||

column3: tridoṣajaṃ tyajet srāvi stabdham arbudakāri ca ||
kuṣṭhaṃ visarpam anyāṃśca kuryāt sarvāṅgagān gadān |
yuktaṃ vidyān nirāmaṃ tu tandrādīnāṃ viparyayāt ||
liṅgaṃ pittāvṛte dāhas tṛṣṇā śūlaṃ bhramas tamaḥ ||
bhavecca rāgī śvayathur jāyante maṇḍalāni ca |
māṃsena kaṭhinaḥ śopho vivarṇaḥ piṭikās tathā ||
harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca saṃcāra iva jāyate |
column5: harṣaḥ pipīlikānāṃ ca saṃcāra iva jāyate |

column3: calaḥ snigdho mṛduḥ śītaḥ śopho gātreṣvarocakaḥ ||
āḍhyavāta iti jñeyaḥ sa kṛcchro medasāvṛte |
śūlaṃ ca pīḍyamānena pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham |
column5: śūlaṃ ca paḍyimānaśca pāṇibhyāṃ labhate sukham |

column3: śukrāvṛte .tivego vā na vā niṣphalatāpi vā ||
vrajatyāśu jarāṃ sneho bhukte cānahyate naraḥ ||
śakṛt pīḍitam annena duḥkhaṃ śuṣkaṃ cirāt sṛjet |
bhramo mūrchā rujā dāhaḥ pittena prāṇa āvṛte ||
column5: bhramo mūrchā rujā dāhaḥ pittena prāṇa āvṛte ||

column3: dāhaśca syād apāne tu male hāridravarṇatā |
śleṣmaṇā tvāvṛte prāṇe sādas tandrārucir vamiḥ |
gurutāṅgeṣu sarveṣu skhalitaṃ ca gatau bhṛśam |

column5: apāne sakalaṃ mūtraṃ śakṛtaḥ syāt pravartanam ||

column3: sarve .pi viṃśatividhaṃ vidyād āvaraṇaṃ ca tat ||
diśānayā ca vibhajet sarvam āvaraṇaṃ bhiṣak ||
sthānānyavekṣya vātānāṃ vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca karmaṇām |
prāṇādīnāṃ ca pañcānāṃ miśram āvaraṇaṃ mithaḥ ||
śanaiḥ śanaiścopaśayād gūḍhām api muhur muhuḥ |
viśeṣāj jīvitaṃ prāṇa udāno balam ucyate ||
āvṛtā vāyavo .jñātā jñātā vā vatsaraṃ sthitāḥ ||
āmāśayastho hatvāgniṃ sāmo mārgān pidhāya yat |
vidadhāti jvaraṃ doṣas tasmāt kurvīta laṅghanam ||
prāgrūpeṣu jvarādau vā balaṃ yatnena pālayan |
laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte .gnau lāghave sati |
svāsthyaṃ kṣut tṛḍ ruciḥ paktir balam ojaśca jāyate ||
vamanaṃ vamanārhasya śastaṃ kuryāt tad anyathā ||
pippalībhir yutān gālān kaliṅgair madhukena vā ||
kṛte .kṛte vā vamane jvarī kuryād viśoṣaṇam |
tat kaphaṃ vilayaṃ nītvā tṛṣṇām āśu nivartayet ||
śītaṃ tebhyo hitaṃ toyaṃ pācanaṃ tṛḍjvarāpaham |
ūṣmā pittād ṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā ||
column5: ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā |

column3: ajīrṇa iva śūlaghnaṃ sāme tīvraruji jvare |
na pibed auṣadhaṃ taddhi bhūya evāmam āvahet ||
laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgvas tiktako rasaḥ ||
malānāṃ pācanāni syur yathāvasthaṃ krameṇa vā |
neṣyate teṣu hi hitaṃ śamanaṃ yan na karśanam |
ṣaḍahaṃ vā mṛdutvaṃ vā jvaro yāvad avāpnuyāt ||
koṣṭhe vibaddhe saruji pibet tu parikartini |
ūrdhvaṃ pravṛtte rakte ca peyāṃ necchanti teṣu tu |
pibet saśarkarākṣaudrān tato jīrṇe tu tarpaṇe |
ityayaṃ ṣaḍaho neyo balaṃ doṣaṃ ca rakṣatā ||
tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ kaṭukaḥ kaphe |
mṛdur jvaro laghur dehaścalitāśca malā yadā ||
column5: mṛdau jvare laghau dehe pracaleṣu maleṣu ca |

column3: mustayā parpaṭaṃ yuktaṃ śuṇṭhyā duḥsparśayāpi vā ||
kanīyaḥ pañcamūlaṃ ca pitte śakrayavā ghanam ||
jvaraṃ madātyayaṃ chardiṃ mūrchāṃ dāhaṃ śramaṃ bhramam |
ūrdhvagaṃ raktapittaṃ ca pipāsāṃ kāmalām api ||
kaṣāyaṃ taṃ piban kāle jvarān sarvān apohati ||
peyā kaphaṃ vardhayati paṅkaṃ pāṃsuṣu vṛṣṭivat ||
raktādyāḥ śālayo jīrṇāḥ ṣaṣṭikāśca jvare hitāḥ ||
odanas taiḥ sruto dvis triḥ prayoktavyo yathāyatham ||
tāni kvathitaśītaṃ ca vāri madyaṃ ca sātmyataḥ |
sajvaraṃ jvaramuktaṃ vā dinānte bhojayel laghu ||
prāg alpavahnir bhuñjāno na hyajīrṇena pīḍyate |
sarpir dadyāt kaphe mande vātapittottare jvare |
rūkṣaṃ hi tejo jvarakṛt tejasā rūkṣitasya ca ||
column5: rūkṣaṃ tejo jvarakaraṃ tejasā rūkṣitasya ca |

column3: yaḥ syād atibalo dhātuḥ sahacārī sadāgatiḥ ||
viparītaṃ jvaroṣmāṇaṃ jayet pittaṃ ca śaityataḥ ||
snehād vātaṃ ghṛtaṃ tulyaṃ yogasaṃskārataḥ kapham |
pūrve kaṣāyāḥ saghṛtāḥ sarve yojyā yathāmalam ||
ghṛtam āśu nihanti sādhitaṃ jvaram agniṃ viṣamaṃ halīmakam |
aruciṃ bhṛśatāpam aṃsayor vamathuṃ pārśvaśirorujaṃ kṣayam ||
tailvakaṃ pavanajanmani jvare yojayet trivṛtayā viyojitam |
tiktakaṃ vṛṣaghṛtaṃ ca paittike yacca pālanikayā śṛtaṃ haviḥ ||
palāṃśakaiḥ kṣīrasamaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ pacej jīrṇakaphajvaraghnam ||
balaṃ hyalaṃ doṣaharaṃ paraṃ tacca balapradam ||
prāyeṇa tasmān na hitā jīrṇe vātottare jvare ||
na śāmyatyevam api cejjvaraḥ kurvīta śodhanam ||
śodhanārhasya vamanaṃ prāg uktaṃ tasya yojayet |
pakve tu śithile doṣe jvare vā viṣamadyaje |
āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā |
column5: āragvadhaṃ vā payasā mṛdvīkānāṃ rasena vā |
