column3: sarṣapāḥ sayavāḥ sarpir dhūpo viḍ vā biḍālajā |
daivāśrayaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ jvarān sarvān vyapohati |
yathāsvaṃ ca sirāṃ vidhyed aśāntau viṣamajvare |
kuryād yathāsvam uktaṃ ca raktamokṣādi sādhanam ||
krodhajo yāti kāmena śāntiṃ krodhena kāmajaḥ |
te jvarāḥ kevalāḥ pūrvaṃ vyāpyante .nantaram malaiḥ ||
na hi jvaro .nubadhnāti mārutādyair vinā kṛtaḥ ||
na vijvaro .pi sahasā sarvānnīno bhavet tathā |
sadyaḥ prāṇaharo yasmāt tasmāt tasya viśeṣataḥ |
tasyāṃ tasyām avasthāyāṃ tat tat kuryād bhiṣagjitam ||
prītikarā manaso viṣayāśca ghnantyapi viṣṇukṛtaṃ jvaram ugram ||
śāntaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ kupyan mārgān mārgāntaraṃ ca yat ||
laṅghanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vādau śodhanaṃ śamanaṃ tathā ||
adhoge raktapitte tu bṛṃhaṇo madhuro rasaḥ ||
ūrdhvage tarpaṇaṃ yojyaṃ prāk ca peyā tvadhogate |
aśnato balino .śuddhaṃ na dhāryaṃ taddhi rogakṛt ||
sādhayed vidhival lehaṃ lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ |
trivṛtā triphalā śyāmā pippalī śarkarā madhu ||
sasitaṃ vā jalaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā madhukodakam ||
kṣīraṃ vā rasam ikṣor vā śuddhasyānantaro vidhiḥ |
mantho jvarokto drākṣādiḥ pittaghnair vā phalaiḥ kṛtaḥ |
pṛthak pṛthag jale teṣāṃ yavāgūḥ kalpayed rase ||
śūkaśimbībhavaṃ dhānyaṃ rakte śākaṃ ca śasyate |
pūrvoktam ambu pānīyaṃ pañcamūlena vā śṛtam |
laghunā śṛtaśītaṃ vā madhvambho vā phalāmbu vā ||
śaśaḥ savāstukaḥ śasto vibandhe tittiriḥ punaḥ |
plakṣasya barhiṇas tadvan nyagrodhasya ca kukkuṭaḥ |
yat kiṃcid raktapittasya nidānaṃ tacca varjayet ||
vṛṣaḥ sadyo jayatyasraṃ sa hyasya param auṣadham ||
lodhro vṛṣas taṇḍulīyaḥ kṛṣṇā mṛn madayantikā ||
jāṅgalaṃ bhakṣayed vājam āmaṃ pittayutaṃ yakṛt |
āpothya vā nave kumbhe plāvayed ikṣugaṇḍikāḥ ||
sthitaṃ tad guptam ākāśe rātriṃ prātaḥ srutaṃ jalam |
ye ca pittajvare coktāḥ kaṣāyās tāṃśca yojayet |
raktapittaṃ na cecchāmyet tatra vātolbaṇe payaḥ |
pṛthak pṛthak śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ saghṛtaṃ sitayāthavā |
pītvā kaṣāyān payasā bhuñjīta payasaiva ca |
kṣīrādīn sasitāṃs toyaṃ kevalaṃ vā jalaṃ hitaṃ ||
raktapitte hitaṃ tacca kṣatakṣīṇe hitaṃ ca yat ||
saviḍaiśca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ taccūrṇaṃ vā ghṛtaplutam |
viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ rāsnā pippalī hiṅgu saindhavam |
bhārgī kṣāraśca taccūrṇaṃ pibed vā ghṛtamātrayā ||
lihyāt karkaṭaśṛṅgīṃ ca kāse tailena vātaje |
duḥsparśāṃ pippalīṃ mustāṃ bhārgīṃ karkaṭakīṃ śaṭhīm ||
tadvat sakṛṣṇāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ ca sabhārgīṃ tadvad eva ca ||
mastunā sasitāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadhnā vā kaṇareṇukām ||
kāsī sapīnaso dhūmaṃ snaihikaṃ vidhinā pibet |
pibet peyāṃ samatilāṃ kṣaireyīṃ vā sasaindhavām ||
kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalaṃ pattraṃ bālaṃ śuṣkaṃ ca mūlakam |
pittakāse tu sakaphe vamanaṃ sarpiṣā hitam ||
hṛtadoṣo himaṃ svādu snigdhaṃ saṃsarjanaṃ bhajet |
ghane kaphe tu śiśiraṃ rūkṣaṃ tiktopasaṃhitam ||
lehayen madhunā gor vā kṣīrapasya śakṛdrasam ||
drākṣāṃ kaṇāṃ pañcamūlaṃ tṛṇākhyaṃ ca pacejjale |
tena kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ pibet samadhuśarkaram ||
sādhitāṃ tena peyāṃ vā suśītāṃ madhunānvitām |
piṣṭvā rasaṃ pibet pūtaṃ vastreṇa ghṛtamūrchitam |
lihyād vā cūrṇam eteṣāṃ kaṣāyam athavā pibet ||
snigdhaṃ virecayed ūrdhvam adho mūrdhni ca yuktitaḥ |
tīkṣṇair virekair balinaṃ saṃsargīṃ cāsya yojayet ||
daśamūlāmbu gharmāmbu madyaṃ madhvambu vā pibet ||
pibed vāri sahakṣaudraṃ kāleṣvannasya vā triṣu ||
madhunā maricaṃ lihyān madhunaiva ca joṅgakam |
pippalī nāgaraṃ mustaṃ pathyā dhātrī sitopalā |
dve pale dāḍimād aṣṭau guḍād vyoṣāt palatrayam ||
sakaṇaṃ kvathitaṃ mūtre kaphakāsī jale .pi vā ||
ghṛtaṃ rase viḍaṅgānāṃ vyoṣagarbhaṃ ca sādhitam ||
ghṛtaṃ trikaṭunā ca siddham upayujya saṃjāyate na kāsaviṣamajvarakṣayagudāṅkurebhyo bhayam ||
darvīlepini śīte ca pṛthag dvikuḍavaṃ kṣipet |
śamanaṃ ca pibeddhūmaṃ śodhanaṃ bahale kaphe ||
dhūmaṃ kāsaghnavidhinā pītvā kṣīraṃ pibed anu ||
niṣṭhyūtānte guḍayutaṃ koṣṇaṃ dhūmo nihanti saḥ |
kāse karma sapitte tu kaphaje tiktasaṃyutam ||
lākṣāṃ sarpir madhūcchiṣṭaṃ jīvanīyaṃ gaṇaṃ sitām |
tvakkṣīrīṃ samitaṃ kṣīre paktvā dīptānalaḥ pibet ||
śṛtaṃ payo madhuyutaṃ saṃdhānārthaṃ pibet kṣatī ||
yavānāṃ cūrṇam āmānāṃ kṣīre siddhaṃ ghṛtānvitam |
cūrṇam āmalakānāṃ vā kṣīre pakvaṃ ghṛtānvitam |
madhunā guṭikā ghnanti tā vṛṣyāḥ pittaśoṇitam |
śṛtakṣīrānupānaṃ vā lihyāt kṣīṇaḥ kṣataḥ kṛśaḥ |
sāśvakarṇaiḥ śṛtāt kṣīrād adyāj jātena sarpiṣā ||
jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ śuṇṭhī varī vīrā punarnavā ||
śṛṅgāṭakaṃ payasyā ca pañcamūlaṃ ca yallaghu ||
taiḥ pacet sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ karṣāṃśaiḥ ślakṣṇakalkitaiḥ ||
pippalyaṣṭapale kalke prasthaṃ siddhe ca śītale ||
ghṛtaṃ tu pitte .bhyadhike lihyād vāte .dhike pibet ||
sarpirguḍān samadhvaṃśān kṛtvā dadyāt payo .nu ca |
reto vīryaṃ balaṃ puṣṭiṃ tairāśutaram āpnuyāt ||
ghaṭṭayan sarpiṣaḥ prasthe kṣaudravarṇe .tra ca kṣipet ||
tena kvāthena tulyāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ ca sādhayet |
upayujya ca ṣaṇ māsān vṛddho .pi taruṇāyate ||
yakṣmoktaḥ kṣatināṃ śasto grāhī śakṛti tu drave ||
paced guḍatulāṃ dattvā kuḍavaṃ ca pṛthag ghṛtāt ||
lehaṃ dve cābhaye nityam ataḥ khāded rasāyanāt ||
payasyāṃ kuṭajaṃ hiṃsrāṃ puṣpaṃ sāraṃ ca bījakāt ||
pūte kṣipet sapathye ca tatra jīrṇaguḍāt tulām ||
pālikaṃ saindhavaṃ śuṇṭhī dve ca sauvarcalāt pale ||
śarkarāyāḥ palānyatra daśa dve ca pradāpayet |
kṛtvā cūrṇam ato mātrām annapāneṣu dāpayet ||
ekāṃ ṣoḍaśikāṃ dhānyād dve dve cājājidīpyakāt ||
tābhyāṃ dāḍimavṛkṣāmle dvir dviḥ sauvarcalāt palam |
śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ dadhitthasya madhyāt pañca palāni ca ||
nivṛtte kṣatadoṣe tu kaphe vṛddha uraḥ śiraḥ ||
dālyate kāsino yasya sa nā dhūmān pibed imān |
kṣayaje bṛṃhaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ kuryād agneśca vardhanam ||
sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pibed yuktyā kṣīṇadeho viśodhanam ||
pitte kaphe dhātuṣu ca kṣīṇeṣu kṣayakāsavān |
kaphaṃ śuddhaiśca taiḥ puṣṭiṃ kuryāt samyag vahan rasaḥ ||
piṣṭaiḥ karkaṭaśṛṅgyā ca samaiḥ sarpir vipācayet ||
siddhe .smiṃścūrṇitau kṣārau dvau pañca lavaṇāni ca |
svinnā mṛditvā tās tasmin purāṇāt ṣaṭpalaṃ guḍāt |
dattvārdhākṣaṃ paced bhūyaḥ sa lehaḥ śvāsakāsajit |
padmakaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca |
balā rāsnā ca taccūrṇaṃ samastaṃ samaśarkaram ||
khāden madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt kāsaharaṃ param |
kṣatakāse ca ye dhūmāḥ sānupānā nidarśitāḥ |
kṣayakāse .pi te yojyā vakṣyate yacca yakṣmaṇi ||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ cāgneḥ srotasāṃ ca viśodhanam |
tulyam eva tadārtaṃ ca pūrvaṃ svedairupācaret ||
snigdhair lavaṇatailāktaṃ taiḥ kheṣu grathitaḥ kaphaḥ |
svinnaṃ ca bhojayed annaṃ snigdham ānūpajai rasaiḥ ||
dadhyuttareṇa vā dadyāt tato .smai vamanaṃ mṛdu |
nirhṛte sukham āpnoti sa kaphe duṣṭavigrahe ||
sasaindhavaṃ phalāmlaṃ vā koṣṇaṃ dadyād virecanam ||
yathā tathānilas tasya mārgam asmād viśodhayet ||
aśāntau kṛtasaṃśuddher dhūmair līnaṃ malaṃ haret |
tāṃ ghṛtāktāṃ pibeddhūmaṃ yavān vā ghṛtasaṃyutān ||
madhūcchiṣṭaṃ sarjarasaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā guru vāguru |
candanaṃ vā tathā śṛṅgaṃ vālān vā snāva vā gavām ||
gugguluṃ vā manohvāṃ vā śālaniryāsam eva vā ||
śallakīṃ gugguluṃ lohaṃ padmakaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam |
uraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ ca mṛdubhiḥ sāme tvāmavidhiṃ caret |
vāyur labdhāspado marma saṃśoṣyāśu hared asūn |
pibet kaṣāyaṃ jīrṇe .smin peyāṃ taireva sādhitām |
pāṭhāṃ madhurasāṃ dāru saralaṃ ca niśi sthitam |
tulyaṃ guḍaṃ nāgaraṃ ca bhakṣayen nāvayeta vā |
laśunasya palāṇḍor vā mūlaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā ||
candanād vā rasaṃ dadyān nārīkṣīreṇa nāvanam |
sasaindhavaṃ ghṛtācchaṃ vā siddhaṃ stanyena vā ghṛtam |
kalkitair madhuradravyais tat piben nāvayeta vā ||
tadvat payas tathā siddham adhobhāgauṣadhair ghṛtam ||
tat pibej jīvanīyair vā lihyāt samadhu sādhitam |
vacā pattraṃ ca tālīśaṃ karṣāṃśais tair vipācayet |
hiṅgupādair ghṛtaprasthaṃ pītam āśu nihanti tat ||
tat sevyaṃ prāyaśo yacca sutarāṃ mārutāpaham |
sarveṣāṃ bṛṃhaṇe hyalpaḥ śakyaśca prāyaśo bhavet ||
ūrdhvādho yakṣmiṇaḥ kuryāt sasnehaṃ yanna karśanam ||
ājaṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ kravyānmāṃsaṃ ca śoṣajit |
jñātaṃ jugupsitaṃ taddhi chardiṣe na balaujase ||
sadāḍimaṃ sāmalakaṃ snigdham ājaṃ rasaṃ pibet |
sakṣaudraṃ payasā siddhaṃ sarpir daśaguṇena vā ||
jīvantīṃ madhukaṃ drākṣāṃ phalāni kuṭajasya ca |
puṣkarāhvaṃ śaṭhīṃ kṛṣṇāṃ vyāghrīṃ gokṣurakaṃ balām ||
daśamūlaśṛtāt kṣīrāt sarpir yad udiyān navam |
pañcabhiḥ pañcamūlair vā śṛtād yad udiyād ghṛtam ||
siddhaṃ sarpir jayatyetad yakṣmaṇaḥ saptakaṃ balam ||
punas tena ghṛtaprasthaṃ siddhe cāsmin palāni ṣaṭ |
tavakṣīryāḥ kṣipet triṃśat sitāyā dviguṇaṃ madhu ||
ghṛtāt trijātāt tripalaṃ tato līḍhaṃ khajāhatam |
medhyaṃ cakṣuṣyam āyuṣyaṃ dīpanaṃ hanti cācirāt |
ye ca sarpirguḍāḥ proktāḥ kṣate yojyāḥ kṣaye .pi te |
sādhitaṃ kāsajit svaryaṃ siddham ārtagalena vā ||
aśnīyāt pāyasaṃ caivaṃ snigdhaṃ svedaṃ niyojayet |
siddhaṃ salavaṇaṃ sarpir nasyaṃ svaryam anuttamam ||
sādhitaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca tat svaryaṃ nāvanaṃ param ||
bhuktvādyāt pippalīṃ śuṇṭhīṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vā vamanaṃ bhajet ||
kaṣāyaiḥ kṣālayed āsyaṃ dhūmaṃ prāyogikaṃ pibet ||
kṛtvā kolaṃ ca karṣāṃśaṃ sitāyāśca catuḥpalam |
pippalīnāṃ śataṃ caikaṃ dve śate maricasya ca |
cūrṇam etat paraṃ rucyaṃ hṛdyaṃ grāhi hinasti ca ||
praseke kalpitān saktūn bhakṣyāṃścādyād balī vamet ||
kaṭutiktais tathā śūlyaṃ bhakṣayej jāṅgalaṃ palam |
pīnase .pi kramam imaṃ vamathau ca prayojayet |
śṛṅgādyair vā yathādoṣaṃ duṣṭam eṣāṃ hared asṛk |
māṃsam evāśnato yuktyā mārdvīkaṃ pibato .nu ca ||
uttīrṇaṃ miśrakaiḥ snehair bhūyo .bhyaktaṃ sukhaiḥ karaiḥ ||
mṛdnīyāt sukham āsīnaṃ sukhaṃ codvartayet param |
māṣāṃs tilāṃśca kiṇvaṃ ca sarvam ekatra cūrṇayet |
laṅghanaṃ prāg ṛte vāyor vamanaṃ tatra yojayet ||
tato virekaṃ kramaśo hṛdyaṃ madyaiḥ phalāmbubhiḥ ||
kṣīrair vā saha sa hyūrdhvaṃ gataṃ doṣaṃ nayatyadhaḥ |
śamanaṃ cauṣadhaṃ rūkṣadurbalasya tad eva tu ||
pariśuṣkaṃ priyaṃ sātmyam annaṃ laghu ca śasyate |
upavāsas tathā yūṣā rasāḥ kāmbalikāḥ khalāḥ ||
hanti mārutajāṃ chardiṃ sarpiḥ pītaṃ sasaindhavam |
sarpir vā tailvakaṃ yojyaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca śleṣmadhāmagam |
ūrdhvam eva haret pittaṃ svādutiktair viśuddhimān ||
piben manthaṃ yavāgūṃ vā lājaiḥ samadhuśarkarām |
drākṣārasaṃ rasaṃ vekṣor guḍūcyambu payo .pi vā |
kvāthaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ pītaḥ śīto vā viniyacchati |
chardiṃ jvaram atīsāraṃ mūrchāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca durjayām ||
dhātrīrasena vā śītaṃ piben mudgadalāmbu vā |
lihyāt kṣaudreṇa pathyāṃ vā drākṣāṃ vā badarāṇi vā |
kaphaghnam annaṃ hṛdyaṃ ca rāgāḥ sārjakabhūstṛṇāḥ ||
khādet kapitthaṃ savyoṣaṃ madhunā vā durālabhām |
chardiprasaṅgena hi mātariśvā dhātukṣayāt kopam upaityavaśyam |
payāṃsi pathyopahitāni lehāśchardiṃ prasaktāṃ praśamaṃ nayanti ||
tailaṃ ca lavaṇaiḥ siddhaṃ samūtrāmlaṃ tathāguṇam ||
bilvaṃ rāsnāṃ yavān kolaṃ devadāruṃ punarnavām |
kulatthān pañcamūlaṃ ca paktvā tasmin pacejjale ||
tailaṃ tan nāvane pāne vastau ca viniyojayet |
snigdhāśceha hitāḥ svedāḥ saṃskṛtāni ghṛtāni ca ||
laghunā pañcamūlena śuṇṭhyā vā sādhitaṃ jalam |
vāruṇīdadhimaṇḍaṃ vā dhānyāmlaṃ vā pibet tṛṣi ||
yukto vireko hṛdyaḥ syāt kramaḥ śuddhe ca pittahā ||
śītaṃ samadhu tacceṣṭaṃ svāduvargakṛtaṃ ca yat ||
vastiṃ ca dadyāt sakṣaudraṃ tailaṃ madhukasādhitam |
syācchūlaṃ yasya bhukte .ti jīryatyalpaṃ jarāṃ gate |
yasya jīrṇe .dhikaṃ snehaiḥ sa virecyaḥ phalaiḥ punaḥ ||
jīryatyanne tathā mūlais tīkṣṇaiḥ śūle sadādhike |
divyāmbu śītaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tadvad bhaumaṃ ca tadguṇam |
saśarkaraṃ vā kvathitaṃ pañcamūlena vā jalam |
nasyaṃ kṣīraghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ śītairikṣos tathā rasaḥ |
mūlāni kuśakāśānāṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ ca jale śṛtam ||
jvaroditaṃ vā drākṣādi pañcasārāmbu vā pibet |
jalaṃ pibed rajanyā vā siddhaṃ sakṣaudraśarkaram ||
annātyayān maṇḍam uṣṇaṃ himaṃ manthaṃ ca kālavit |
tṛṣi śramān māṃsarasaṃ manthaṃ vā sasitaṃ pibet ||
śītasnānācca madyāmbu pibet tṛṇmān guḍāmbu vā |
snehād uṣṇāmbvajīrṇāt tu jīrṇān maṇḍaṃ pipāsitaḥ ||
pāne praśastaṃ sarvā ca kriyā rogādyapekṣayā |
tṛṣyan pūrvāmayakṣīṇo na labheta jalaṃ yadi ||
maraṇaṃ dīrgharogaṃ vā prāpnuyāt tvaritaṃ tataḥ |
yaṃ doṣam adhikaṃ paśyet tasyādau pratikārayet |
yaugikaṃ vidhivad yuktaṃ madyam eva nihanti tān ||
kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghram amlopasaṃhitaḥ |
madyam amleṣu ca śreṣṭhaṃ doṣaviṣyandanād alam ||
tīkṣṇoṣṇādyaiḥ purā proktair dīpanādyais tathā guṇaiḥ |
paraṃ tato .nubadhnāti yo rogas tasya bheṣajam |
tatra vātolbaṇe madyaṃ dadyāt piṣṭakṛtaṃ yutam |
pittolbaṇe bahujalaṃ śārkaraṃ madhu vā yutam ||
suśītaṃ sasitāsaktu yojyaṃ tādṛk ca pānakam ||
drākṣārasaṃ vā saṃsargī tarpaṇādiḥ paraṃ hitaḥ ||
tṛṣyalpaśaḥ piben madyaṃ madaṃ rakṣan bahūdakam |
pāṭalyutpalakandair vā svabhāvād eva vā himam |
aśāmyati rasais tṛpte rohiṇīṃ vyadhayet sirām |
śārkaraṃ madhu vā jīrṇam ariṣṭaṃ sīdhum eva vā |
yathāgni bhakṣayan māṃsaṃ mādhavaṃ nigadaṃ pibet |
sakāmābhiḥ saha strībhir yuktyā jāgaraṇena ca ||
yad idaṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ pṛthag doṣabalaṃ prati ||
nāvikṣobhya mano madyaṃ śarīram avihanya vā ||
kuryān madātyayaṃ tasmād iṣyate harṣaṇī kriyā |
na cecchāmyet kaphe kṣīṇe jāte daurbalyalāghave |
grīṣmopataptasya taror yathā varṣaṃ tathā payaḥ |
madyakṣīṇasya hi kṣīṇaṃ kṣīram āśveva puṣyati ||
ojas tulyaṃ guṇaiḥ sarvair viparītaṃ ca madyataḥ |
payasā vihate roge bale jāte nivartayet ||
tayos tu syād ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ vastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ śivāḥ |
ato .sya vakṣyate yogo yaḥ sukhāyaiva kevalam ||
āśvinaṃ yā mahat tejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā |
dadhātyaindraṃ ca yā vīryaṃ prabhāvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca yā ||
astraṃ makaraketor yā puruṣārtho balasya yā |
sautrāmaṇyāṃ dvijamukhe yā hutāśe ca hvayate ||
madaśaktim anujjhantī yā rūpair bahubhiḥ sthitā ||
yām āsvādya vilāsinyo yathārthaṃ nāma bibhrati |
ekaṃ prasādya kurute yā dvayorapi nirvṛtim |
tṛṇavat puruṣā yuddhe yām āsvādya tyajantyasūn |
smṛtvā smṛtvā ca bahuśo viyuktaḥ śocate yayā ||
aprasannāpi yā prītyai prasannā svarga eva yā |
yā prītir yā ratir vā vāg yā puṣṭiriti ca stutā ||
pānapravṛttau satyāṃ tu tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet ||
vidhiyuktād ṛte madyād ye na sidhyanti dāruṇāḥ ||
asti dehasya sāvasthā yasyāṃ pānaṃ nivāryate |
madyaṃ sahāyam aprāpya samyak pariṇamet katham ||
rakṣatā jīvitaṃ tasmāt peyam ātmavatā sadā |
snātaḥ praṇamya suravipragurūn yathāsvaṃ vṛttiṃ vidhāya ca samastaparigrahasya |
vilāsinīnāṃ ca vilāsaśobhi gītaṃ sanṛtyaṃ kalatūryaghoṣaiḥ |
darśane .pi vidadhad vaśānugam svāditaṃ kim uta cittajanmanaḥ ||
sphāṭikaśuktigataṃ sataraṅgaṃ kāntam anaṅgam ivodvahad aṅgam ||
tālīśādyaṃ cūrṇam elādikaṃ vā hṛdyaṃ prāśya prāg vayaḥsthāpanaṃ vā |
tatprārthibhyo bhūmibhāge sumṛṣṭe toyonmiśraṃ dāpayitvā tataśca ||
pītvaivaṃ caṣakadvayaṃ parijanaṃ saṃmānya sarvaṃ tato gatvāhārabhuvaṃ puraḥ subhiṣajo bhuñjīta bhūyo .tra ca |
māṃsāpūpaghṛtārdrakādiharitair yuktaṃ sasauvarcalair dvis trir vā niśi cālpam eva vanitāsaṃvalganārthaṃ pibet ||
rahasi dayitām aṅke kṛtvā bhujāntarapīḍanāt pulakitatanuṃ jātasvedāṃ sakampapayodharām |
yadi sarabhasaṃ sīdhor vāraṃ na pāyayate kṛtī kim anubhavati kleśaprāyaṃ tato gṛhatantratām ||
bhavati ratiśrameṇa ca madaḥ pibato .lpam api |
kṣayam ata ojasaḥ pariharan sa śayīta param ||
itthaṃ yuktyā piban madyaṃ na trivargād vihīyate |
anyathā hi vipatsu syāt paścāt tāpendhanaṃ dhanam ||
tasmād vyavasthayā pānaṃ pānasya satataṃ hitam |
vidhir vasumatām eṣa bhaviṣyadvasavas tu ye |
yathopapatti tair madyaṃ pātavyaṃ mātrayā hitam ||
yāvad dṛṣṭer na saṃbhrāntir yāvan na kṣobhate manaḥ |
tāvad eva virantavyaṃ madyād ātmavatā sadā ||
paittiko bhāvitaścānnaiḥ piban madyaṃ na sīdati ||
ślaiṣmiko dhanvajair māṃsair madyaṃ māricikaiḥ saha ||
tatra vāte hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyaḥ paiṣṭikagauḍikam |
vātikas tu piben madhye samadoṣo yathecchayā ||
ṣaṣṭikāḥ śālayo raktā yavāḥ sarpiśca jīvanam ||
pibed vā mānuṣīkṣīraṃ tena dadyācca nāvanam |
durālabhāṃ vā mustaṃ vā śītena salilena vā |
pañca karmāṇi ceṣṭāni secanaṃ śoṇitasya ca |
āśu prayojyaṃ saṃnyāse sutīkṣṇaṃ nasyam añjanam |
sakthnoḥ śirodharāyāṃ ca parikṣiptam ṛju sthitam |
prāg dakṣiṇaṃ tato vāmam arśaḥ pṛṣṭhāgrajaṃ tataḥ ||
sasneham athavā kṣīraṃ tailaṃ vā vātanāśanam ||
svedayed anu piṇḍena dravasvedena vā punaḥ ||
rāsnāyā hapuṣāyā vā piṇḍair vā kārṣṇyagandhikaiḥ ||
karañjo bastamūtraṃ ca lepanaṃ śreṣṭham arśasām |
rakte duṣṭe bhiṣak tasmād raktam evāvasecayet |
pibaṃs tam eva tenaiva bhuñjāno gudajān jayet |
aśnan jīrṇe ca pathyāni mucyate hatanāmabhiḥ |
pibed aharahas takraṃ niranno vā prakāmataḥ |
saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā māsārdhaṃ māsam eva ca |
jīrṇe takre pradadyād vā takrapeyāṃ sasaindhavām ||
yūṣai rasair vā takrāḍhyaiḥ śālīn bhuñjīta mātrayā ||
srotaḥsu takraśuddheṣu raso dhātūn upaiti yaḥ |
tena puṣṭir balaṃ varṇaḥ paraṃ tuṣṭiśca jāyate ||
takraṃ vā dadhi vā tatra jātam arśoharaṃ pibet |
snehāḍhyaiḥ saktubhir yuktāṃ lavaṇāṃ vāruṇīṃ pibet ||
pakvāt khādet samadhunī dve dve hanti kaphodbhavān |
śreṣṭhārasena trivṛtāṃ pathyāṃ takreṇa vā saha ||
hate gudāśraye doṣe gudajā yānti saṃkṣayam |
dvipalāṃśaṃ pṛthak pādaśeṣe pūte guḍāt tule |
dattvā prasthaṃ ca dhātakyāḥ sthāpayed ghṛtabhājane ||
pakṣāt sa śīlito .riṣṭaḥ karotyagniṃ nihanti ca |
pālikān pādaśeṣe tu kṣiped guḍatulāṃ param |
pūrvavat sarvam asya syād ānulomitaras tvayam ||
prāgbhaktam ānulomyāya phalāmlaṃ vā pibed ghṛtam |
anyacca kaphavātaghnaṃ śākaṃ ca laghu bhedi ca |
sahiṅgu yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ dadhisaraiḥ saha ||
madirāṃ śārkaraṃ gauḍaṃ sīdhuṃ takraṃ tuṣodakam ||
ariṣṭaṃ mastu pānīyaṃ pānīyaṃ vālpakaṃ śṛtam |
pippalīṃ madanaṃ bilvaṃ śatāhvāṃ madhukaṃ vacām ||
kuṣṭhaṃ śaṭhīṃ puṣkarākhyaṃ citrakaṃ devadāru ca |
atha raktārśasāṃ vīkṣya mārutasya kaphasya vā ||
anubandhaṃ tataḥ snigdhaṃ rūkṣaṃ vā yojayeddhimam |
śakṛcchyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣam adho niryāti nānilaḥ ||
kaṭyūrugudaśūlaṃ ca hetur yadi ca rūkṣaṇam |
tatrānubandho vātasya śleṣmaṇo yadi viṭ ślathā ||
śvetā pītā guruḥ snigdhā sapicchaḥ stimito gudaḥ |
duṣṭe .sre śodhanaṃ kāryaṃ laṅghanaṃ ca yathābalam |
yāvacca doṣaiḥ kāluṣyaṃ srutes tāvad upekṣaṇam ||
yat tu prakṣīṇadoṣasya raktaṃ vātolbaṇasya vā |
yat tu pittolbaṇaṃ raktaṃ gharmakāle pravartate |
stambhanīyaṃ tad ekāntān na ced vātakaphānugam ||
paktvāvalehaṃ līḍhvā ca taṃ yathāgnibalaṃ pibet ||
peyāṃ maṇḍaṃ payaśchāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā chāgadugdhabhuk |
balavad raktapittaṃ ca sravad ūrdhvam adho .pi vā |
triṃśat palāni guḍato ghṛtāt pūte ca viṃśatiḥ |
tat pakvaṃ lehatāṃ yātaṃ dhānye pakṣasthitaṃ lihan ||
anamlo vā kadamlo vā savāstukaraso rasaḥ ||
raktaśāliḥ saro dadhnaḥ ṣaṣṭikas taruṇī surā |
sa jayatyulbaṇaṃ raktaṃ mārutaṃ ca prayojitaḥ ||
arśāṃsi tasmād adhikaṃ tajjaye yatnam ācaret ||
na ced evaṃ śamas tasya snigdhoṣṇais tarpayet tataḥ |
kṣīraśeṣe kaṣāye ca tasmin pūte vimiśrayet |
priyaṅguṃ kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ kamalasya ca kesaram |
dārvītvaṅ nāgaraṃ māṃsī citrako devadāru ca ||
susnigdhaiḥ svedayet piṇḍair vartim asmai gude tataḥ ||
eteṣām eva vā cūrṇaṃ gude nāḍyā vinirdhamet |
tadvighāte sutīkṣṇaṃ tu vastiṃ snigdhaṃ prapīḍayet ||
sa pītaḥ sarpiṣā yukto bhakte vā snigdhabhojinā |
sarvaṃ ca kuryād yat proktam arśasāṃ gāḍhavarcasām |
droṇe .pāṃ pūtivalkadvitulam atha pacet pādaśeṣe ca tasmin |
etan māsena jātaṃ janayati paramām ūṣmaṇaḥ paktiśaktiṃ |
droṇatraye .pi caraṇāvaśeṣe pūte śataṃ tatra guḍasya dadyāt ||
yuktaṃ kāmaṃ gaṇḍikābhis tathekṣoḥ sarpiḥpātre māsamātreṇa jātam ||
cukraṃ krakacam ivedaṃ durnāmnāṃ vahnidīpanaṃ paramam |
guḍapalaśatayojitaṃ nivāte nihitam idaṃ prapibaṃśca pakṣamātrāt |
niśamayati gudāṅkurān sagulmān analabalaṃ prabalaṃ karoti cāśu ||
dagdhe srute .nu kalaśena jalena pakve pādasthite guḍatulāṃ palapañcakaṃ ca ||
dadyāt pratyekaṃ vyoṣacavyābhayānāṃ vahner muṣṭī dve yavakṣārataśca |
darvīm ālimpan hanti līḍho guḍo .yaṃ gulmaplīhārśaḥkuṣṭhamehāgnisādān ||
toyadroṇe citrakamūlatulārdhaṃ sādhyaṃ yāvat pādadalastham athedam |
aṣṭau dattvā jīrṇaguḍasya palāni kvāthyaṃ bhūyaḥ sāndratayā samam etat ||
jayati gudajakuṣṭhaplīhagulmodarāṇi prabalayati hutāśaṃ śaśvad abhyasyamānaḥ ||
arśāṃsi hanti guṭikā tvagvikāraṃ ca śīlitā ||
cūrṇīkṛtāḥ ṣoḍaśa sūraṇasya bhāgās tato .rdhena ca citrakasya |
mahauṣadhād dvau maricasya caiko guḍena durnāmajayāya piṇḍī ||
vaḍabāmukha iva jarayati bahugurvapi bhojanaṃ cūrṇaḥ ||
piba saptadinaṃ mathitāluḍitān yadi marditum icchasi pāyuruhān ||
śuṣkeṣu bhallātakam agryam uktaṃ bhaiṣajyam ārdreṣu tu vatsakatvak |
sarveṣu sarvartuṣu kālaśeyam arśaḥsu balyaṃ ca malāpahaṃ ca ||
bhittvā vibandhān anulomanāya yan mārutasyāgnibalāya yacca |
tad annapānauṣadham arśasena sevyaṃ vivarjyaṃ viparītam asmāt ||
sanne .nale santi na santi dīpte rakṣed atas teṣu viśeṣato .gnim ||
na tu saṃgrahaṇaṃ yojyaṃ pūrvam āmātisāriṇi |
tathā sa śīghraṃ prāpnoti rucim agnibalaṃ balam |
peyāṃ yuñjyād viriktasya vātaghnair dīpanaiḥ kṛtām |
śālyodanaṃ tilair māṣair mudgair vā sādhu sādhitam |
dadhnaḥ saro .mlaḥ sasnehaḥ khalo hanti pravāhikām ||
piṣṭaiḥ ṣaḍguṇabilvais tair dadhni mudgarase guḍe ||
snehe ca yamake siddhaḥ khalo .yam aparājitaḥ |
dadhnaḥ saraṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ saguḍanāgaram |
surāṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭāṃ vyañjanārthaṃ prayojayet ||
phalāmlaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ yūṣaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā |
bhṛṣṭān vā yamake saktūn khāded vyoṣāvacūrṇitān ||
kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pītaṃ hanyād āmaṃ savedanam |
pippalyāḥ pibataḥ sūkṣmaṃ rajo maricajanma vā ||
ṣaḍbhiḥ śuṇṭhyāḥ palair dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ granthyagnisaindhavāt ||
taddhi vātajitām agryaṃ śūlaṃ ca viguṇo .nilaḥ ||
ko niṣṭanan prāṇiti koṣṭhaśūlī nāntarbahistailaparo yadi syāt ||
rase kolāmlacāṅgeryor dadhni piṣṭe ca nāgare |
praveśayed gudaṃ dhvastam abhyaktaṃ sveditaṃ mṛdu ||
tailaṃ paced gudabhraṃśaṃ pānābhyaṅgena taj jayet ||
paitte tu sāme tīkṣṇoṣṇavarjyaṃ prāg iva laṅghanam |
yo rasāśī jayecchīghraṃ sa paittaṃ jaṭharāmayam ||
doṣādhikyān na jāyeta balinaṃ taṃ virecayet ||
tato .nu koṣṇaṃ pātavyaṃ kṣīram eva yathābalam |
snāto bhuñjīta payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā ||
mṛlliptād agninā svinnād rasaṃ niṣpīḍitaṃ himam ||
dāruṇaṃ gudapākaṃ ca tatra chāgaṃ payo hitam |
raktātīsāraṃ hantyāśu tayā vā sādhitaṃ ghṛtam ||
ājena payasā pītaḥ sadyo raktaṃ niyacchati |
gudasya dāhe pāke vā sekalepā hitā himāḥ ||
yadā vibaddho vāyuśca kṛcchrāccarati vā na vā ||
raktaṃ viṭsahitaṃ pūrvaṃ paścād vā yo .tisāryate |
ahorātraṃ jale tapte ghṛtaṃ tenāmbhasā pacet ||
adho vā yadi vāpyūrdhvaṃ yasya raktaṃ pravartate ||
kaṇāṃ madhuyutāṃ līḍhvā takraṃ pītvā sacitrakam ||
kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi pūrvoktam amlaṃ lākṣādi ṣaṭpalam |
sa balī sahasā hanyāt tasmāt taṃ tvarayā jayet ||
jayet pūrvaṃ trayāṇāṃ vā bhaved yo balavattamaḥ ||
bhīśokābhyām api calaḥ śīghraṃ kupyatyatas tayoḥ |
yasyoccārād vinā mūtraṃ pavano vā pravartate |
dadyāt sātiviṣāṃ peyām āme sāmlāṃ sanāgarām |
column5: dadyāt sātiviṣāṃ peyāṃ sāme sāmlāṃ sanāgarām |

column3: paṭūni pañca dvau kṣārau maricaṃ pañcakolakam ||
guḍena vaṭakān kṛtvā triguṇena sadā bhajet ||
pakvena vaṭakāḥ kāryā guḍena sitayāpi vā |
paraṃ hi vahnisaṃparkāl laghimānaṃ bhajanti te ||
dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā saṃsnehya svinnābhyaktaṃ nirūhayet ||
nirūḍhaṃ ca viriktaṃ ca samyak cāpyanuvāsitam |
kāñjikena ca tat pakvam agnidīptikaraṃ param ||
vāte śleṣmāvṛte sāme kaphe vā vāyunoddhate |
agner nirvāpakaṃ pittaṃ rekeṇa vamanena vā ||
annaiḥ saṃdhukṣayed agniṃ cūrṇaiḥ snehaiśca tiktakaiḥ ||
cūrṇitaṃ madhunā lehyaṃ peyaṃ madyair jalena vā |
kuṭajatvakphalaṃ tiktā dhātakī ca kṛtaṃ rajaḥ |
kaṭukāṃ rohiṇīṃ mustāṃ nimbaṃ ca dvipalāṃśakān |
droṇe .pāṃ sādhayet tena pacet sarpiḥ picūnmitaiḥ ||
pittagrahaṇyāṃ tat peyaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ tiktakaṃ ca yat ||
kumbhe māsaṃ sthitaṃ jātam āsavaṃ taṃ prayojayet ||
tat piban grahaṇīdoṣān jayet sarvān hitāśanaḥ |
pibet pāṇitalaṃ tasmiñ jīrṇe syān madhurāśanaḥ ||
dve haridre vacā kuṣṭhaṃ citrakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī ||
vārtākakuḍavaṃ cārkād aṣṭau dve citrakāt pale |
ślaiṣmike grahaṇīdoṣe savāte tair ghṛtaṃ pacet ||
saptalāṃ kaṇṭakārīṃ ca citrakaṃ caikato dahet |
yo .lpāgnitvāt kaphe kṣīṇe varcaḥ pakvam api ślatham ||
muñcet paṭvauṣadhayutaṃ sa pibed alpaśo ghṛtam |
samāno dīpayatyagnim agneḥ saṃdhukṣako hi saḥ |
sa ghṛtaṃ lavaṇair yuktaṃ naro .nnāvagrahaṃ pibet |
raukṣyān mande .nale sarpis tailaṃ vā dīpanaiḥ pibet ||
annāvapīḍitaṃ balyaṃ dīpanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca tat ||
yadā kṣīṇe kaphe pittaṃ svasthāne pavanānugam |
paktvānnam āśu dhātūṃśca sarvān ojaśca saṃkṣipan |
mārayet syāt sa nā svastho bhukte jīrṇe tu tāmyati ||
payaḥ sahamadhūcchiṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tṛṣitaḥ pibet ||
yat kiṃcid guru medyaṃ ca śleṣmakāri ca bhojanam |
sarvaṃ tad atyagnihitaṃ bhuktvā ca svapanaṃ divā ||
etat prakṛtyaiva viruddham annaṃ saṃyogasaṃskāravaśena cedam |
ityādi avijñāya yatheṣṭaceṣṭāścaranti yat sāgnibalasya śaktiḥ ||
tasmād agniṃ pālayet sarvayatnais tasmin naṣṭe yāti nā nāśam eva |
doṣair graste grasyate rogasaṃghair yukte tu syān nīrujo dīrghajīvī ||
saha tailaphalair yuñjyāt sāmlāni snehavanti ca ||
toyena kalkaṃ drākṣāyāḥ pibet paryuṣitena vā ||
yavānāṃ vikṛtīḥ kṣāraṃ kālaśeyaṃ ca śīlayet ||
tair vā peyāṃ pravālaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā |
pibed guḍopadaṃśān vā lihyād etān pṛthak pṛthak |
yavāḥ kulatthāḥ kolāni varuṇaḥ katakāt phalam ||
bhinatti vātasambhūtāṃ tat pītaṃ śīghram aśmarīm ||
kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaro guṇṭha itkaṭo moraṭo .śmabhit |
punarnave śirīṣaśca teṣāṃ kvāthe paced ghṛtam ||
bhinatti kaphajām āśu sādhitaṃ ghṛtam aśmarīm ||

column5: tatsiddhaṃ vā pibet kṣīraṃ vedanābhir upadrutaḥ ||

column3: toyaṃ payo vā sarpir vā sarvamūtravikārajit ||
rasaṃ vā dhanvayāsasya kaṣāyaṃ kakubhasya vā |
madyaṃ vā nigadaṃ pītvā rathenāśvena vā vrajet ||
rekārthaṃ tailvakaṃ sarpir vastikarma ca śīlayet |
pumān sutṛpto vṛṣyāṇāṃ māṃsānāṃ kukkuṭasya ca ||
akriyāyāṃ dhruvo mṛtyuḥ kriyāyāṃ saṃśayo bhavet ||
column5: akriyāyāṃ dhruvo mṛtyuḥ kriyāyāṃ saṃśayo bhavet |

column3: nābheḥ samantād abhyajyād adhas tasyāśca vāmataḥ ||
śalyaṃ syāt sevanīṃ muktvā yavamātreṇa pāṭayet |
aśmamānena na yathā bhidyate sā tathāharet ||
samagraṃ sarpavaktreṇa strīṇāṃ vastis tu pārśvagaḥ |
nyased ato .nyathā hyāsāṃ mūtrasrāvī vraṇo bhavet |
vastibhedo .śmarīhetuḥ siddhiṃ yāti na tu dvidhā |
tathā na pūryate .sreṇa vastiḥ pūrṇe tu pīḍayet |
dvau kālau saghṛtāṃ koṣṇāṃ yavāgūṃ mūtraśodhanaiḥ ||
taṃ vastibhir na cārohed varṣaṃ rūḍhavraṇo .pi saḥ |
nyagrodhādes tu pittārtaṃ rasaiḥ śuddhaṃ ca tarpayet ||
madhuyuktaṃ guḍūcyā vā rasam āmalakasya vā |
tiktaṃ śākaṃ madhu śreṣṭhā bhakṣyāḥ śuṣkāḥ sasaktavaḥ |
yaveṣu sukṛtān saktūn sakṣaudrān sīdhunā pibet ||
tailaṃ vātakaphe pitte ghṛtaṃ miśreṣu miśrakam |
karañjau varuṇān mūlaṃ pippalyāḥ pauṣkaraṃ ca yat ||
prasthaṃ ghṛtāj jayet sarvāṃs tan mehān piṭikā viṣam |
śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ vamiṃ vṛddhiṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam |
yavānīṃ pauṣkaraṃ pāṭhāṃ granthiṃ cavyaṃ phalatrayam ||
dvau prasthau mākṣikāt kṣiptvā rakṣet pakṣam upekṣayā ||
dvivahe .pāṃ kṣipet tatra pādasthe dve śate guḍāt ||
ayaskṛtiḥ sthitā pītā pūrvasmād adhikā guṇaiḥ ||
rūkṣam udvartanaṃ gāḍhaṃ vyāyāmo niśi jāgaraḥ |
yojanānāṃ śataṃ yāyāt khaned vā salilāśayān |
apakvā vraṇavat pakvās tāsāṃ prāgrūpam eva ca |
tīkṣṇaṃ ca śodhanaṃ prāyo durvirecyā hi mehinaḥ |
pratataṃ ca hared raktaṃ pakve tu vraṇavat kriyā ||
ghṛtaṃ virecanadravyaiḥ siddhaṃ tābhyāṃ ca pāyayet |
nirūhaṃ snehavastiṃ ca tābhyām eva prakalpayet ||
masūrān nistuṣād aṣṭau tatkvāthaḥ saghṛto jayet |
paced ekatra saṃyojya tad ghṛtaṃ pūrvavad guṇaiḥ ||
pakvaḥ syād vidradhiṃ bhittvā vraṇavat tam upācaret |
pakvaḥ srotāṃsi sampūrya sa yātyūrdhvam adho .thavā |
daśāhaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā rakṣan bhiṣag upadravāt |
pāyayen madhuśigruṃ vā yavāgūṃ tena vā kṛtām |
śodhayed balataḥ śuddhaḥ sakṣaudraṃ tiktakaṃ pibet ||
kaṣāyair yaugikair yuñjyāt svaiḥ svais tadvacchilājatu |
pākaṃ ca vārayed yatnāt siddhiḥ pakve hi daivikī ||
stanaje vraṇavat sarvaṃ na tvenam upanāhayet |
śophavraṇakriyāṃ kuryāt pratataṃ ca hared asṛk ||
pakve ca pāṭite tailam iṣyate vraṇaśodhanam |
tailam ā vraṇasaṃdhānāt snehasvedau ca śīlayet ||
prastham eraṇḍatailasya dvau ghṛtāt payasas tathā |
vastikarma puraḥ kṛtvā vaṅkṣaṇasthaṃ tato dahet ||
aṅguṣṭhasyopari snāva pītaṃ tantusamaṃ ca yat ||
utkṣipya sūcyā tat tiryag dahecchittvā yato gadaḥ |
gulme .nyair vātakaphaje plīhni cāyaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
srotasāṃ mārdavaṃ kṛtvā jitvā mārutam ulbaṇam |
bhittvā vibandhaṃ snigdhasya svedo gulmam apohati ||
vastikarma paraṃ vidyād gulmaghnaṃ taddhi mārutam |
svasthāne prathamaṃ jitvā sadyo gulmam apohati ||
column5: sve sthāne prathamaṃ jitvā sadyo gulmamapohati ||

column3: sājājīsaindhavair dadhnā dugdhena ca rasena ca ||
dāḍimān mūlakāt kolāt pacet sarpir nihanti tat |
daśamūlaṃ balāṃ kālāṃ suṣavīṃ dvau punarnavau ||
yavaiḥ kolaiḥ kulatthaiśca māṣaiśca prāsthikaiḥ saha |
rogān āśutarān pūrvān kaṣṭān api ca śīlitam ||
ṣaṭpalaṃ vā pibet sarpir yad uktaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi |
prasannayā vā kṣīrārthaḥ surayā dāḍimena vā ||
column5: prasannayā vā kṣīrārthaṃ surayā dāḍimena vā |

column3: ghṛte mārutagulmaghnaḥ kāryo dadhnaḥ sareṇa vā |
vātagulme kapho vṛddho hatvāgnim aruciṃ yadi ||
hṛllāsaṃ gauravaṃ tandrāṃ janayed ullikhet tu tam |
maṇḍena vā pibet prātaścūrṇānyannasya vā puraḥ |
kṛcchrān gulmān vātaviṇmūtrasaṅgaṃ kaṇṭhe bandhaṃ hṛdgrahaṃ pāṇḍurogam |
trikaṭukam ajamodā saindhavaṃ jīrake dve samadharaṇaghṛtānām aṣṭamo hiṅgubhāgaḥ |
prathamakavaḍabhojyaḥ sarpiṣā samprayukto janayati jaṭharāgniṃ vātagulmaṃ nihanti ||
pītaḥ koṣṇajalena koṣṭhajarujo gulmodarādīn ayaṃ śārdūlaḥ prasabhaṃ pramathya harati vyādhīn mṛgaughān iva ||
hiṅgutriguṇaṃ saindhavam asmāt triguṇaṃ ca tailam airaṇḍam ||
śuṇṭhyāḥ karṣaṃ guḍasya dvau dhautāt kṛṣṇatilāt palam ||
śleṣmaṇyanubale vāyau pitte tu payasā saha ||
vivṛddhaṃ yadi vā pittaṃ saṃtāpaṃ vātagulminaḥ |
hṛdrogaṃ vidradhiṃ śoṣaṃ sādhayatyāśu tat payaḥ |
gulmaṃ jaṭharam ānāhaṃ pītam ekatra sādhayet |
vātagulmī pibed vāṭyam udāvarte tu bhojayet |
snigdhaṃ paippalikair yūṣair mūlakānāṃ rasena vā ||
paced viḍaṅgaṃ vyāghrīṃ ca pālikāni jalāḍhake ||
mitam uṣṇaṃ dravaṃ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ vātagulminām |
samaṇḍā vāruṇī pānaṃ taptaṃ vā dhānyakair jalam ||
paraṃ saṃśamanaṃ sarpis tiktaṃ vāsāghṛtaṃ śṛtam ||
śṛtaṃ tenaiva vā kṣīraṃ nyagrodhādigaṇena vā ||
pathyāpādaṃ pibet sarpis tat siddhaṃ pittagulmanut ||
pibed vā tailvakaṃ sarpir yaccoktaṃ pittavidradhau |
drākṣāṃ payasyāṃ madhukaṃ candanaṃ padmakaṃ madhu ||
pibed upari tasyoṣṇaṃ kṣīram eva yathābalam ||
dāhe .bhyaṅgo ghṛtaiḥ śītaiḥ sājyair lepo himauṣadhaiḥ ||
chinnamūlā vidahyante na gulmā yānti ca kṣayam ||
column5: chinnamūlā vidahyante na gulmā yānti ca kṣayam |

column3: raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti tacca nāsti na cāsti ruk |
column5: raktaṃ hi vyamlatāṃ yāti tacca nāsti na cāsti ruk ||

column3: dhātrī parūṣakaṃ drākṣā kharjūraṃ dāḍimaṃ sitā |
nigūḍhaṃ yadi vonnaddhaṃ stimitaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sthiram ||
alpaṃ toyāḍhake sādhyaṃ pādaśeṣeṇa tena ca ||
tato .sya gulme dehe ca samaste svedam ācaret ||
yā kriyā kriyate yāti sā siddhiṃ na virūkṣite ||
vastrāntaraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhindyād gulmaṃ pramāṇavit |
pramṛjyād gulmam evaikaṃ na tvantrahṛdayaṃ spṛśet |
evaṃ ca visṛtaṃ sthānāt kaphagulmaṃ virecanaiḥ ||
siddho .yaṃ miśrakaḥ sneho gulmināṃ sraṃsanaṃ hitam ||
citrakasya tathā pathyās tāvatīs tadrase srute |
dviprasthe sādhayet pūte kṣiped dantīsamaṃ guḍam ||
kaṇākarṣau tathā śuṇṭhyāḥ siddhe lehe tu śītale ||
gomūtreṇa pibed ekaṃ tena guggulum eva vā ||
ghaṭasyāntaḥ pacet pakvam agnivarṇe ghaṭe ca tam |
śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikā jīrṇāḥ kulatthā jāṅgalaṃ palam ||
vyoṣaṃ takraṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ bhaktaṃ pānaṃ tu vāruṇī ||
pañcamūlaśṛtaṃ vāri jīrṇaṃ mārdvīkam eva vā ||
ślaiṣmiko baddhamūlatvād yadi gulmo na śāmyati |
tasya dāhaṃ hṛte rakte kuryād ante śarādibhiḥ ||
tato .gnivege śamite śītair vraṇa iva kriyā |
svaṃ svaṃ kuryāt kramaṃ miśraṃ miśradoṣe ca kālavit |
pānaṃ raktabhave gulme naṣṭe puṣpe ca yoṣitaḥ |
kṣāreṇa yuktaṃ palalaṃ sudhākṣīreṇa vā tataḥ |
tābhyāṃ vā bhāvitān dadyād yonau kaṭukamatsyakān ||
kiṇvaṃ vā saguḍakṣāraṃ dadyād yonau viśuddhaye ||
rasaudanas tathāhāraḥ pānaṃ ca taruṇī surā ||
pāyayet tailam airaṇḍaṃ samūtraṃ sapayo .pi vā |
māsaṃ dvau vāthavā gavyaṃ mūtraṃ māhiṣam eva vā ||
caturguṇe jale mūtre dviguṇe citrakāt pale |
kalke siddhaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ sakṣāraṃ jaṭharī pibet ||
surāsauvīrakābhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ vā pāyayed ghṛtam ||
ebhiḥ snigdhāya saṃjāte bale śānte ca mārute |
paṭolamūlaṃ triphalāṃ niśāṃ vellaṃ ca kārṣikam |
pibet saṃcūrṇya mūtreṇa peyāpūrvaṃ tato rasaiḥ |
śṛtaṃ pibed vyoṣayutaṃ pītam evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
gavākṣīṃ śaṅkhinīṃ dantīṃ tilvakasya tvacaṃ vacām |
dvau kṣārau pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇapañcakam ||
viḍaṅgaṃ ca samāṃśāni dantyā bhāgatrayaṃ tathā |
trāyantīṃ rohiṇīṃ tiktāṃ sātalāṃ trivṛtāṃ vacām ||
kārabhaṃ gavyam ājaṃ vā dadyād ātyayike gade ||
nidhāpayet tato māsād uddhṛtaṃ gālitaṃ pacet ||
hantyetat kuṣṭham unmādam apasmāraṃ ca pānataḥ |
jātaṃ mathitvā tatsarpis trivṛtsiddhaṃ ca tadguṇam |
eṣāṃ cānu pibet peyāṃ rasaṃ svādu payo .thavā ||
pibed ambu tataḥ peyāṃ tato yūṣaṃ kulatthajam ||
pibed rūkṣas tryahaṃ tvevaṃ bhūyo vā pratibhojitaḥ |
tailvakaṃ nīlinīsarpiḥ snehaṃ vā miśrakaṃ pibet ||
tadvad vā gugguluṃ kṣīraṃ tulyārdrakarasaṃ tathā ||
viḍaṅgaṃ citrako dantī cavyaṃ vyoṣaṃ ca taiḥ payaḥ |
kalkaiḥ kolasamaiḥ pītvā pravṛddham udaraṃ jayet ||
yadi kuryāt tatas tailaṃ bilvakṣārānvitam pibet ||
kaphe vātena pitte vā tābhyāṃ vāpyāvṛte .nile |
vāsasā veṣṭayed evaṃ vāyur nādhmāpayet punaḥ ||
suviriktasya yasya syād ādhmānaṃ punareva tam |
iti sāmānyataḥ proktāḥ siddhā jaṭhariṇāṃ kriyāḥ |
prāg utkleśān nivartyaṃ ca bale labdhe kramāt payaḥ ||
jāte cāgnibale snigdhaṃ bhūyo bhūyo virecayet |
punaḥ kṣīraṃ punar vastiṃ punareva virecanam |
krameṇa dhruvam ātiṣṭhan yattaḥ pittodaraṃ jayet ||
śuṇṭhīṃ mādrīṃ ghanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ saralaṃ paṭupañcakam |
udaraṃ gulmam aṣṭhīlāṃ tūṇyau śophaṃ viṣūcikām |
dadyād āpṛcchya tajjñātīn pātuṃ madyena kalkitam |
yasmin vā kupitaḥ sarpo vimuñcati phale viṣam ||
hṛtadoṣaṃ tu śītāmbusnātaṃ taṃ pāyayet payaḥ ||
peyāṃ vā trivṛtaḥ śākaṃ māṇḍūkyā vāstukasya vā |
māsam ekaṃ tataścaiva tṛṣitaḥ svarasaṃ pibet ||
evaṃ vinirhṛte śākair doṣe māsāt paraṃ tataḥ |
labdhe bale ca bhūyo .pi snehapītaṃ viśodhitam |
viḍaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ saktūn saghṛtān saindhavaṃ vacām ||
musalena pīḍito .nu ca yāti plīhā payobhujo nāśam |
pālikaiḥ pañcakolais tu taiḥ samastaiśca tulyayā |
tailaṃ pakvaṃ jayet pānāt plīhānaṃ kaphavātajam |
yakṛti plīhavat karma dakṣiṇe tu bhuje sirām ||
jātaṃ jātaṃ jalaṃ srāvyam evaṃ tad yāpayed bhiṣak ||
aktāni madhusarpirbhyām atha sīvyed bahir vraṇam ||
nidhāya tasmin nāḍīṃ ca srāvayed ardham ambhasaḥ ||
athāsya nāḍīm ākṛṣya tailena lavaṇena ca |
vraṇam abhyajya baddhvā ca veṣṭayed vāsasodaram ||
tṛtīye .hni caturthe vā yāvad ā ṣoḍaśaṃ dinam |
tasya viśramya viśramya srāvayed alpaśo jalam ||
syāt kṣīravṛttiḥ ṣaṇmāsāṃstrīn peyāṃ payasā pibet |
vahnir mandatvam āyāti doṣaiḥ kukṣau prapūrite ||
tasmād bhojyāni bhojyāni dīpanāni laghūni ca |
bhāvitānāṃ gavāṃ mūtre ṣaṣṭikānāṃ ca taṇḍulaiḥ |
yavāgūṃ payasā siddhāṃ prakāmaṃ bhojayen naram ||
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ vrajantyeṣāṃ vātapittakaphās tathā ||
prayogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām anu kṣīraṃ prayojayet |
dāḍimāt kuḍavo dhānyāt kuḍavārdhaṃ palaṃ palam |
snehitaṃ vāmayet tīkṣṇaiḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ ca śodhayet |
drākṣāñjaliṃ vā mṛditaṃ tat pibet pāṇḍurogajit ||
mūtreṇa piṣṭāṃ pathyāṃ vā tatsiddhaṃ vā phalatrayam |
gomūtrāñjalinā piṣṭaṃ śṛtaṃ tenaiva vā pibet |
sādhitaṃ kṣīram ebhir vā pibed doṣānulomanam ||
mūtre sthitaṃ vā saptāhaṃ payasāyorajaḥ pibet |
jīrṇe kṣīreṇa bhuñjīta rasena madhureṇa vā ||
pītvā taccūrṇam ambhobhiḥ sukhair lihyāt tato madhu ||
pāṇḍurogaṃ jvaraṃ dāhaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsam arocakam |
tāpyaṃ dārvyās tvacaṃ cavyaṃ granthikaṃ devadāru ca ||
prakṣipya vaṭakān kuryāt tān khādet takrabhojanaḥ ||
arśāṃsi kāmalāṃ mehān plīhānaṃ śamayanti ca |
pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ yakṣmāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ jvaram |
tān bhakṣayitvānupiben niranno bhukta eva vā |
dvipalaṃ madhukaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ tvakkṣīrīṃ ca vicūrṇitam |
vikalpya yojyaṃ viduṣā pṛthag doṣabalaṃ prati ||
mṛdaṃ niryāpayet kāyāt tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaiḥ puraḥ |
balādhānāni sarpīṃṣi śuddhe koṣṭhe tu yojayet ||
vṛścikālī ca bhārgī ca sakṣīrais taiḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam |
kumbhasya cūrṇaṃ sakṣaudraṃ traiphalena rasena vā |
triphalāyā guḍūcyā vā dārvyā nimbasya vā rasam ||
tilapiṣṭanibhaṃ yas tu kāmalāvān sṛjen malam |
kaphasaṃmūrchito vāyur yadā pittaṃ bahiḥ kṣipet ||
svaṃ pittam eti tenāsya śakṛd apyanurajyate |
māsaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ vā kiṭṭaṃ vātha hiraṇyajam |
drākṣālehaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ sarpīṃṣi madhurāṇi ca |
sāme viśoṣito bhuktvā laghu koṣṇāmbhasā pibet ||
sakāmalāśoṣamanovikārān kāsaṃ kaphaṃ caiva jayet prayogaḥ ||
ghṛtam ārdrakanāgarasya kalkasvarasābhyāṃ payasā ca sādhayitvā |
mūtraṃ gor vā mahiṣyā vā sakṣīraṃ kṣīrabhojanaḥ |
pakvaṃ sacitrakaṃ tadvad guṇair yuñjyācca kālavit ||
dattvā guḍatulāṃ tasmin lehe dadyād vicūrṇitam |
prasthārdhaṃ ca hime kṣaudrāt tan nihantyupayojitam |
kuryād abhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ lepaṃ snānāya tūdakam ||
tailam eraṇḍajaṃ vātaviḍvibandhe tad eva tu ||
prāgbhaktaṃ payasā yuktaṃ rasair vā kārayet tathā |
paitte tiktaṃ pibet sarpir nyagrodhādyena vā śṛtam ||
dāru dārvī himaṃ dantī viśālā niculaṃ kaṇā |
śophaṃ tridoṣaṃ cirajaṃ pravṛddhaṃ nighnanti bhūnimbamahauṣadhe ca ||
iti nijam adhikṛtya pathyam uktaṃ kṣatajanite kṣatajaṃ viśodhanīyam |
gauḍaṃ piṣṭānnaṃ dadhi salavaṇaṃ vijjalaṃ madyam amlam |
dhānā vallūraṃ samaśanam atho gurvasātmyaṃ vidāhi |
svapnaṃ cārātrau śvayathugadavān varjayen maithunaṃ ca ||
raktāvaseko vamanaṃ virekaḥ snehanaṃ na tu ||
rasena yuktaṃ trāyantyā drākṣāyās traiphalena vā |
śākhāduṣṭe tu rudhire raktam evādito haret |
ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ mahātiktaṃ śṛtaṃ vā trāyamāṇayā ||
surāhvā kṛṣṇagandhā ca kuṣṭhaṃ cālepanaṃ cale ||
padminīkardamaḥ śītaḥ piṣṭaṃ mauktikam eva vā ||
śaṅkhaḥ pravālaṃ śuktir vā gairikaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam |
yojyāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe .nye .nye mandavīryās ta eva ca |
ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhir vividhābhir bale sthitaḥ |
athāsya dāhaḥ kṣāreṇa śarair hemnāpi vā hitaḥ |
pākibhiḥ pācayitvā vā pāṭayitvā tam uddharet ||
na ghṛtaṃ bahudoṣāya deyaṃ yan na virecanam |
tatra vātottare tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ hitam ||
parpaṭaṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca palāṃśaṃ pācayed apām |
sarpiṣo dvādaśapalaṃ pacet tat tiktakaṃ jayet ||
triphalā padmakaṃ pāṭhā rajanyau śārive kaṇe ||
piban kuṣṭhaṃ jayatyāśu bhajan sakhadiraṃ jalam |
snigdhasya śodhanaṃ yojyaṃ visarpe yad udāhṛtam |
prabhañjanas tathā hyasya na syād dehaprabhañjanaḥ ||
piṣṭaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiṣaḥ prastham ebhiḥ krūre koṣṭhe snehanaṃ recanaṃ ca |
dantyāḍhakam apāṃ droṇe paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet |
pītvā tad ekadivasāntaritaṃ sujīrṇe bhuñjīta kodravam asaṃskṛtakāñjikena |
kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsam apacīṃ ca vijetum icchan icchan prajāṃ ca vipulāṃ grahaṇaṃ smṛtiṃ ca ||
syus trāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca bhāgārdhike nāgarapādayukte ||
etat palaṃ jarjaritaṃ vipakvaṃ jale pibed doṣaviśodhanāya |
kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsaṃ grahaṇīpradoṣam arśāṃsi kṛcchrāṇi halīmakaṃ ca |
guḍasya ca dvādaśa māsam eṣa jitātmanāṃ hantyupayujyamānaḥ ||
siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāha yakṣo mumukṣor bhikṣoḥ prāṇān māṇibhadraḥ kilemam ||
kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaphapittakuṣṭhaṃ susevito dharma ivocchinatti ||
ebhireva ca śṛtaṃ ghṛtam ukhyaṃ bheṣajair jayati mārutakuṣṭham |
kuṣṭhī pītvā māsam aruk syād gudakīlī mehī śophī pāṇḍurajīrṇī kṛmimāṃśca ||
raktā nimbaṃ surataru kṛtaṃ pañcamūlyau ca cūrṇaṃ pītvā māsaṃ jayati hitabhug gavyamūtreṇa kuṣṭham ||
gavāmbupītaṃ vaṭakīkṛtaṃ tathā nihanti kuṣṭhāni sudāruṇānyapi ||
guṭikā rasāyanaṃ kuṣṭhajicca vṛṣyā ca saptasamā ||
sāyomalā sāmalakā satailā kuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi nihanti līḍhā ||
mustaṃ vyoṣaṃ triphalā mañjiṣṭhā dāru pañcamūle dve |
iti doṣe vijite .ntastvaksthe śamanaṃ bahiḥ pralepādi hitam |
tīkṣṇālepotkliṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hi vivṛddhim eti maline dehe ||
svinnotsannaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śastrair likhitaṃ pralepanair limpet ||
yeṣu na śastraṃ kramate sparśendriyanāśaneṣu kuṣṭheṣu |
teṣu nipātyaḥ kṣāro raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya ||
lepo .tikaṭhinaparuṣe supte kuṣṭhe sthire purāṇe ca |
mustā triphalā madanaṃ karañja āragvadhaḥ kaliṅgayavāḥ |
eṣa kaṣāyo vamanaṃ virecanaṃ varṇakas tathodgharṣaḥ |
piṣṭā ca kākamācī caturvidhaḥ kuṣṭhahā lepaḥ ||
nimbaṃ haridre surasaṃ paṭolaṃ kuṣṭhāśvagandhe suradāru śigruḥ |
column5: kuṣṭhaṃ haridre surasaṃ paṭolaṃ nimbāśvagandhe suradāruśigrū |

column3: sasarṣapaṃ tumburudhānyavanyaṃ caṇḍā ca cūrṇāni samāni kuryāt ||
tais takrapiṣṭaiḥ prathamaṃ śarīraṃ tailāktam udvartayituṃ yateta |
tathāsya kaṇḍūḥ piṭikāḥ sakoṭhāḥ kuṣṭhāni śophāśca śamaṃ vrajanti ||
dadrūḥ sakaṇḍūḥ kiṭibhāni pāmā vicarcikā ceti tathā na santi ||
lepād vicarcikāṃ hanti rāgavega iva trapām ||
manaḥśilāle maricāni tailam ārkaṃ payaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ pradehaḥ |
column5: manaḥśilāle maricāni tailamārkaṃ payaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ pradehaḥ |

column3: dinakarakarābhitaptaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ ca naṣṭaṃ ca ||
tailena yuktam uṣitaṃ saptāhaṃ bhājane tāmre ||
māsān navaṃ kilāsaṃ snānena vinā viśuddhasya ||
jīvantī mañjiṣṭhā dārvī kampillakaṃ payas tuttham |
eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ siddhaḥ siddhe ca sarjarasaḥ ||
deyaḥ samadhūcchiṣṭo vipādikā tena naśyati hyaktā |
mūlaṃ saptāhvāt tvak śirīṣāśvamārād arkān mālatyāścitrakāsphotanimbāt |
bījaṃ kārañjaṃ sārṣapaṃ prāpunāṭam śreṣṭhā jantughnaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ dve haridre ||
tailaṃ tailaṃ sādhitaṃ taiḥ samūtrais tvagdoṣāṇāṃ duṣṭanāḍīvraṇānām |
tailaṃ siddhaṃ viṣāpaham abhyaṅgāt kuṣṭhajit param ||
lākṣā vyoṣaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca bījaṃ saśrīveṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhasiddhārthakāśca |
takronmiśraḥ syāddharidrā ca lepo dadrūṣūkto mūlakotthaṃ ca bījam ||
khadiro dhavaśca lepaḥ śyāmā dantī dravantī ca ||
klede prapatati cāṅge dāhe visphoṭake ca carmadale |
doṣe hṛte .panīte rakte bāhyāntare kṛte śamane |
snehe ca kālayukte na kuṣṭham ativartate sādhyam ||
doṣe hyatimātrahṛte vāyur hanyād abalam āśu ||
śuddhir mūrdhni syāt trirātrāt trirātrāt ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe māsyasṛṅmokṣaṇaṃ ca ||
yo durvānto durvirikto .thavā syāt kuṣṭhī doṣairuddhatair vyāpyate .sau |
niḥsaṃdehaṃ yātyasādhyatvam evaṃ tasmāt kṛtsnān nirhared asya doṣān ||
kuṣṭhād api bībhatsaṃ yacchīghrataraṃ ca yātyasādhyatvam |
śvitram atas tacchāntyai yateta dīpte yathā bhavane ||
saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣāt prayojayet pūrvam eva dehasya |
śvitre sraṃsanam agryaṃ malayūrasa iṣyate saguḍaḥ ||
seveta viriktatanus tryahaṃ pipāsuḥ pibet peyām ||
śvitre .ṅge ye sphoṭā jāyante kaṇṭakena tān bhindyāt |
sphoṭeṣu niḥsruteṣu prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet tridinam ||
malayūm asanaṃ priyaṅguṃ śatapuṣpāṃ cāmbhasā samutkvāthya |
pītvoṣṇasthitasya jāte sphoṭe takreṇa bhojanaṃ nirlavaṇam ||
gavyaṃ mūtraṃ citrakavyoṣayuktaṃ sarpiḥkumbhe sthāpitaṃ kṣaudramiśram |
pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ śvitriṇā peyam etat kāryaṃ cāsmai kuṣṭhadiṣṭaṃ vidhānam ||
column5: pakṣādūrdhvaṃ śvitribhiḥ peyametat kuryāccāsmin kuṣṭhadiṣṭaṃ vidhānam ||

column3: mārkavam athavā khāded bhṛṣṭaṃ tailena lohapātrastham |
dvaipaṃ dagdhaṃ carma mātaṅgajaṃ vā śvitre lepas tailayukto variṣṭhaḥ |
pūtiḥ kīṭo rājavṛkṣodbhavena kṣāreṇāktaḥ śvitram eko .pi hanti ||
column5: pūtiḥ kīṭo rājavṛkṣodbhavena kṣāreṇāktaḥ śvitrameko nihanti ||

column3: rātrau gomūtre vāsitān jarjarāṅgān ahni chāyāyāṃ śoṣayet sphoṭahetūn |
evaṃ vārāṃs trīṃs tais tataḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ snuhyāḥ kṣīreṇa śvitranāśāya lepaḥ ||
śikhipittaṃ tathā dagdhaṃ hrīveraṃ vā tadāplutam ||
mūtreṇa gavāṃ piṣṭaḥ savarṇakaraṇaṃ paraṃ śvitre ||
kṣāre sudagdhe gajaliṇḍaje ca gajasya mūtreṇa parisrute ca |
droṇapramāṇe daśabhāgayuktaṃ dattvā paced bījam avalgujānām ||
śvitraṃ jayeccikkaṇatāṃ gatena tena pralimpan bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭaṃ |
kuṣṭhaṃ maṣaṃ vā tilakālakaṃ vā yad vā vraṇe syād adhimāṃsajātam ||
tutthaṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇāni pañca kṣāradvayaṃ lāṅgalikāṃ ca paktvā ||
snugarkadugdhe ghanam āyasasthaṃ śalākayā tad vidadhīta lepam |
kuṣṭhe kilāse tilakālakeṣu maṣeṣu durnāmasu carmakīle ||
tasminn eva nirūḍhaṃ taṃ pāyayeta virecanam ||
sakṣaudraṃ surasādīn vā lihyāt kṣaudrayutān pṛthak |
kṛmimān madhunā lihyād bhāvitaṃ vā varārasaiḥ |
śirogateṣu kṛmiṣu cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ ca tat ||
paktvā pūpalikāṃ khādeddhānyāmlaṃ ca pibed anu ||
dinam āruṣkaraṃ tailaṃ pāne vastau ca yojayet |
kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti |
samāsato .mlān madhurān rasāṃśca kṛmīñ jihāsuḥ parivarjayeta ||
snehāktaṃ svinnam aṅgaṃ tu vakraṃ stabdhaṃ savedanam ||
yatheṣṭam ānāmayituṃ sukham eva hi śakyate |
śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kimu gātrāṇi jīvatām |
asakṛt taṃ punaḥ snehaiḥ svedaiśca pratipādayet ||
ghṛtaṃ tilvakasiddhaṃ vā sātalāsiddham eva vā ||
sroto baddhvānilaṃ rundhyāt tasmāt tam anulomayet |
dīpanaiḥ pācanīyair vā bhojyair vā tadyutair naram |
snaihikaṃ nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ śrotrādīnāṃ ca tarpaṇam ||
vibaddhamārgaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śukraṃ dadyād virecanam ||
viriktaṃ pratibhuktaṃ ca pūrvoktāṃ kārayet kriyām |
garbhe śuṣke tu vātena bālānāṃ ca viśuṣyatām ||
nātimātraṃ tathā vāyur vyāpnoti sahasaiva vā ||
sa hanti vātaṃ te te ca snehasvedāḥ suyojitāḥ |
śvasanāsu vimuktāsu tathā saṃjñāṃ sa vindati |
palāṣṭakaṃ tilvakato varāyāḥ prasthaṃ palāṃśaṃ gurupañcamūlam |
sairaṇḍasiṃhītrivṛtaṃ ghaṭe .pāṃ paktvā pacet pādaśṛtena tena ||
dadhnaḥ pātre yāvaśūkāt tribilvaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ hanti tat sevyamānam |
ūrustambhe tu na sneho na ca saṃśodhanaṃ hitam |
mūtrair vā śīlayet pathyāṃ gugguluṃ girisaṃbhavam ||
sthiratoyaṃ saraḥ kṣemaṃ pratisroto nadīṃ taret ||
sahacaraṃ suradāru sanāgaraṃ kvathitam ambhasi tailavimiśritam |
nimbāmṛtāvṛṣapaṭolanidigdhikānāṃ bhāgān pṛthak daśa palān vipaced ghaṭe .pām |
aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitarasena punaśca tena prasthaṃ ghṛtasya vipacet picubhāgakalkaiḥ ||
tat sevitaṃ vidhamati prabalaṃ samīraṃ saṃdhyasthimajjagatam apyatha kuṣṭham īdṛk ||
tasya śuktiḥ prakuñco vā nasyaṃ vāte śirogate ||
jīrṇaṃ piṇyākaṃ pañcamūlaṃ pṛthak ca kvāthyaṃ kvāthābhyām ekatas tailam ābhyām |
kṣīrād aṣṭāṃśaṃ pācayet tena pānād vātā naśyeyuḥ śleṣmayuktā viśeṣāt ||
palāni pañcāśad abhīrutaśca pādāvaśeṣaṃ vipaced vahe .pām ||
tulyakṣīraṃ pālikais tailapātraṃ siddhaṃ kṛcchrāñchīlitaṃ hanti vātān |
bheḍasya saṃmataṃ tailaṃ tat kṛcchrān anilāmayān ||
pattrakalkaṃ tataḥ pūtaṃ vidhinā tat prayojitam |
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ chardiṃ mūrchāṃ gulmakṣatakṣayān ||
pāne nasye .nvāsane .bhyañjane ca snehāḥ kāle samyag ete prayuktāḥ |
duṣṭān vātān āśu śāntiṃ nayeyur vandhyā nārīḥ putrabhājaśca kuryuḥ ||
snehasvedair drutaḥ śleṣmā yadā pakvāśaye sthitaḥ |
pittaṃ vā darśayed rūpaṃ vastibhis taṃ vinirjayet ||
pracchānena sirābhir vā deśād deśāntaraṃ vrajat |
aṅgaglānau tu na srāvyaṃ rūkṣe vātottare ca yat ||
ghṛtaṃ pibet tathā kṣīraṃ guḍūcīsvarase śṛtam ||
tailaṃ payaḥ śarkarāṃ ca pāyayed vā sumūrchitam |
pibed ghṛtaṃ vā kṣīraṃ vā svādutiktakasādhitam ||
nirhared vā malaṃ tasya saghṛtaiḥ kṣīravastibhiḥ |
sakṣaudraṃ triphalāyā vā guḍūcīṃ vā yathā tathā |
kalye liptvāyasīṃ pātrīṃ madhyāhne bhakṣayed idam ||
pañcamūlasya dhātryā vā rasair lelītakīṃ vasām ||
khuḍaṃ surūḍham apyaṅge brahmacārī piban jayet |
ityābhyantaram uddiṣṭaṃ karma bāhyam ataḥ param ||
sparśaśītāḥ sukhasparśā ghnanti dāhaṃ rujaṃ klamam ||
sarāge saruje dāhe raktaṃ hṛtvā pralepayet |
ghṛtaṃ sahacarān mūlaṃ jīvantī chāgalaṃ payaḥ |
lepaḥ piṣṭās tilās tadvad bhṛṣṭāḥ payasi nirvṛtāḥ ||
siddhaṃ samadhu śuktaṃ vā sekābhyaṅge kaphottare ||
kupite mārgasaṃrodhān medaso vā kaphasya vā |
yathāsannaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ vikalpyaṃ syād yathābalam ||
ete sthānasya gāmbhīryāt sidhyeyur yatnato navāḥ ||
vāyau pittāvṛte śītām uṣṇāṃ ca bahuśaḥ kriyām ||
vyatyāsād yojayet sarpir jīvanīyaṃ ca pāyayet |
dhanvamāṃsaṃ yavāḥ śālir virekaḥ kṣīravān mṛduḥ ||
apāne tvāvṛte sarvaṃ dīpanaṃ grāhi bheṣajam ||
prāṇādīnāṃ bhiṣak kuryād vitarkya svayam eva tat |
samānaṃ śamayed vidvāṃs tridhā vyānaṃ tu yojayet |
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ nayed evaṃ vṛtān vātān vimārgagān |
bheṣajaṃ śamanaṃ śastaṃ paryāyaiḥ smṛtam auṣadham ||
śarvarīṃ madhuyaṣṭyā vā kovidārasya vā jale |
karbudārasya bimbyā vā nīpasya vidulasya vā ||
tataḥ pibet kaṣāyaṃ taṃ prātar mṛditagālitam ||
sūtroditena vidhinā sādhu tena tathā vamet |
ā darvīlepanāt siddhaṃ līḍhvā pracchardayet sukham ||
evam eva phalābhāve kalpyaṃ puṣpaṃ śalāṭu vā |
payaḥ puṣpe .sya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā ||
dve vā trīṇyapi vāpothya kvāthe tiktottamasya vā ||
vimṛdya pūtaṃ taṃ kvāthaṃ pittaśleṣmajvarī pibet ||
jvare paitte kavoṣṇena kaphavātāt kaphād api ||
ikṣvākur vamane śastaḥ pratāmyati ca mānave ||

column3: dvidhā khyātaṃ ca tanmūlaṃ śyāmaṃ śyāmāruṇaṃ trivṛt |
sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca taddhitam |
krūre koṣṭhe bahau doṣe kleśakṣamiṇi cāture ||
gṛhītvā visṛjet kāṣṭhaṃ tvacaṃ śuṣkāṃ nidhāpayet ||
ekīkṛtya ca tat svinnaṃ puṭapākena bhakṣayet ||
paktvā mṛdvagninā khādet tato mātrām ayantraṇaḥ ||
guḍaḥ kalyāṇako nāma sarveṣv ṛtuṣu yaugikaḥ |
sarvaiḥ samā samasitā kṣaudreṇa guṭikāḥ kṛtāḥ |
trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhām ajājīṃ saralaṃ vacām |
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet ||
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayet tryaham |
bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave ||
tato majjānam uddhṛtya śucau pātre nidhāpayet |
sauvīrakeṇa vā yuktaṃ kalkena traivṛtena vā ||
dantīkaṣāye tanmajjño guḍaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca nikṣipet |
tam ariṣṭaṃ sthitaṃ māsaṃ pāyayet pakṣam eva vā ||
viśoṣya cūrṇayitvā ca dvau bhāgau gālayet tataḥ ||
kaṣāye daśamūlasya taṃ bhāgaṃ bhāvitaṃ punaḥ ||
śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet |
saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam ||
sudhā bhinatti doṣāṇāṃ mahāntam api saṃcayam |
dvivarṣāṃ vā trivarṣāṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ |
tāṃ pāṭayitvā śastreṇa kṣīram uddhārayet tataḥ ||
bilvādīnāṃ bṛhatyor vā kvāthena samam ekaśaḥ |
guḍasyāṣṭapale pathyā viṃśatiḥ syāt palaṃ palam ||
madyena taistaiśca mano.nukūlair yuktāni deyāni virecanāni ||
vāmayet taṃ punaḥ snigdhaṃ smaran pūrvam atikramam ||
tatra pūrvoditā vyāpat siddhiśca na tathāpi cet |
doṣān utkleśya nirhartum aśaktaṃ janayed gadān |
vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hidhmāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ tṛṣam ||
śītair vā stabdham āme vā samutkleśyāharanmalān |
tān eva janayed rogān ayogaḥ sarva eva saḥ ||
kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham |
na gacched vibhramaṃ tatra vāmayed āśu taṃ bhiṣak ||
yavāgūṃ tanukāṃ dadyāt snehasvedau ca kālavit ||
śune kākāya vā dadyāt tenānnam asṛjā saha |
śuklaṃ vā bhāvitaṃ vastram āvānaṃ koṣṇavāriṇā |
prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syāt pitte śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite ||
tad eva darbhamṛditaṃ raktaṃ vastau niṣecayet |
balāṃ guḍūcīṃ triphalāṃ sarāsnāṃ dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palonmitāni |
aṣṭau phalānyardhatulāṃ ca māṃsācchāgāt paced apsu caturthaśeṣam ||
kalkair guḍakṣaudraghṛtaiḥ satailair yuktaḥ sukhoṣṇo lavaṇānvitaśca ||
vastiḥ paraṃ sarvagadapramāthī svasthe hito jīvanabṛṃhaṇaśca |
vastau ca yasmin paṭhito na kalkaḥ sarvatra dadyād amum eva tatra ||
prastho rasācchāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamaḥ sa yāvat ||
syād dīpano māṃsabalapradaśca cakṣurbalaṃ copadadhāti sadyaḥ ||
eraṇḍamūlāt tripalaṃ palāśāt tathā palāṃśaṃ laghupañcamūlam |
rāsnāṃ vṛṣaṃ lohitikām anantāṃ balāṃ kanīyastṛṇapañcamūlyau |
niṣkvāthya toyena rasena tena śṛtaṃ payo .rdhāḍhakam ambuhīnam |
piṣṭair ghṛtakṣaudrayutair nirūhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ śītalam eva dadyāt |
pratyāgate dhanvarasena śālīn kṣīreṇa vādyāt pariṣiktagātraḥ ||
paktvā kulatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ ||
tān sarṣapailāmadanaiḥ sakuṣṭhair akṣapramāṇaiḥ prasṛtaiśca yuktān |
kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya ||
vakṣye mṛdūn snehakṛto nirūhān sukhocitānāṃ prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak tu ||
karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak ||
kṣīrād dvau prasṛtau kāryau madhutailaghṛtāt trayaḥ |
bilvādimūlakvāthād dvau kaulatthād dvau sa vātajit ||
siddhavastīn ato vakṣye sarvadā yān prayojayet ||
madhutaile same karṣaḥ saindhavād dvipicur miśiḥ ||
suradāru ca rāsnā ca vastir doṣaharaḥ śivaḥ |
pṛthag daśapalaṃ kṣīre pañcamūlaṃ ca sādhayet ||
vahe vipācya toyasya droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca ||
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām ||
saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā ||
nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī ||
bilvājamodacapalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ samaiḥ ||
sādhyam eraṇḍatailaṃ vā tailaṃ vā kapharoganut |
ānāham aśmarīṃ cāśu hanyāt tad anuvāsanam |
kaphaghnaṃ kalpayet tailaṃ dravyair vā kaphaghātibhiḥ |
tīkṣṇair vikarṣite snigdho madhuraḥ śiśiro mṛduḥ ||
svaiḥ svair auṣadhavargaiḥ svān svān rogānnivartayati ||
medasvino viśodhyā ye ca narāḥ kuṣṭhamehārtāḥ ||
vastiḥ saṃkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvād anirharan |
uṣṇasya tasmād ekasya tatra pānaṃ praśasyate ||
phalavartyas tathā svedāḥ kālaṃ jñātvā virecanam |
vyajed ā klamanāśācca prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kārayet |
pāṇivastrair galāpīḍaṃ kuryān na mriyate tathā |
śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ |
alpe doṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥ punaḥ |
gudaṃ dahan likhan kṣiṇvan karotyasya parisravam |
sa vidagdhaṃ sravatyasraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ ||
siddhir vastyāpadām evaṃ snehavastes tu vakṣyate ||
śīto .lpo vādhike vāte pitte .tyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ |
tābhyām eva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte .nuvāsayet |
vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktais taṃ vastibhir haret |
mṛdur virekaḥ sarvaṃ ca tatrāmavihitaṃ hitam |
ūrdhvaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhād ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya etyapi ||
nāpakvaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ gudaṃ sa hyupalimpati |
tīkṣṇo vastis tathā tailam arkapattrarase śṛtam |
anucchvāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā ||
drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā |
tatra vastir virekaśca galapīḍādi karma ca ||
yathāṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ yathā tathā ||
vyatyāsād upayogena kramāt taṃ prakṛtiṃ nayet |
dhanve sādhāraṇe deśe same sanmṛttike śucau |
gṛhṇīyād auṣadhaṃ susthaṃ sthitaṃ kāle ca kalpayet ||
payo bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ tacca nīrujām |
rasaḥ kalkaḥ śṛtaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaśceti prakalpanā ||
svarasaḥ sa samuddiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ piṣṭo dravāplutaḥ |
cūrṇo .plutaḥ śṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ śīto rātriṃ drave sthitaḥ ||
yuñjyād vyādhyādibalatas tathā ca vacanaṃ muneḥ ||
mātrāyā na vyavasthāsti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ |
ālocya deśakālau ca yojyā tadvacca kalpanā ||
madhyaṃ tu mānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ svarasasya catuḥpalam |
peṣyasya karṣam āloḍyaṃ tad dravasya palatraye ||
śītaṃ pale palaiḥ ṣaḍbhiścaturbhis tu tato .param ||
kalkasya yojayed aṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamam ||
pṛthak snehasamaṃ dadyāt pañcaprabhṛti tu dravam |
lehasya tantumattāpsu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca |
kiṃcit sīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartyamāne ca paścimaḥ ||
dagdho .ta ūrdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syād āmas tvagnisādakṛt |
mṛdur nasye kharo .bhyaṅge pāne vastau ca cikkaṇaḥ ||
śāṇaṃ pāṇitalaṃ muṣṭiṃ kuḍavaṃ prastham āḍhakam |
dviguṇaṃ yojayed ārdraṃ kuḍavādi tathā dravam |
kalpayet sadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam |
aṅgānuktau tu mūlaṃ syād aprasiddhau tad eva tu |
dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṃkṣaṇaśca tau ||
palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭirāmraṃ caturthikā ||
dve pale prasṛtas tau dvāvañjalis tau tu mānikā |
āḍhakaṃ bhājanaṃ kaṃso droṇaḥ kumbho ghaṭo .rmaṇam ||
tulā palaśataṃ tāni viṃśatir bhāra ucyate |
saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca tatrādyam āgneyaṃ vaindhyam auṣadham ||
athāsya dakṣiṇe karṇe mantram uccārayed imam ||
ātmā vai putranāmāsi saṃjīva śaradāṃ śatam ||

column3: nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭhatailena secayet snāpayed anu |
tṛtīye .hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate |
dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ tṛtīye ca ghṛtaṃ tataḥ ||
stanyābhāve payaśchāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet |
jāgṛyur bāndhavās tasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam ||
hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣāt satataṃ vacām ||
prāg dakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣag vāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ ||
dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīṃ pālīm anyena pāṇinā |
vidhyed daivakṛte chidre sakṛd evarju lāghavāt |
nordhvaṃ na pārśvato nādhaḥ sirās tatra hi saṃśritāḥ ||
sthāne vyadhān na rudhiraṃ na rugrāgādisaṃbhavaḥ ||
vartis tryahāt tato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
pūrvoktaṃ yojayet kṣīram annaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam ||
trāsayen nāvidheyaṃ taṃ trastaṃ gṛhṇanti hi grahāḥ |
apāmārgeṇa ca ghṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ pūrvavad guṇaiḥ |
hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā |
yad adbhirekatāṃ yāti na ca doṣairadhiṣṭhitam |
tad viśuddhaṃ payo vātād duṣṭaṃ tu plavate .mbhasi ||
kaphāt salavaṇaṃ sāndraṃ jale majjati picchilam |
śiśos tīkṣṇam abhīkṣṇaṃ ca rodanāllakṣayed rujam ||
sa yaṃ spṛśed bhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ |
tatra vidyād rujaṃ mūrdhni rujaṃ cākṣinimīlanāt ||
atha dhātryāḥ kriyāṃ kuryād yathādoṣaṃ yathāmayam |
tatra vātātmake stanye daśamūlaṃ tryahaṃ pibet ||
anu cācchasurām evaṃ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecayet ||
bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tair vā vipakvaṃ sasitopalam |
sukham evaṃ vamed bālaḥ tīkṣṇair dhātrīṃ tu vāmayet |
śakṛn nānāvyathāvarṇaṃ mūtraṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanam |
vihitāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ vacādiṃ yojayed gaṇam |
dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiṃcinna dūyate ||
ta eva doṣā dūṣyāśca jvarādyā vyādhayaśca yat |
atas tad eva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tvasya kanīyasī ||
sadyas tān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayen matimān mṛdu |
yuñjyād virecanādīṃs tu dhātryā eva yathoditān |
siddhaṃ prasthārdham ājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param ||
siddhaṃ lākṣādikaṃ nāma tailam abhyañjanād idam |
pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā ||
tadvallihyāt tathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā romacarmaṇām |
sadanto jāyate yas tu dantāḥ prāg yasya cottarāḥ |
kurvīta tasminn utpāte śāntiṃ taṃ ca dvijātaye ||
dadyāt sadakṣiṇaṃ bālaṃ naigameṣaṃ ca pūjayet |
baddhvā gośakṛtā liptam kukūle svedayet tataḥ |
rasena limpet tālvāsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet ||
pṛṣṭhārur gudakuṭṭaṃ ca kecicca tam anāmikam ||
vyādher yadyasya bhaiṣajyaṃ stanas tena pralepitaḥ |
sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto .nu pītas taṃ taṃ jayed gadam ||
teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ ||
vakravaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśam ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate ||
skandārtas tena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaveddhruvam |
ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ madhye vinamanaṃ jvaraḥ |
romaharṣo muhus trāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ ||
sphoṭāḥ sadāharukpākāḥ saṃdhiṣu syuḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
niśyahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude .pi vā ||
pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampas tandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ ||

jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet |
tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ |
kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdnāti na jugupsate ||
hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hantyātmānaṃ tathā param |
apsu majjet patet kūpe kuryād anyacca tadvidham |

atha sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam ||
