ghṛtāni bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca |
yuñjyāt tathā baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ mantratantravit ||
utkvāthya toyaṃ tad rātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam |
gandharvās tu caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ coragāḥ punaḥ |
rudraḥ skando viśākho .ham indro .ham iti vādinam |
dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vālihānaṃ daśanacchadau |
tṛṇacchidaṃ ca pretena gṛhītaṃ naram ādiśet |
purāṇam athavā tailaṃ navaṃ tat pānanasyayoḥ |
abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyam eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane ||
pralepe kalkam eteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane ||
siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam |
grahān sarvān nihantyāśu viśeṣād āsurān grahān ||
guṇaiḥ pūrvavad uddiṣṭo rājadvāre ca siddhikṛt ||
bījaṃ karañjāt kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt ||
samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ śyoṇākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca |
bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt ||
ghṛtam anavam aśeṣamūtrāṃśasiddhaṃ mataṃ bhūtarāvāhvayaṃ pānatas tad grahaghnaṃ param ||
vidhivinihitam āśu sarvaiḥ kramair yojitaṃ hanti sarvagrahonmādakuṣṭhajvarāṃs tan mahābhūtarāvaṃ smṛtam ||
grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ |
rocate yad yadā yebhyas tat teṣām āharet tadā ||
dadhi chattraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ baliriṣyate |
śvetapattraṃ ca lodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ ||
hiraṇyaṃ ca balir yojyo mūtrājyakṣīram ekataḥ ||
harītakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā ||
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chattraṃ vastram vilepanam |
ebhireva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe ||
piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi ||
ṛte piśācāt sarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret |
savaidyam āturaṃ ghnanti kruddhās te hi mahaujasaḥ ||
mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayet sadā ||
japan siddhāṃśca tanmantrān grahān sarvān apohati ||
yaccoktam iha tat sarvaṃ prayuñjīta parasparam ||
ebhir hi hīnasattvasya hṛdi doṣāḥ pradūṣitāḥ ||
dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hṛtvā mārgān manovahān |
unmādo balavān rātrau bhuktamātre ca jāyate ||
unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet ||
pāṇḍur dīno muhur muhyan hāheti paridevate ||
pūrvam āvṛtamārge tu sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam ||
ittham apyanuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanam añjanam ||
yuñjyāt tāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ |
dvau prasthau svarasād brāhmyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam ||
pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare ||
kalyāṇakam idaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavaneṣu ca ||
jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā ||
kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tair ghṛtam ||
brāhmīm aindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām ||
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām |
column5: viṣaghnīṃ laśunaṃ rāsnāṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām ||

column3: tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaśca miśrakaḥ |
vidhyet sirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā |
āśvāsayet suhṛt taṃ vā vākyair dharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ ||
brūyād iṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayed adbhutāni vā |
kaśābhis tāḍayitvā vā baddhaṃ śvabhre viniṣkṣipet ||
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ ||
baliṃ ca dadyāt palalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām ||
catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṃgameṣu ca ||
hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca ||
tamo viśan mūḍhamatir bībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ |
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan ||
paśyann asanti rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau |
pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayoreva ca mehanam ||
tatra vātāt sphuratsakthiḥ prapataṃśca muhur muhuḥ |
apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan ||
apasmarati pittena muhuḥ saṃjñāṃ ca vindati ||
prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcagavyam idaṃ mahat |
kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nāvane paramaṃ hitam ||
pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye .bhyaṅge ca śasyate |
bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayed bhiṣak ||
tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiśca dhūpam asya prayojayet ||
muktaṃ manovikāreṇa tvam itthaṃ kṛtavān iti |
na brūyād viṣayairiṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto .sya bṛṃhayet ||
vartma saṃdhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvam akṣi vā ||
rogān kuryuścalas tatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ |
vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tat ||
karotyaruṅ nimeṣo .sau vartma yat tu nimīlyate ||
vimuktasaṃdhi niśceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ vātahataṃ hi tat |
pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭam uśanti tat |
karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntam āsthitam ||
pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam |
pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapābhā ghanāḥ kaphāt ||
kolamātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiṃcid alpas tato .thavā ||
raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate ||
madhye vā vartmano .nte vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā |
doṣair vartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yad antaḥ sūkṣmakhācitam |
yad vartmotkliṣṭam utkliṣṭam akasmān mlānatām iyāt |
kharatāntarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇām anyāni vā punaḥ ||
sāsraiḥ syād arbudo doṣair viṣamo bāhyataścalaḥ ||
ādyo .tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato .rśaśca varjayet ||
na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatas tataḥ ||
phenena toyarāśer vā picunā pramṛjann asṛk |
ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayor dattvā piṇḍīṃ ca yavasaktubhiḥ |
vidyāt sulikhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye |
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam |
niṣpīḍayed anu vidhiḥ pariśeṣas tu pūrvavat ||
lekhane bhedane cāyaṃ kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani |
likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam ||
tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣmaśāte tad añjanam ||
dhūpayet sarṣapaiḥ sājyaiḥ śuddhāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pāyayet ||
śiśos tu likhitaṃ vartma srutāsṛg vāmbujanmabhiḥ ||
kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnam annaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ ||
utsṛjya dvau bhruvo .dhastād bhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ |
baddhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam |
gairikeṇa vraṇaṃ yuñjyāt tīkṣṇaṃ nasyāñjanādi ca ||
vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ |
tena netraṃ sarugrāgaśophaṃ syāt sa jalāsravaḥ |
kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet ||
mahān apākaḥ kaṇḍūmān upanāhaḥ sa nīrujaḥ |
raktād raktāsrāve tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet ||
tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī ||
śastreṇa sādhayet pañca sālajīn āsravāṃs tyajet |
upekṣitaḥ sirotpāto rājīs tā eva vardhayan |
sādhayed auṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam ||
navotthaṃ tad api dravyairarmoktaṃ yacca pañcadhā |
chittvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam |
doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sakṛt kṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śuklarūpatām ||
yasya vā liṅganāśo .ntaḥ śyāvaṃ yad vā salohitam ||
purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakam |
upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca |
pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet tatas tam upanāhayet ||
kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca ||
madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha ||
armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat |
raktaṃ dadhinibhaṃ yacca śukravat tasya bheṣajam ||
nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ |
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā |
sirājāle sirā yās tu kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhaiḥ |
na sidhyantyarmavat tāsāṃ piṭikānāṃ ca sādhanam ||
tris trivṛdvāriṇā pakvaṃ kṣataśukre ghṛtaṃ pibet |
ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi dhātavas tryūṣaṇaṃ truṭī |
sthire śukre ghane cāsya bahuśo .pahared asṛk |
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālādibhir likhet ||
sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālam idam eva ca śīlitam ||
ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam |
column5: ajakāṃ pārśvato viddhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam ||

column3: vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca |
saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire ||
snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā |
yuktyā kuryād yathā nāticchedena syāt nimajjanam ||
nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt |
na hīyate labdhabalā tathāntas tīkṣṇāñjanair dṛk satataṃ prayuktaiḥ ||
prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ abhūtam api paśyati |
bhūtaṃ tu yatnād āsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate ||
pārśve paśyen na pārśvasthe timirākhyo .yam āmayaḥ ||
yathāvarṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭir hīyeta ca kramāt |
tatra vātena timire vyāviddham iva paśyati ||
vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryād rajodhūmāvṛtām iva |
sa liṅganāśo vāte tu saṃkocayati dṛksirāḥ |
dṛṅmaṇḍalaṃ viśatyantar gambhīrā dṛg asau smṛtā ||
kāce dṛk kācanīlābhā tādṛg eva ca paśyati |
dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hrasvā hrasvadarśinī ||
kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati ||
sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syālliṅganāśe tu lakṣyate |
raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati ||
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭis tādṛk ca paśyati |
timire śeṣayor dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate |
nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi |
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado .paraḥ |
rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā |
bhṛśam amlāśanād doṣaiḥ sāsrair yā dṛṣṭirācitā ||
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ |
ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaśca yāpyāḥ śeṣāṃstu sādhayet |
kārṣikair niśi tat pītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param |
ardhaprastho ghṛtāt siddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā ||
yuktaṃ pibet tat timirī tadyuktaṃ vā varārasam |
prātar bhaktasya vā pūrvam adyāt pathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
cūrṇo viśeṣāt timiraṃ bhāskaro bhāskaro yathā |
gomūtre chagaṇarase .mlakāñjike ca strīstanye haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca |
yat tutthaṃ jvalitam anekaśo niṣiktaṃ tat kuryād garuḍasamaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ ||
yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||
taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tacchalākā netre yuktā sāñjanānañjanā vā |
taimiryārmasrāvapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti ||
nirdagdhaṃ samaghṛtam añjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo .yaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti gārdhram ||
cūrṇitaṃ naladapattravimiśraṃ bhinnatāram api rakṣati cakṣuḥ ||
tatra yannavanītaṃ syāt puṣṇīyāt tena kukkuṭam |
maricāni daśārdhapicustāpyāt tutthāt palaṃ picur yaṣṭyāḥ |
ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ sroto.ñjanaṃ tāmram ayaḥ saśaṅkhaṃ |
sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ pratidoṣam ataḥ śṛṇu ||
loha eva sthitaṃ māsaṃ nāvanād ūrdhvajatrujān |
vasāñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate |
na ced evaṃ śamaṃ yāti tatastarpaṇam ācaret |
pṛthak pṛthag anenaiva vidhinā kalpayed vasām ||
pañcāṃśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ tryaṃśam athaikāṃśam añjanaṃ timiraghnam |
dṛgvaimalyāya vimalā vartiḥ syāt kokilā punaḥ |
sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭair lepo mukhasya ca |
sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirovastau ca śasyate |
tat srutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacet kṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet |
śīte cāsmin hitam idaṃ sarvaje timire .ñjanam ||
āndhyāya syur malā dadyāt srāvye tvasre jalaukasaḥ |
guḍaḥ pheno .ñjanaṃ kṛṣṇā maricaṃ kuṅkumād rajaḥ ||
tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭham añjanam ||
ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet ||
bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ pattraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam ||
kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam ||
yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam ||
saṃtarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam ||
cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyair yatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvad icchā |
vyartho loko .yaṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsām andhānāṃ vidyamāne .pi vitte ||
triphalā rudhirasrutir viśuddhir manaso nirvṛtirañjanaṃ sanasyam |
śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā ||
muninā niminopadiṣṭam etat paramaṃ rakṣaṇam īkṣaṇasya puṃsām ||
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayet punaḥ |
chattrābhā naikavarṇā ca chattrakī nāma nīlikā ||
svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite |
daivacchidraṃ nayet pārśvād ūrdhvam āmanthayan iva ||
vidhyet suviddhe śabdaḥ syād aruk cāmbulavasrutiḥ ||
sāntvayann āturaṃ cānu netraṃ stanyena secayet |
sthire doṣe cale vāti svedayed akṣi bāhyataḥ |
ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā baddhākṣaṃ śāyayet tataḥ |
viddhād anyena pārśvena tam uttānaṃ dvayor vyadhe ||
kṣavathuṃ kāsam udgāraṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ pānam ambhasaḥ ||
śaktito laṅghayet seko ruji koṣṇena sarpiṣā |
vilepīṃ vā tryahāccāsya kvāthair muktvākṣi secayet |
manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryād vedhe rūḍhe .ñjanaṃ mṛdu ||
ājena tāmram amunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punaridaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam ||
piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitam anātapaśuṣkam akṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛcca dṛṣṭeḥ |
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītam acchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ |
adhimantho bhavet tatra karṇayor nadanaṃ bhramaḥ |
hatādhimanthaḥ so .pi syāt pramādāt tena vedanāḥ |
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā ||
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ |
adhimanthe bhaven netraṃ syande tu kaphasaṃbhave |
uktaḥ śuṣkādipāko .yaṃ saśophaḥ syāt tribhir malaiḥ ||
raktotpanno hanti tadvat trirātrān mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||
kārayed upavāsaṃ ca kopād anyatra vātajāt ||
saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ ||
taccūrṇaṃ sakṛd avacūrṇanānniśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam ||
ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭeryāḥ siddham |
śīghram eva jayati prayojitaḥ śigrupallavarasaḥ samākṣikaḥ ||
taruṇam urubūkapattraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddham āje kṣīre |
uṣṇena śūle dāhe tu payaḥsarpiryutair himaiḥ |
ayam eva vidhiḥ sarvo manthādiṣvapi śasyate |
jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet ||
puṣpāñjanād daśapalaṃ karṣaṃ ca maricāt tataḥ |
ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param ||
dagdhvājyapiṣṭā lohasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭham añjanam |
saśophe vālpaśophe ca snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām ||
tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ vedanāghnam |
tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ||
śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ pattrair dhūpitaṃ tad yavaiśca |
netre yuktaṃ hanti saṃdhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cātitīvrām ||
stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayecca taiḥ |
tāmram ālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet peṣayet tataḥ ||
cikitsā pṛthag eteṣāṃ svaṃsvam uktātha vakṣyate ||
viriktasya ca vartmānu nirlikhed ā viśuddhitaḥ |
saṃkṣudya sādhayet kvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā |

column5: tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣmaśāte tad añjanam ||

column3: alaṃ ca sauvīrakam añjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmrarajaḥ susūkṣmam |
dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tatsamutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā ||
punaḥ punar virekaṃ ca nityam āścyotanāñjanam |
śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām |
saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam ||
dve pādamadhye pṛthusaṃniveśe sire gate te bahudhā ca netre |
cirācca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkām alpaśaḥ sravet |
sā lasīkā spṛśed yad yat tat tat pākam upaiti ca |
nādān akasmād vividhān karṇanādaṃ vadanti tam ||
uccaiḥ kṛcchrācchrutiṃ kuryād badhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca ||
vātena śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā śroto limpet tato bhavet |
kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tvapi ||
teṣu ruk pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca bādhate ||
eko nīrug aneko vā garbhe māṃsāṅkuraḥ sthiraḥ ||
savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ sa upekṣitaḥ ||
saṃkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm ||
kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā ||
karṇe śophaḥ saruk pālyām aruṇaḥ paripoṭavān ||
stabdhaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān unmantho galliraśca saḥ |
lihyuḥ pālīm upekṣitāḥ lehyākhyāḥ piṭikāstā hi |
vātaghnasādhitaṃ sarpiḥ karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet ||
mahāsneho drutaṃ hanti sutīvrām api vedanām |
nihanti śūladāhoṣāḥ kevalaṃ kṣaudram eva vā |
svedayet puṭapākena sa rasaḥ śūlajit param |
raktaje pittavat kāryaṃ sirāṃ cāśu vimokṣayet ||
yuñjyān nāḍīvidhānaṃ ca duṣṭavraṇaharaṃ ca yat ||
srotaḥ pramṛjya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picuvartibhiḥ |
pacet tailaṃ tad āsrāvaṃ nigṛhṇātyāśu pūraṇāt ||
karṇanāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe |
pakvaṃ tailaṃ jayatyāśu sukṛcchrān api pūraṇāt |
atha suptāviva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ haret tataḥ ||
svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīm udvartayet tilaiḥ ||
tailaṃ vipakvaṃ sakṣīraṃ pālīnāṃ puṣṭikṛt param ||
surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam |
chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandham ālocya yaugikam |
niveśya saṃdhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam ||
suvarṣmāṇam arogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivardhayet ||
ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam ||
atha kuryād vayaḥsthasya chinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām ||
chindyān nāsāsamaṃ pattraṃ tattulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ |
sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā |
kapolavadhraṃ saṃdadhyāt sīvyen nāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ |
chindyād rūḍhe .dhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntācca carma tat |
sīvyet tataśca suślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayet punaḥ ||
kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ ||
tatra vātāt pratiśyāye mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ ||
kīṭikā iva sarpantīr manyate parito bhruvau ||
ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakvaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam ||
śleṣmā ca pūtir nirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti tam ||
nicayād abhighātād vā pūyāsṛṅ nāsikā sravet |
kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat ||
kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet ||
tyajet snānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam |
kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet ||
sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtam pītvā vamet piṣṭaistu nāvanam ||
kaṭutīkṣṇair ghṛtair nasyaiḥ kavaḍaiḥ sarvajaṃ jayet ||
kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet ||
kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam |
sādhitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣavapuṭapraṇut |
pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau ||
kruddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvantyantar mukhaṃ gadān |
tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ityukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ ||
grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau |
dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaśca saḥ |
jāyamāne .tirug dante jāte tatra tu śāmyati ||
adhāvanān malo dante kapho vā vātaśoṣitaḥ |
pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante jāyate tataḥ |
calā mandarujo dantāḥ pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate |
dantamāṃse malaiḥ sāsrair bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur guruḥ ||
tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svair yathoditaiḥ |
janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ tad galārbudam |
kṛṣṇo .ruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātāt kṛṣṇarājimān |
sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt |
dehaṃ vṛddhaśca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare .lpatām ||
tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahānilāt ||
vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ ||
kuryāt tad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate |
mukhapāko bhavet sāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtir malaiḥ ||
oṣṭhe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale ||
ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ ||
paṭolyā kākamācyā ca tailam abhyañjanaṃ pacet |
khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam |
idam eva nave kāryaṃ karmauṣṭhe tu kaphāture ||
svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vimedaskaṃ dahen medojam agninā |
dantaharṣe tathā bhede sarvā vātaharā kriyā ||
anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā |
guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet |
rajo rujaṃ jayatyāśu vastrasthaṃ daśane ghṛtam ||
gaṇḍūṣaṃ grāhayet tailam ebhireva ca sādhitam |
dṛḍham apyuddhared dantaṃ pūrvaṃ mūlād vimokṣitam ||
tailaṃ sayaṣṭyāhvarajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ ||
ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavaḍanasyayoḥ |
rakṣet pākaṃ himaiḥ pakvaḥ pāṭyo dāhyo .vagāḍhakaḥ ||
kṣāraṃ yuñjyāt tato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam ||
kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā |
nave jihvālase .pyevaṃ taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet ||
chedayen maṇḍalāgreṇa nātyagre na ca mūlataḥ |
vacā dantī ca mūrvā ca lepaḥ koṣṇo .rtiśophahā |
upanāhyo vraṇe rūḍhe pralepyaśca punaḥ punaḥ |
medobhave sirāṃ vidhyet kaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet |
aśāntau pācayitvā ca sarvān vraṇavad ācaret |
kvāthena teṣāṃ ghanatāṃ gatena taccūrṇayuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ ||
tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādigadān sukṛcchrān |
khadiratulām ambughaṭe paktvā toyena tena piṣṭaiśca |
hatvāsye sarvagadān janayati gārdhrīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm ||
palaśataṃ bāṇāt toyaghaṭe paktvā rase .smiṃśca palārdhikaiḥ |
tailaprasthaṃ pācayecchlakṣṇapiṣṭairebhir dravyair dhāritaṃ tan mukhena |
rogān sarvān hanti vaktre viśeṣāt sthairyaṃ dhatte dantapaṅkteścalāyāḥ ||
khadirasārād dve tule paced valkāt tulāṃ cārimedasaḥ |
ghaṭacatuṣke pādaśeṣe .smin pūte punaḥ kvathanād ghane ||
kārayed guṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tadgadāpahāḥ ||
sarvāsyarogoddhṛtaye tad āhur dantasthiratve tvidam eva mukhyam ||
kṣaudreṇa yuktaḥ kavaḍagraho .yaṃ sarvāmayān vaktragatān nihanti ||
attāraṃ naram aṇavo .pi vaktrarogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpam iva na spṛśantyanarthāḥ ||
pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaścāsyagadān aśeṣān ||
tasmāt teṣām asakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayed duṣṭam ||
prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma ||
nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā saṃbhidyate tathā |
ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ saṃdhibhya iva mucyate ||
column5: ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ saṃdhibhya iva mucyate ||

column3: pakṣāt kupyati māsād vā svayam eva ca śāmyati |
kopite saṃnipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ ||
ā madhyāhnaṃ vivardhiṣṇuḥ kṣudvataḥ sā viśeṣataḥ |
sūryāvartaḥ sa ityuktā daśa rogāḥ śirogatāḥ |
śirasyeva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava ||
susūkṣmaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyād dāruṇakaṃ tu tat |
tad indraluptaṃ rujyāṃ ca prāhuścāceti cāpare |
khalaterapi janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt ||
kaphād ghanatvag varṇāṃśca yathāsvaṃ nirdiśet tvaci ||
dagdhāgnineva nīromā sadāhā yā ca jāyate ||
tad vātāt sphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jalaprabham |
pittāt sadāhaṃ pītābhaṃ kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat ||
māṣān kulatthān mudgān vā tadvat khāded ghṛtānvitān |
tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet ||
varaṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīram ardhodakaṃ pacet ||
tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ ||
column5: tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasye tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ |

column3: varge .tra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram |
ityaśāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ |
kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrchanti jantavaḥ |
kṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvād raktam atra na nirharet ||
vidhyet sirāṃ dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ śīlayen mṛjām ||
khalatau palite valyāṃ haridromni ca śodhitam |
māsaṃ vā nimbajaṃ tailaṃ kṣīrabhuṅnāvayed yatiḥ ||
nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ |
māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ śārivā nīlam utpalam ||
sthitam ikṣurase māsaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet |
sarvān mūrdhagadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam ||
jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet |
sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ |
vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ ca syur vraṇe vraṇāḥ ||
yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaścāśu praśāmyati |
śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhine vivarṇe vedanānvite ||
hṛte hṛte ca rudhire suśītaiḥ sparśavīryayoḥ |
srutāsṛjāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānām api cedṛśām ||
abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
column5: abhyajya svedayitvā tu veṇunāḍyā tataḥ śanaiḥ ||

column3: vilīyate sa cen naivaṃ tatastam upanāhayet |
na mukhe cainam ālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate ||
bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau mehakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca ||
chinnāśca saṃdhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktair ye ca śodhanaiḥ |
śuddhānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyam utsādāya yad īritam |
pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syād āśu ropaṇaḥ ||
tilavad yavakalkaṃ tu kecid icchanti tadvidaḥ |
dve pañcamūle vargaśca vātaghno vātike hitaḥ ||
ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā |
cūrṇo vartiśca saṃyojya vraṇe sapta yathāyatham ||
sarpiḥ sādhyam anena sūkṣmavadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ sagatayaḥ śudhyanti rohanti ca ||
viddhaṃ bhinnaṃ vidalitaṃ tatra ghṛṣṭaṃ lasīkayā ||
raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ saploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet |
avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ vicchinnaṃ syāt tato .pi ca ||
ghṛṣṭe vidalite caiṣa sutarām iṣyate vidhiḥ |
saptāhād gatavege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhim ācaret ||
prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak |
ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet ||
asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netram adīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat |
tato .sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ ||
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram |
pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā |
snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ ||
column5: na kuryāt snehasekaṃ ca tena klidyati hi vraṇaḥ |

column3: chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ |
kāryā śalyāhṛte viddhe bhaṅgād vidalite kriyā |
lohagandhitvam āsyasya syād gātre ca vigandhatā ||
kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati ||
abhinnam antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tvato .nyathā |
vraṇasaukṣmyād bahutvād vā koṣṭham antram anāviśat ||
yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyak antre sīvyed anu vraṇam ||
sthānād apetam ādatte jīvitaṃ kupitaṃ ca tat |
udarān medaso vartiṃ nirgatāṃ bhasmanā mṛdā ||
avakīrya kaṣāyair vā ślakṣṇair mūlaistataḥ samam |
dṛḍhaṃ baddhvā ca sūtreṇa vardhayet kuśalo bhiṣak ||
syād anyathā rug āṭopo mṛtyur vā chidyamānayā ||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe .nne ghṛtaṃ pibet |
haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ ||
column5: haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ ||

column3: samāsād iti bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ bahudhā tu tat |
yathā syād upayogāya tathā tad upadekṣyate |
prājyāṇudāri yat tvasthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat ||
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ saṃdhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat |
jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yat tad vivarjayet ||

column5: asaṃśliṣṭaṃ kapālaṃ tu lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat |

column3: saṃkṣobhād api yad gacched vikriyāṃ tad vivarjayet ||
ādito yacca durjātam asthi saṃdhirathāpi vā |
śithilena hi bandhena saṃdhisthairyaṃ na jāyate ||
tryahāt tryahād ṛtau gharme saptāhān mokṣayeddhime ||
prātaḥ prātaḥ pibed bhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam ||
māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavet saṃdher yathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim |
yantraṇārthaṃ tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ |
jaṅghorvoḥ pārśvayor dvau dvau tala ekaśca kīlakaḥ ||
uktair vidhānair buddhyā ca yathāsvaṃ sthānam ānayet ||
āpothya bhaṅgaṃ yamayet tato bhagnavad ācaret ||
bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak |
column5: bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak |
column9: nopagacched yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak ||

column3: glānir na śasyate tasya saṃdhiviśleṣakṛddhi sā |
lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāram amlaṃ maithunam ātapam |
vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam ||
column5: vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣānnam eva ca ||

column3: kṛṣṇāṃstilān virajaso dṛḍhavastrabaddhān sapta kṣapā vahati vāriṇi vāsayet |
saṃśoṣayed anudinaṃ pravisārya caitān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye ||
punarapi pītapayaskāṃstān pūrvavad eva śoṣitān bāḍham |
sakṣīraśuklaiḥ sapayaḥ sadūrvaistailaṃ pacet tan naladādibhiśca ||
gandhatailam idam uttamam asthisthairyakṛj jayati cāśu vikārān |
pāyor vraṇo .ntar bāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅmāṃsago bhavet |
doṣaiḥ pṛthag yutaiḥ sarvairāgantuḥ so .ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūmatī kaphāt |
vraṇatāṃ yānti tāḥ pakvāḥ pramādāt tatra vātajā ||
ṛjur vātakaphād ṛjvyā gudo gatyātra dīryate |
sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno .sya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ ||
kṣiṇoti tiryaṅ nirgacchann unmārgaṃ kṣatato gatiḥ |
syāt tataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ māṃsakothena tatra ca ||
vidārayanti na cirād unmārgī kṣatajaśca saḥ ||
pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam |
athāsya piṭikām eva tathā yatnād upācaret ||
bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet ||
tāsu rūḍhāsu śeṣāśca mṛtyur dīrṇe gude .nyathā |
sarvatra ca bahucchidre chedān ālocya yojayet |
pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa chedo gotīrthako mataḥ |
abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitam etad eṣām ||
guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthak syāt |
bhagandareṣveṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni |
sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ parihared adhikaṃ vā ||
vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthir grathanāt smṛtaḥ ||
pittāt sadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā pacyate drutam |
bhinno .sram uṣṇaṃ sravati śleṣmaṇā nīrujo ghanaḥ ||
śītaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sraved ghanam |
doṣair duṣṭe .sṛji granthir bhaven mūrchatsu jantuṣu ||
māṃsalair dūṣitaṃ māṃsam āhārair granthim āvahet ||
pravṛddhaṃ medurair medo nītaṃ māṃse .thavā tvaci ||
vāyunā kurute granthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam |
vāyuḥ saṃpīḍya saṃkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca |
niḥsphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ ||
vāto .sram asrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇam |
tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medo.ntaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhistu tat |
sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṃkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca |
māṃsāṅkuraiścitaṃ yāti vṛddhiṃ cāśu sravet tataḥ |
śanaiḥ śanair ghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ tat pracakṣate ||
rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt pittāt tu pītaṃ dāhajvarānvitam ||
kaphād guru snigdham aruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurair bṛhat |
ślīpadaṃ jāyate tacca deśe .nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam ||
gatiḥ sā dūragamanān nāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ ||
sā doṣaiḥ pṛthag ekasthaiḥ śalyahetuśca pañcamī ||
antaḥsthitaṃ śalyam anāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sāsya |
phenānuviddhaṃ tanum alpam uṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam ||
saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ ||
eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ pittāsraje punaḥ |
jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ ||
māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī yāpayed evam eva ca |
śastreṇa pāṭayitvā vā dahen medasi sūddhṛte ||
sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ tathā |
arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam |
sirām upari gulphasya dvyaṅgule pāyayecca tam |
traivṛtaṃ vā pibed evam aśāntāvagninā dahet ||
gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit |
sirām aṅguṣṭhake viddhvā kaphaje śīlayed yavān ||
tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ pītaṃ samūlām apacīṃ jayet ||
tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye .bhyaṅge ca pūjitam |
aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhir vāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ |
vasterūrdhvam adhastād vā medo hṛtvāgninā dahet |
sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ ||
tata ūrdhvaṃ hared granthīn ityāha bhagavān nimiḥ |
pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendravastiṃ ca gadānyapārśve |
vidārya matsyāṇḍanibhāni madhyājjālāni karṣed iti suśrutoktiḥ ||
ā gulphakarṇāt sumitasya jantostasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakād vibhajya |
column5: ā gulphakarṇāt sumitasya jantostasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakād vibhajya |

column3: yā vartyo yāni tailāni tan nāḍīṣvapi śasyate |
ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya pattraṃ vanitāpayaśca |
snugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hantyacireṇa nāḍīm ||
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ |
medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ ||
te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmam iva kaṇṭakaiḥ |
sā viddhā vātapittābhyāṃ tābhyām eva ca gardabhī |
pittād bhavanti piṭikāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ ||
pañcāhāt saptarātrād vā pakṣād vā hanti jīvitam ||

column5: māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ janayet punaḥ |

column3: durgandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ ||
granthiḥ kīlavad utsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat ||
cipyam akṣatarogaṃ ca vidyād upanakhaṃ ca tam |
kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam ||
śyāmalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyaṅgaṃ vaktrād anyatra nīlikā ||
paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt |
pittāt tāmrāntam ānīlaṃ śvetāntaṃ kaṇḍumat kaphāt ||
tatastvag jāyate pāṇḍuḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā |
aśāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirāvyadhaḥ |
vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca |
valmīkaṃ hastapāde ca varjayed itarat punaḥ ||
pakve tu duṣṭamāṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāśca śodhayet |
śastreṇa samyag anu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā ||
vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvag vā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā |
dve jīrake kṛṣṇatilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha |
piṣṭā vā chāgapayasā sakṣaudrā mausalī jaṭā |
jambvāmrapallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ |
lepaḥ savarṇakṛt piṣṭaṃ svarasena ca tindukam ||
yavān sarjarasaṃ lodhram uśīraṃ madanaṃ madhu |
ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca gomūtre paced ā darvilepanāt ||
mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavastubarikā lākṣā haridrādvayaṃ nepālī haritālakuṅkumagadā gorocanā gairikam |
pattraṃ pāṇḍu vaṭasya candanayugaṃ kālīyakaṃ pāradaṃ pattaṅgaṃ kanakatvacaṃ kamalajaṃ bījaṃ tathā kesaram ||
sikthaṃ tutthaṃ padmakādyo vasājyaṃ majjā kṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu cāgnau |
siddhaṃ siddhaṃ vyaṅganīlyādināśe vaktre chāyām aindavīṃ cāśu dhatte ||
prasuptau vātakuṣṭhoktaṃ kuryād dāhaṃ ca vahninā |
utkoṭhe kaphapittoktaṃ koṭhe sarvaṃ ca kauṣṭhikam ||
doṣā duṣṭā gatā guhyaṃ trayoviṃśatim āmayān ||
antar bahir vā meḍhrasya kaṇḍūlā māṃsakīlakāḥ |
piṭikā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataśca yāḥ ||
nivartate sarugdāhaṃ kvacit pākaṃ ca gacchati ||
piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ carma tat pralambam adho maṇeḥ |
vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet ||
mehanaṃ vedanā cogrā taṃ vidyād asṛgarbudam ||
sraṃsaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca ||
tāṃstāṃśca svān gadān vyāpad vātikī nāma sā smṛtā |
rujan saṃdūṣayed yoniṃ vāyuḥ prākcaraṇeti sā ||
sā phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrād udāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati ||
iyaṃ vyāpad udāvṛttā jātaghnī tu yadānilaḥ |
jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ hanti raukṣyād duṣṭārtavodbhavam ||
striyo yonim aṇudvārāṃ kuryāt sūcīmukhīti sā |
karoti yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca śuṣkākhyā sātivedanā |
ṣaḍahāt saptarātrād vā śukraṃ garbhāśayān marut ||
vamet saruṅ nīrujo vā yasyāḥ sā vāminī matā |
duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ ||
kurute vivṛtāṃ srastāṃ vātikīm iva duḥkhitām |
yathāsvair dūṣaṇair duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonim upāśritam |
iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati |
tato garbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti rogāṃścāpnoti dāruṇān |
śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śuddhiṃ virekeṇa viśeṣataḥ ||
tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca triphalāṃ ca pacej jale ||
sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam |
kapāle triphalā dagdhā saghṛtā ropaṇaṃ param |
sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ pratidoṣaṃ tu śophavat ||
na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam |
pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ ||
kumbhīkāyāṃ hared raktaṃ pakvāyāṃ śodhite vraṇe |
svedayitvā tato bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ carma samānayet ||
maṇau punaḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ cātra śasyate ||
ayam eva prayojyaḥ syād avapāṭyām api kramaḥ |
tryahāt tryahāt sthūlatarāṃ nyasya nāḍīṃ vivardhayet ||
srotodvāram asiddhau tu vidvān śastreṇa pāṭayet |
na hi vātād ṛte yonir vanitānāṃ praduṣyati |
ato jitvā tam anyasya kuryād doṣasya bheṣajam ||
snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayet samām ||
sthānāpavṛttā yonir hi śalyabhūtā striyo matā |
śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca ||
kṣataṃ kṣayam asṛkpittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam ||
garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
vātapittāmayān hatvā pānād garbhaṃ dadhāti tat |
doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃśca nāśayet |
tena śūnonnatā stabdhā picchilā srāviṇī tathā ||
yavānnam abhayāriṣṭaṃ sīdhu tailaṃ ca śīlayet ||
durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāt tailaṃ vā kalka eva vā |
evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ ||
dve niśe madhukaṃ medāṃ dīpyakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm |
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param |
phalasarpiriti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat ||
etat paraṃ ca bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ dehavardhanam ||
jagad viṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ ||
sthiram ityulbaṇaṃ vīrye yat kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitam |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti viṣaṃ proktam akṛtrimam ||
viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam ||
jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ ||
dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo dāhaḥ kaṇṭhe ca vedanā |
viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām ||

column5: tāluśoṣaṃ tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam |

column3: durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane ||
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛg vā piśitaṃ kṣipet ||
column5: mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ kṣipet ||

column3: dvijān abhyarcya taiḥ puṣye kalpayed agadottamam |
vaidyaścātra tadā mantraṃ prayatātmā paṭhed imam ||
namo vaiḍūryamāte hulu hulu rakṣa māṃ sarvaviṣebhyaḥ ||
piṣṭe ca dvitīyo mantraḥ harimāyi svāhā ||
jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā |
column5: jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā ||

column3: svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣīviṣākhyāṃ viṣam abhyupaiti ||
mūrchan vaman gadgadavāg vimuhyan bhavecca dūṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ |
bhaven naro dhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā vihaṅgaḥ |
sthitaṃ rasādiṣvathavā vicitrān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān ||
column5: sthitaṃ rasādiṣvathavā yathoktān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān |

column3: duṣṭaṃ dūṣayate dhātūn ato dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam ||
pippalyo dhyāmakaṃ māṃsī lodhram elā suvarcikā |
śūyate pacyate sadyo gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām |
śalyam ākṛṣya taptena lohenānu dahed vraṇam ||
viṣāṇāṃ cālpavīryāṇāṃ yogo gara iti smṛtaḥ |
manyate kṛṣṇam ātmānaṃ gauro gauraṃ ca kālakaḥ ||
garārto vāntavān bhuktvā tat pathyaṃ pānabhojanam ||
visarpati ghanāpāye tad agastyo hinasti ca |
nāghṛtaṃ sraṃsanaṃ śastaṃ pralepo bhojyam auṣadham |
tridhā samāsato bhaumā bhidyante te tvanekadhā ||
catuṣpād vyantarān vidyād eteṣām eva saṃkarāt ||
na tu daṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśaṃ tat tuṇḍāhatam ādiśet ||
ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā vyālīḍhākhyam aśoṇitam |
daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ trīṇi tāni tu ||
nirviṣaṃ dvayam atrādyam asādhyaṃ paścimaṃ vadet |
viṣaṃ nāheyam aprāpya raktaṃ dūṣayate vapuḥ ||
raktam aṇvapi tu prāptaṃ vardhate tailam ambuvat |
kadācit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat |
viṣodvego jvaraśchardir mūrchā dāho .pi vā bhavet |
śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ ||
dvitīye granthayo vege tṛtīye mūrdhni gauravam |
dāho hidhmā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam ||
daṣṭasya rājilair duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ yāti śoṇitam |
pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ dvitīye gurutāti ca ||
gātrabhaṅgo jvaraḥ śītaḥ śeṣayoḥ pūrvavad vadet |
kuryāt pañcasu vegeṣu cikitsāṃ na tataḥ param ||
nairṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet |
stabdhajihvo muhur mūrchan śītocchvāso na jīvati |
hidhmā śvāso vamiḥ kāso daṣṭamātrasya dehinaḥ ||
jāyante yugapad yasya sa hṛcchūlī na jīvati |
na nasyaiścetanā tīkṣṇair na kṣatāt kṣatajāgamaḥ ||
rakṣan kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān viṣam āśu śamaṃ nayet |
mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ ||
kuryācchīghraṃ yathā dehe viṣavallī na rohati |
daṣṭamātro daśed āśu tam eva pavanāśinam ||
loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanaiśchittvā cānu sasaṃbhramam |
na jāyate viṣād vego bījanāśād ivāṅkuraḥ ||
karoti bhasmasāt sadyo vahniḥ kiṃ nāma tu kṣatam |
aṅgaṃ sahaiva daṃśena lepayed agadair muhuḥ ||
viṣe pravisṛte vidhyet sirāṃ sā paramā kriyā ||
rakte nirhriyamāṇe hi kṛtsnaṃ nirhriyate viṣam |
skanne tu rudhire sadyo viṣavegaḥ praśāmyati |
pibed ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudram agadaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam |
vamanair viṣahṛdbhiśca naivaṃ vyāpnoti tad vapuḥ |
susūkṣmaṃ samyag ālocya viśiṣṭāṃ cācaret kriyām |
pānaṃ darvīkarair daṣṭe nasyaṃ madhu sapākalam |
agadaḥ phaṇināṃ ghore viṣe rājīmatām api |
sakṣaudro himavān nāma hanti maṇḍalināṃ viṣam |
mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet ||
atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve visrāvya śoṇitam |
dvitīye vamanaṃ kṛtvā tadvad evāgadaṃ pibet |
pāyayed vamanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ ca viṣāpahaiḥ |
māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet ||
tṛtīye vamitaḥ peyāṃ vege maṇḍalināṃ pibet |
atīkṣṇam agadaṃ ṣaṣṭhe gaṇaṃ vā padmakādikam ||
garbhiṇībālavṛddheṣu mṛduṃ vidhyet sirāṃ na ca |
tvaṅ manohvā niśe vakraṃ rasaḥ śārdūlajo nakhaḥ ||
bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam |
phalatrikaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca bastasya mūtreṇa susūkṣmapiṣṭam ||
bhūyo vegāya jāyeta śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā ||
sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu |
tathā droṇāṃ mahādroṇāṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim |
vṛścikasya viṣaṃ tīkṣṇam ādau dahati vahnivat |
ūrdhvam ārohati kṣipraṃ daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati ||
mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvā rūkṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ ||
karoti sekam aṅgānāṃ daṃśaḥ śītāmbuneva ca |
nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaśca dhūpanam ||
viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca ||
yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ |
lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaśca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayo .pi vā |
pāne sarpir madhuyutaṃ kṣīraṃ vā bhūriśarkaram ||
saindhavaṃ ca vinihantyagado .yaṃ lepato .likulajaṃ viṣam āśu ||
kuryād guṭikāṃ lepād iyam aliviṣanāśanī śreṣṭhā ||
arkasya dugdhena śirīṣabījaṃ trir bhāvitaṃ pippalicūrṇamiśram |
kīṭebhyo dāruṇatarā lūtāḥ ṣoḍaśa tā jaguḥ |
nidrāṃ śītajvaraṃ kāsaṃ kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute bhṛśam |

column5: sarve .pi sarvair jāyante vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā ||

column3: saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt |
kledena yat spṛśatyaṅgaṃ tatrāpi kurute vraṇam |
lūtā nābher daśatyūrdhvam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca kīṭakāḥ ||
taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt |
ṣaṣṭhe vyāpnoti marmāṇi saptame hanti jīvitam |
iti tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ madhyaṃ hīnaṃ ca vibhajed ataḥ ||
dahecca jāmbavauṣṭhādyair na tu pittottaraṃ dahet |
prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na chindīta dahen na ca |
kaphe jyeṣṭhāmbunā pītvā viṣam āśu samudvamet |
lodhraṃ sevyaṃ padmakaṃ padmareṇuḥ kālīyākhyaṃ candanaṃ yacca raktam |
kāntāpuṣpaṃ dugdhinīkā mṛṇālaṃ lūtāḥ sarvā ghnanti sarvakriyābhiḥ ||
śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukradigdhaiḥ spṛśanti vā |
column5: śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukraspṛṣṭaiḥ spṛśanti vā |

column3: yad aṅgam aṅgaistatrāsre dūṣite pāṇḍutāṃ gate ||
sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe |
daṣṭo yena tu tacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati ||
dagdhaṃ visrāvayed daṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet ||
anyaiśca viṣaśophaghnaiḥ sirāṃ vā mokṣayed drutam ||
madanasya ca saṃcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet |
takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ saṃcūrṇya vā pibet ||
gavāṃ mūtreṇa payasā mañjarīṃ tilakasya vā ||
pradihyād agadaistaistaiḥ purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pibet ||
aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ ||
column5: palalaṃ tilatailaṃ ca rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ ||

column3: dīrgham āyuḥ smṛtiṃ medhām ārogyaṃ taruṇaṃ vayaḥ |
pūrve vayasi madhye vā tat prayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ |
aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ |
vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ ||
diśy udīcyāṃ śubhe deśe trigarbhāṃ sūkṣmalocanām ||
atha puṇye .hni sampūjya pūjyāṃs tāṃ praviśec chuciḥ |
tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ ||
haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet ||
snigdhasvinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ tena sādhu viricyate |
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam |
yasya yad yaugikaṃ paśyet sarvam ālocya sātmyavit ||
dve ca tailāt pacet sarvaṃ tad agnau lehatāṃ gatam ||
avatīrṇaṃ himaṃ yuñjyād viṃśaiḥ kṣaudraśatais tribhiḥ |
yā noparundhyād āhāram ekaṃ mātrāsya sā smṛtā |
ṣaṣṭikaḥ payasā cātra jīrṇe bhojanam iṣyate ||
brahmaṇā vihitaṃ dhanyam idaṃ prāśya rasāyanam ||
tad ghṛtakumbhe bhūmau nidhāya ṣaṇmāsasaṃstham uddhṛtya |
prāhṇe prāśya yathānalam ucitāhāro bhavet satatam ||
antar dvihastaṃ gambhīraṃ pūryam āmalakair navaiḥ ||
ādīpya gomayair vanyair nirvāte svedayet tataḥ ||
svinnāni tāny āmalakāni tṛptyā khāden naraḥ kṣaudraghṛtānvitāni |
kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ cānu pibet prakāmaṃ tenaiva varteta ca māsam ekam ||
varjyāni varjyāni ca tatra yatnāt spṛśyaṃ ca śītāmbu na pāṇināpi |
ekādaśāhe .sya tato vyatīte patanti keśā daśanā nakhāś ca ||
athālpakair eva dinaiḥ surūpaḥ strīṣv akṣayaḥ kuñjaratulyavīryaḥ |
parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭī ||
jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī |
vidārī vṛṣamūlaṃ ca tad aikadhyaṃ palonmitam |
pādaśeṣaṃ rasaṃ tasmād vyasthīny āmalakāni ca |
snehārdhaṃ madhu siddhe tu tavakṣīryāś catuḥpalam ||
ity eṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ |
column5: tathā ityeṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ ||

column3: kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam |
medhāṃ smṛtiṃ kāntim anāmayatvam āyuḥprakarṣaṃ pavanānulomyam |
strīṣu praharṣaṃ balam indriyāṇām agneś ca kuryād vidhinopayuktaḥ ||
sitayā vā samā yuktā samāyuktā rasāyanam |
maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaṃ yathāgni kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūrṇam |
rasaṃ guḍūcyāḥ sahamūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ ||
medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī ||
column5: medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa ca śaṅkhapuṣpī ||

column3: triphalā kaṭukatrayaṃ haridre sapaṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ ||
triguṇena rasena śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sapayaskaṃ ghṛtanalvaṇaṃ vipakvam |
upayujya bhavej jaḍo .pi vāgmī śrutadhārī pratibhānavān arogaḥ ||
peṣyair mṛṇālabisakesarapattrabījaiḥ siddhaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ payasā ca sarpiḥ |
pañcāravindam iti tat prathitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prabhraṣṭapauruṣabalapratibhair niṣevyam ||
yan nālakandadalakesaravad vipakvaṃ nīlotpalasya tad api prathitaṃ dvitīyam |
sarpiś catuṣkuvalayaṃ sahiraṇyapattraṃ medhyaṃ gavām api bhavet kimu mānuṣāṇām ||
vaidehikā ca triyavāḥ pṛthak syur yavau suvarṇasya tilo viṣasya ||
sarpiṣaś ca palam ekata etad yojayet pariṇate ca ghṛtāḍhyam |
bhojanaṃ samadhu vatsaram evaṃ śīlayann adhikadhīsmṛtimedhaḥ ||
atharvamantrādikṛtāś ca kṛtyāḥ śāmyanty anenātibalāś ca vātāḥ ||
akṣamātraṃ tato mūlāc cūrṇitāt payasā pibet ||

column5: evaṃ varṣaprayogeṇa balavān san varṣaśataṃ jīvet ||

column3: subhāvitaḥ svena rasena tasmān mātrāṃ parāṃ prāsṛtikīṃ pibed yaḥ ||
kṣīreṇa tenaiva ca śālim aśnan jīrṇe bhavet sa dvitulopayogāt |
śaktaḥ surūpaḥ subhagaḥ śatāyuḥ kāmī kakudmān iva gokulasthaḥ ||
māsaṃ niranno māsaṃ ca kṣīrānnādo jarāṃ jayet ||
ghṛtakṣaudraplutaṃ lihyāt tatpakvaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pibet ||
yathottaraṃ sa guṇavān vidhinā ca rasāyanam ||
chāyāśuṣkaṃ tato mūlaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ lihan |
sarpiṣā madhusarpirbhyāṃ piban vā payasā yatiḥ ||
ambhasā vā hitānnāśī śataṃ jīvati nīrujaḥ |
tailena līḍho māsena vātān hanti sudustarān |
saptarātratrayaṃ yāvat trīṇi trīṇi tataḥ param ||
ā catvāriṃśatas tāni hrāsayed vṛddhivat tataḥ |
parivāritaṃ samantāt pacet tato gomayāgninā mṛdunā |
tatsvaraso yaś cyavate gṛhṇīyāt taṃ dine .nyasmin ||
pūrvavidhiyantritātmā prāpnoti guṇān sa tān eva ||
ghṛṣṭveṣṭikācūrṇakaṇair jalena prakṣālya saṃśoṣya ca mārutena ||
tadrasaṃ punar api śrapayeta kṣīrakumbhasahitaṃ caraṇasthe ||
sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tatra tulyapramāṇaṃ yuñjyāt svecchaṃ śarkarayā rajobhiḥ |
ekībhūtaṃ tat khajakṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye saptarātraṃ suguptam ||
tam amṛtarasapākaṃ yaḥ prage prāśam aśnann anupibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā |
smṛtimatibalamedhāsattvasārair upetaḥ kanakanicayagauraḥ so .śnute dīrgham āyuḥ ||
droṇe .mbhaso vraṇakṛtāṃ triśatād vipakvāt kvāthāḍhake palasamais tilatailapātram |
sahāmalakaśuktibhir dadhisareṇa tailena vā guḍena payasā ghṛtena yavasaktubhir vā saha |
tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā vapuṣkaram aruṣkaraṃ paramamedhyam āyuṣkaram ||
kaphajo na sa rogo .sti na vibandho .sti kaścana |
column5: kaphajo na sa rogo.sti na vibandho.sti kaścana |

column3: yaṃ na bhallātakaṃ hanyāc chīghram agnibalapradam ||
tilavat pīḍayed droṇyāṃ kvāthayed vā kusumbhavat |
tattailaṃ saṃbhṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ paced ā salilakṣayāt ||
snigdhasvinno hṛtamalaḥ pakṣād uddhṛtya tat tataḥ ||
tenāsyordhvam adhastāc ca doṣā yānty asakṛt tataḥ |
pañcāhāni pibet tailam itthaṃ varjyān vivarjayan |
tad eva khadirakvāthe triguṇe sādhu sādhitam |
nihitaṃ pūrvavat pakṣaṃ piben māsaṃ suyantritaḥ ||
sarpirmadhuyutaṃ pītaṃ tad eva khadirād vinā |
tad eva nasye pañcāśad divasān upayojitam |
pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīr madhusarpiṣā |
tisras tisras tu pūrvāhṇe bhuktvāgre bhojanasya ca |

column5: jīrṇe jīrṇe ca bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpiṣā |
column9: jīrṇe jīrṇe ca bhuñjīta ṣaṣṭikaṃ kṣīrasarpiṣā ||

column3: piṣṭās tā balibhiḥ peyāḥ śṛtā madhyabalair naraiḥ ||
tadvac ca chāgadugdhena dve sahasre prayojayet |
ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam ||
bilvārdhamātreṇa ca pippalīnāṃ pātraṃ pralimped ayaso niśāyām |
prātaḥ pibet tat salilāñjalibhyāṃ varṣaṃ yatheṣṭāśanapānaceṣṭaḥ ||
lohopaliptāḥ pṛthag eva jīvet samāḥ śataṃ vyādhijarāvimuktaḥ ||
kṣīrāñjalibhyāṃ ca rasāyanāni yuktāny amūny āyasalepanāni |
kurvanti pūrvoktaguṇaprakarṣam āyuḥprakarṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tataś ca ||
śaradam avalihānaḥ pāriṇāmān vikārāṃs tyajati mitahitāśī tadvad āhārajātān ||
tīvreṇa kuṣṭhena parītamūrtir yaḥ somarājīṃ niyamena khādet |
ye somarājyā vituṣīkṛtāyāś cūrṇair upetāt payasaḥ sujātāt |
uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tad evānupibanti cānte ||
rāhor amṛtacauryeṇa lūnād ye patitā galāt |
amṛtasya kaṇā bhūmau te laśunatvam āgatāḥ ||
tatkāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktam ālocya mātrayā ||
kvāthena vā yathāvyādhi rasaṃ kevalam eva vā ||
śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthiratāṃ gata ojasi ||
kuḍavo .sya parā mātrā tadardhaṃ kevalasya tu |
palaṃ piṣṭasya tanmajjñaḥ sabhaktaṃ prāk ca śīlayet ||
bhuñjīta yūṣair payasā rasair vā dhanvacāriṇām ||
madyam ekaṃ pibet tatra tṛṭprabandhe jalānvitam |
sthitaṃ daśāhād aśnīyāt tadvad vā vasayā samam ||
nimardakān vā ghṛtaśuktayuktān prakāmam adyāllaghu tuccham aśnan ||
śuddhe vā vidyate vāyau na dravyaṃ laśunāt param ||
atitikṣor ajīrṇaṃ ca laśuno vyāpade dhruvam ||
sarvaṃ ca tiktakaṭukaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ |
chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate ||
snigdham anamlakaṣāyaṃ mṛdu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham ||
column5: snigdhamanamlakaṣāyaṃ mṛdu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham ||

tat samarasatāṃ yātaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ prakṣiped rase bhūyaḥ |

column5: svaiḥ svairevaṃ kvāthair bhāvyaṃ vārān bhavetsapta ||

column3: tryahaṃ yuñjīta girijam ekaikena tathā tryaham ||
yogaṃ yogyaṃ tatas tasya kālāpekṣaṃ prayojayet ||
guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaṃ na ca ||
kulatthān kākamācīṃ ca kapotāṃśca sadā tyajet ||
na so .sti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya |
column5: na so .sti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpaḥ śilāhvayaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya |

column3: tatkālayogair vidhivat prayuktaṃ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ dadhāti ||
ato .nyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ ||
column5: ato.nyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ |

column3: sukhopacārā bhraṃśe .pi ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ ||
śītodakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ ghṛtam ekaikaśo dviśaḥ |
triśaḥ samastam athavā prāk pītaṃ sthāpayed vayaḥ ||
guḍena madhunā śuṇṭhyā kṛṣṇayā lavaṇena vā |
dve dve khādan sadā pathye jīved varṣaśataṃ sukhī ||
harītakīṃ sarpiṣi sampratāpya samaśnatas tat pibato ghṛtaṃ ca |
bhaveccirasthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakṛt kṛtaṃ sādhu yathā kṛtajñe ||
praṇāśam āyānti jarāvikārā granthā viśālā iva durgṛhītāḥ ||
lauhaṃ rajo vellabhavaṃ ca sarpiḥkṣaudradrutaṃ sthāpitam abdamātram |
samudgake bījakasārakﾱpte lihan balī jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ ||
jarānadīṃ rogataraṃgiṇīṃ te lāvaṇyayuktāḥ puruṣās taranti ||
niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvantyarujaḥ kim atra citram ||
bījakasya rasam aṅgulihāryaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ triphalāṃ ca |
śīlayatsu puruṣeṣu jarattā svāgatāpi vinivartata eva ||
punarnavasyārdhapalaṃ navasya piṣṭaṃ pibed yaḥ payasārdhamāsam |
māsadvayaṃ tattriguṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇo .pi bhūyaḥ sa punarnavaḥ syāt ||
pītāśvagandhā payasārdhamāsaṃ ghṛtena tailena sukhāmbunā vā |
kṛśasya puṣṭiṃ vapuṣo vidhatte bālasya sasyasya yathā suvṛṣṭiḥ ||
poṣaḥ śarīrasya bhavatyanalpo dṛḍhībhavanty ā maraṇācca dantāḥ ||
vṛṣaḥ sthiraḥ śāntavikāraduḥkhaḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ ||
sārdhaṃ tilair āmalakāni kṛṣṇair akṣāṇi saṃkṣudya harītakīr vā |
ye .dyur mayūrā iva te manuṣyā ramyaṃ parīṇāmam avāpnuvanti ||
ye māsam ekaṃ svarasaṃ pibanti dine dine bhṛṅgarajaḥsamuttham |
kṣīrāśinas te balavīryayuktāḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvitam āpnuvanti ||
māsaṃ vacām apyupasevamānāḥ kṣīreṇa tailena ghṛtena vāpi |
maṇḍūkaparṇīm api bhakṣayanto bhṛṣṭāṃ ghṛte māsam anannabhakṣāḥ |
chāyāviśuṣkaṃ guṭikārdham adyāt pūrvaṃ samastām api tāṃ krameṇa |
bhajed viriktaḥ kramaśaśca maṇḍaṃ peyāṃ vilepīṃ rasakaudanaṃ ca ||
sarpiḥsnigdhaṃ māsam ekaṃ yatātmā māsād ūrdhvaṃ sarvathā svairavṛttiḥ |
varjyaṃ yatnāt sarvakālaṃ tvajīrṇaṃ varṣeṇaivaṃ yogam evopayuñjyāt ||
bhavati vigatarogo yo .pyasādhyāmayārtaḥ prabalapuruṣakāraḥ śobhate yo .pi vṛddhaḥ |
upacitapṛthugātraśrotranetrādiyuktas taruṇa iva samānāṃ pañca jīvecchatāni ||
pātre lohamaye tryahaṃ ravikarair āloḍayan pācayet |
agnau cānu mṛdau salohaśakalaṃ pādasthitaṃ tat pacet ||
pūtasyāṃśaḥ kṣīrato .ṃśastathāṃśau bhārgān niryāsād dvau varāyās trayo .ṃśāḥ |
aṃśāś catvāraś ceha haiyaṃgavīnād ekīkṛtyaitat sādhayet kṛṣṇalauhe ||
vimalakhaṇḍasitāmadhubhiḥ pṛthag yutam ayuktam idaṃ yadi vā ghṛtam |
bhṛṅgapravālān amunaiva bhṛṣṭān ghṛtena yaḥ khādati yantritātmā |
anenaiva ca kalpena yas tailam upayojayet |
tān evāpnoti sa guṇān kṛṣṇakeśaś ca jāyate ||
yathāsvam auṣadhaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktvā rasāyanam ||
guṇair ebhiḥ samuditaḥ sevate yo rasāyanam |
sa nivṛttātmā dīrghāyuḥ paratreha ca modate ||
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirapatyaṃ ca guṇavat tatra saṃśritam ||
mede dve dve ca kākolyau śūrpaparṇyau śatāvarīm ||
vīrāṃ payasyāṃ jīvantīm ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ trikaṇṭakam ||
māṣāṇām āḍhakaṃ caitad dvidroṇe sādhayed apām ||
vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau yaṣṭīṃ phalgūni pippalīm ||
tat siddhapūtaṃ cūrṇasya pṛthak prasthena yojayet ||
so .kṣamātram ataḥ khādet yasya rāmāśataṃ gṛhe |
jāgarti rātriṃ sakalām akhinnaḥ khedayan striyaḥ ||
yaḥ khādet sasitān gacchet sa strīśatam apūrvavat ||
column5: yaḥ khādet sa pumān gacchet strīṇāṃ śatamapūrvavat ||

column3: payo.nupānaṃ yo lihyān nityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet |
kulīraśṛṅgyā yaḥ kalkam āloḍya payasā pibet ||
pibed bāṣkayaṇaṃ cānu kṣīraṃ na kṣayam eti saḥ |
yat kiṃcin madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanam |
manaso harṣaṇaṃ yacca tat sarvaṃ vṛṣyam ucyate ||
kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṃghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
column5: kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṃghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||

column3: nāmāpi yasyā hṛdayotsavāya yāṃ paśyatāṃ tṛptiranāptapūrvā |
priyaṃvadā tulyamanaḥśayā yā sā strī vṛṣyatvāya paraṃ narasya ||
tāmbūlam acchamadirā kāntā kāntā niśā śaśāṅkāṅkā |
yad yacca kiṃcid iṣṭaṃ manaso vājīkaraṃ tat tat ||
madhu mukham iva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kalaraṇanā parivādinī priyeva |
kusumacayamanoramā ca śayyā kisalayinī latikeva puṣpitāgrā ||
deśe śarīre ca na kācid artirartheṣu nālpo .pi manovidhānaḥ |
vājīkarāḥ saṃnihitāśca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti ||
mustā parpaṭakaṃ jvare tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭodbhavaṃ lājāśchardiṣu vastijeṣu girijaṃ meheṣu dhātrīniśe |
pāṇḍau śreṣṭham ayo .bhayānilakaphe plīhāmaye pippalī saṃdhāne kṛmijā viṣe śukatarur medo.nile gugguluḥ ||
sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ kṛmiṣu kṛmighnaṃ śoṣe surā chāgapayo .tha māṃsam ||
akṣyāmayeṣu triphalā guḍūcī vātāsraroge mathitaṃ grahaṇyām |
kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca ||
unmādaṃ ghṛtam anavaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ vyapasmṛtiṃ brāhmī |
māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ stabdhagātratāṃ svedaḥ |
samaśuktārdrakamātrā mande vahnau śrame surā snānam |
duḥkhasahatve sthairye vyāyāmo gokṣurur hitaḥ kṛcchre ||
vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī triphalā guggulur vraṇe ||
vastir vātavikārān paittān rekaḥ kaphodbhavān vamanam |
kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ sarpiḥ pittaṃ samīraṇaṃ tailam ||
ityagryaṃ yat proktaṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ śamāyālam |
kiṃ śāsti śāstram asmin iti kalpayato .gniveśamukhyasya |
na cikitsācikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati |
na hyupāyam apekṣante sarve rogā na cānyathā |
na sidhyed daivavaiguṇyān na tviyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmikā ||
na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam ||
kaḥ prāptaḥ kalyatāṃ pathyād ṛte rohiṇikādiṣu ||
śāstrād eva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghanabṛṃhaṇam ||
tyajed dūrād bhiṣakpāśān pāśān vaivasvatān iva ||
cikitsāśāstram akhilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam ||
tasmād analpaphalam alpasamudyamānāṃ prītyartham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram ||
dīrghajīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ |
etat paṭhan saṃgrahabodhaśaktaḥ svabhyastakarmā bhiṣag aprakampyaḥ |
yadi carakam adhīte taddhruvaṃ suśrutādipraṇigaditagadānāṃ nāmamātre .pi bāhyaḥ |
atha carakavihīnaḥ prakriyāyām aklinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ ||
abhiniveśavaśād abhiyujyate subhaṇite .pi na yo dṛḍhamūḍhakaḥ |
paṭhatu yatnaparaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam anirvidaḥ ||
vāte pitte śleṣmaśāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa |
etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahmajo vā kā nirmantre vaktṛbhedoktiśaktiḥ ||
bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ subhāṣitam ||
kṛtvā yacchubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ ||
